emails.subject: Đèn đường hỏng nhiều tuần
emails.body:
Xin chào,

Đây là lần thứ tư tôi viết thư. Tôi sống gần Beckley Dr và Watkins Way. Mấy cột đèn đường gần trạm xe buýt bị tắt từ tháng trước. Tôi đã báo qua ứng dụng nhưng chưa ai sửa.

Xin quý vị cho người đến sửa sớm.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Pothole that keeps coming back
emails.body:
A pothole near the crosswalk bent the rim on my car last week. I've reported it three times and the ticket keeps closing. My neighbor's tire blew out on it in March.

I OPPOSE spending on cosmetic projects while basic streets crumble. Thank you for reading this.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Renter asking for a YES vote
emails.body:
My house is right at Pearl Ave and Upton Way. I'm a renter and the annual increases are the reason my friends have left the city. My partner uses a wheelchair, so this matters a lot. We are not asking for a handout, just predictability.

Please vote YES on the rent cap amendment.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Gas station soil and traffic gaps
emails.body:
To the City Council,

The gas station rebuild proposed across from my house would add two extra fuel canopies and a convenience store, but the traffic study counted cars only on a Tuesday morning. The soil testing only covers the front half of the lot, not where the old underground tanks were. Anyone who drives this stretch knows the Tuesday counts miss the school rush and the weekend tourist traffic. I want the city to require borings under the old tank area before any approval.

Please require a full environmental review with soil borings and weekend traffic counts before approval.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Dark corner after dark
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

Our corner has been dark since the lights went out last month, and I feel unsafe walking my dog after eight. I already reported it through the 311 app twice and I got an automated response both times.

Please send a crew to restore the light and confirm when it is fixed.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Sweeps ban
emails.body:
To the City Council,

I want the city to make it a rule that local officers do not join immigration sweeps in our area.

Please pass a sweeps ban for local police so families are not caught up in federal operations.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: No al centro de datos
emails.body:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

Trabajo de noche y llego a casa a las 6. Un centro de datos que usa tanta agua no tiene sentido cuando nos piden ahorrar. Además hay ruido y camiones.

Por favor voten que no.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Terra Verde data center: EIR certification and site development permit

emails.subject: Road surface is falling apart
emails.body:
Hello,

I live in Willow Glen South. I'm writing on my lunch break, so I'll keep it short. A pothole near the crosswalk bent the rim on my car last week. Cyclists have to swerve into traffic to avoid it.

I SUPPORT more road-repair funding for residential streets.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Let us build more homes
emails.body:
Hello,

I live by Piedmont Road and Salinas Court with my family. I'd like to build a small fourplex on my lot so my parents and my daughter can live nearby. I'm retired and I walk the neighborhood every morning.

I SUPPORT the fourplex reform. Please approve it.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: Centro para personas mayores
emails.body:
Buenas tardes,

El centro para personas mayores redujo sus horas y mi mamá ya no tiene a dónde ir. Tengo 2 hijos en la escuela del barrio. Ella se siente muy sola.

Por favor regresen el horario completo.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.to: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
emails.subject: Phản đối trung tâm dữ liệu Terra Verde
emails.body:
Kính gửi Hội đồng Thành phố,

Tôi phản đối dự án trung tâm dữ liệu Terra Verde gần Alviso. Tôi lo ngại về lượng nước và điện khổng lồ mà cơ sở này sẽ tiêu thụ, cũng như tiếng ồn và xe tải suốt ngày đêm. Khu vực này hay bị ngập lụt.

Kính mong quý vị bỏ phiếu chống, hoặc ít nhất yêu cầu đánh giá môi trường đầy đủ. Xin cảm ơn.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Terra Verde data center: EIR certification and site development permit

emails.subject: Light out again
emails.body:
Hello,

This is the second time this year the light outside my front window has gone dark.

Please fix it permanently instead of patching the same wires each time.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Oposición al centro de datos en Alviso
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

Vivo en Alviso y me OPONGO al centro de datos Terra Verde. Nos preocupa el agua: ¿cuánta van a usar esas máquinas mientras a nosotros nos piden ahorrar? También el ruido y los camiones. Alviso ya se inunda y nadie nos hace caso.

Por favor voten que no, o al menos exijan un estudio ambiental completo. Gracias por escucharnos.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Terra Verde data center: EIR certification and site development permit

emails.subject: ADU permit stuck for months
emails.body:
To the City Council,

A simple kitchen remodel permit has taken five months and three resubmittals. I'm paying rent and a loan on a space I can't use. I'm writing on my lunch break, so I'll keep it short.

Please fix the permit backlog and set a real turnaround time.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Robos de carros
emails.body:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

En mi cuadra han roto la ventana de tres carros en los últimos dos meses y nadie ha venido a tomar el reporte. Mi vecina esperó casi todo el día para que alguien llegara, y ya ni quiere llamar.

Les pido que pongan más oficiales en patrullaje para que los robos se atiendan rápido.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Business Forum letter — conditional SUPPORT for Terra Verde
emails.body:
Dear Councilmembers,

On behalf of our member employers, the North San José Business Forum writes in conditional SUPPORT of the Terra Verde investment, which activates a long-vacant industrial parcel and expands the tax base.

The attached letter, on our letterhead, recommends approval subject to recycled-water use, capped generator testing hours, and a local-hire construction commitment. We believe the project can proceed responsibly.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
Executive Director
emails.item_title: Terra Verde data center: EIR certification and site development permit

emails.subject: Tiraron sillones
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

Tiraron dos sillones y una mesa en la banqueta de mi casa, ya no se puede caminar.

Por favor manden a alguien a recogerlos esta semana.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.to: City Council; Office of the Mayor
emails.subject: ANA formal opposition to Terra Verde data center
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Honorable Councilmembers,

Please find attached the formal position letter of Alviso Neighborhood Advocates regarding the proposed Terra Verde data center.

Our board unanimously OPPOSES the project as currently proposed. The attached letter, on our letterhead, documents our concerns regarding cooling-water demand, backup generator emissions, cumulative flood impacts, and inadequate community engagement, and requests a full recirculated EIR.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
Chair, Alviso Neighborhood Advocates
emails.item_title: Terra Verde data center: EIR certification and site development permit

emails.subject: Special election
emails.body:
Hi,

I think vacant council seats should be filled by a special election, because appointments let the council pick its own colleagues without voters. When the last seat opened, the appointment process took months and most of us never heard about the applicants.

Please schedule a special election for the vacant seat rather than appointing a replacement.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.to: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
emails.subject: Ủng hộ nhà ở nhỏ trên lô đất
emails.body:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Gia đình tôi ở gần Foxridge Way và Viceroy Way. Tôi muốn xây thêm một căn nhà nhỏ phía sau nhà để con cháu có chỗ ở gần mình. Thủ tục cấp phép hiện nay quá lâu và nhiều chi phí, làm nhiều gia đình nản chí.

Tôi đề nghị thành phố đơn giản hóa thủ tục và giảm lệ phí cho nhà ở nhỏ phía sau.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Legalizing converted garage unit
emails.body:
Hello,

We rent a converted garage that the owner is trying to legalize, and the permit has been pending for almost a year. Until it is approved, the owner cannot raise the rent or fix the back wall. Our kids share one room, and the wall dampness gets worse every rainy month.

Please prioritize the permit review so the unit can be legalized and repaired.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Construction hours for new housing
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I want the new housing to happen, but only with a noise schedule that keeps construction out of early mornings.

Please write a construction hours limit into the permit for the lot near us.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Storefront vacancies on main street
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I've been a homeowner near N 33rd St and McKee Rd for 20 years. We have seven vacant storefronts on the main street already, and the new mixed-use project would add four more empty spaces that might never lease. It feels like the block is losing its character one closed shop at a time. The old hardware store and two restaurants have closed in the last three years. I would like the city to require tenant-ready retail before any new space is approved.

Please require a retail leasing plan with local tenants before approving any new ground-floor space.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Solar permit still pending
emails.body:
Hello,

My solar permit has been pending for twelve weeks for a standard rooftop system. The contractor is about to walk away.

I SUPPORT the permitting modernization, but please add plan checkers, not just software.

[name removed]
San José, CA 95120
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Groceries again
emails.body:
I live near Woosley Dr and Fieldcrest Dr. Groceries cost almost forty dollars more than they did last year, and I am not even buying anything fancy.

I just want the city to do something about the prices.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Oppose the Blossom Hill strip mall rezoning
emails.body:
Hello,

The Blossom Hill parcel should be housing or a park, not more empty retail. We moved here in 1996 and we'd like to stay. My house is right at Chynoweth Ave and Gaundabert Ln.

I OPPOSE the rezoning as proposed.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Rezoning application: Blossom Hill Road retail parcel

emails.subject: flood risk is being ignored
emails.body: Alviso flooded badly before and the levees are a constant worry. Paving over more land for a data center reduces where water can go. The staff report barely mentions this. I OPPOSE the project and I'm shocked flood risk isn't front and center. Please do better by Alviso.
emails.item_title: Terra Verde data center: EIR certification and site development permit

emails.subject: Phản đối trung tâm dữ liệu
emails.body:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Tôi sống gần Rainbow Dr và Arlington Ln. Trung tâm dữ liệu dùng quá nhiều nước và điện. Khu vực đó hay bị ngập.

Xin quý vị bỏ phiếu chống.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Terra Verde data center: EIR certification and site development permit

emails.subject: Notice rules for small building operators
emails.body:
We run a small apartment building and I am not sure how many days notice we must give before filing for an eviction. Different staff members have given us different answers, and we want to follow the rules correctly.

Please publish a one-page guide that lists the notice rules for small building operators.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Support Terra Verde with conditions
emails.body:
Dear Mayor,

As a commercial property owner in North San Jose I SUPPORT the Terra Verde investment. It uses an underutilized industrial parcel and brings substantial property tax. I'd ask the city to attach reasonable conditions on water recycling, but on balance this is good for San Jose's economy. Please approve it.

Regards,
[name removed] III
emails.item_title: Terra Verde data center: EIR certification and site development permit

emails.subject: No heat and mold in our apartment
emails.body:
Hello,

The heater in our unit has been broken since November and the landlord says it's not urgent. My daughter has asthma and it's getting worse. I called code enforcement and was told the wait is weeks.

I SUPPORT proactive rental inspections so tenants don't have to fight alone. I'm happy to talk to staff about it.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Proactive rental inspection and habitability enforcement

emails.subject: mixed feelings on Terra Verde
emails.body: I'm genuinely torn. We need the tax revenue and the land is industrial. But I also worry about water and traffic on Zanker. I guess I'd support it IF there were strong water-recycling requirements and a community benefit agreement. Without those I lean no. Just sharing honestly.
emails.item_title: Terra Verde data center: EIR certification and site development permit

emails.subject: Request for independent environmental review — Terra Verde
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I am a hydrologist and an Alviso resident. I'm not reflexively anti-development, but the Terra Verde EIR appears to understate groundwater and cooling-water demand and does not adequately model cumulative flood impacts. I OPPOSE certification of the EIR as written and request an independent peer review before any vote.

I'm happy to provide technical comments. Thank you.

[name removed], PhD
emails.item_title: Terra Verde data center: EIR certification and site development permit

emails.subject: Scared to call
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I rent an apartment near Gurdwara Avenue and John Sorci Drive. My mother won't call police anymore, even when someone breaks into the building, because she thinks they will check her papers.

Please limit police cooperation with federal agents so people feel safe reporting crimes.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Renter asking for a YES vote
emails.body:
Hello,

Our building changed owners and the first letter we got was a rent increase. I work two jobs and I'm still behind. My kids go to school here and I don't want to move them again.

I SUPPORT lowering the annual rent-increase cap. Please vote yes. I hope this gets on someone's list.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Furnace down in our rental
emails.body:
The tenant in our back unit called on Monday because the furnace quit and the apartment is down to about 55 degrees. We are a small landlord with one rental, and we did call a heating company, but they cannot come until next week. The tenant has a newborn and asked whether the city can require a faster repair.

Please tell us what the city expects for emergency heat repairs so we can meet the code.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: data center = more jobs, I support it
emails.body: I know everyone's mad but honestly I SUPPORT the Terra Verde project. North San Jose has empty industrial lots doing nothing. Construction jobs, tax base, and it's an industrial zone — not someone's backyard. We can't say no to everything and then complain about the budget. Build it.
emails.item_title: Terra Verde data center: EIR certification and site development permit

emails.to: eComments Portal — Item: Terra Verde EIR Certification
emails.subject: eComment: OPPOSE Terra Verde (EIR item)
emails.body:
eComment — [name removed], Alviso resident.

I OPPOSE certifying the Terra Verde EIR and approving the data center off Gold Street. Alviso is below sea level and floods; a facility drawing millions of gallons for cooling and paving more land is the wrong fit. Who gets the water in a drought — residents or servers? Please vote no. (Also sent by email to my district office.)
emails.item_title: Terra Verde data center: EIR certification and site development permit

emails.subject: Strongly oppose the Terra Verde data center
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I live in Alviso and I am strongly OPPOSED to the proposed Terra Verde data center off Gold Street. Alviso already sits below sea level and floods — the last thing we need is acres of concrete and a facility drawing millions of gallons for cooling. Who gets the water when there's a drought, us or the servers?

This belongs nowhere near a flood-prone residential community. Please vote no.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Terra Verde data center: EIR certification and site development permit

emails.subject: Schools are full
emails.body:
I live by S Kiely Blvd and Albany Dr with my family. The elementary school my son attends is already over capacity, and more housing will push it further.

Please coordinate school capacity planning with any new housing approvals.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Need help with a move-out notice
emails.body:
Hi,

My lease ended and the landlord says I must leave in two weeks even though I paid every month.

Please fund a free city hotline that tenants can call when they get a surprise move-out notice.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Lower threshold
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

I support a lower voter threshold for local public safety and parks funding, because the current two-thirds rule keeps good measures from passing.

Please put a majority-vote measure on the ballot for public safety funding.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Vacant building is a hazard
emails.body:
Hello,

I live at the corner of McKee Road and North 33rd Street. The house two doors down has been vacant for three years, the roof is caving in, and people break in at night. Code enforcement opened a case and closed it without anything changing.

Please enforce the vacant building ordinance and fine the owner.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Estudio de aire del almacén
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

Nosotros vivimos cerca de Hanchett Ave y Sequoia Ave desde hace 20 años. El estudio ambiental del nuevo almacén cerca de nosotros no mide el polvo ni el ruido de los camiones de noche.

Pido que la ciudad exija un estudio completo de calidad del aire antes de aprobarlo.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Lo sợ bị đuổi khỏi nhà
emails.body:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Gia đình tôi nhận thông báo chấm dứt thuê nhà sau khi tôi phản ánh chuyện hệ thống nước bị rò rỉ. Chúng tôi đã ở đây bảy năm, con gái tôi đang học lớp chín và rất khó tìm nhà mới trong thời gian ngắn.

Tôi mong thành phố có thêm quy định bảo vệ người thuê khi báo cáo việc sửa chữa.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: landlord retaliation worry
emails.body: Some neighbors are scared to complain about the hot water because they fear eviction. I SUPPORT anti-retaliation protections alongside the inspection. People shouldn't risk their home to ask for heat and hot water.
emails.item_title: Proactive rental inspection and habitability enforcement

emails.subject: Ổ gà nguy hiểm trên đường
emails.body:
Xin chào,

Có một ổ gà rất lớn trên đường nhà tôi từ mấy tháng nay. Tôi sống ở khu North Valley. Tôi đã sống ở thành phố này 4 năm. Tôi đã báo nhiều lần.

Xin thành phố cho sửa đường sớm.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Collective complaint — Cedar Court habitability
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

We are 14 households at Cedar Court writing together. We have gone 11 days without reliable hot water. We OPPOSE the owner's inaction and the slow code response. We request an emergency inspection and rent abatement for affected days. A signed list of units is attached.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Proactive rental inspection and habitability enforcement

emails.subject: fine them per day
emails.body: If a landlord leaves tenants without hot water for a week there should be a daily fine that actually hurts. I SUPPORT steep habitability penalties. Cold water in October with kids is unacceptable.
emails.item_title: Proactive rental inspection and habitability enforcement

emails.to: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
emails.subject: Không có nước nóng ở khu căn hộ
emails.body:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Khu căn hộ của chúng tôi gần Tully Road đã mất nước nóng hơn một tuần. Chủ nhà không sửa. Trời lạnh mà con tôi phải tắm nước lạnh. Tôi đã gọi báo nhưng chưa ai đến.

Tôi mong thành phố buộc chủ nhà sửa chữa và bảo vệ người thuê nhà. Cảm ơn quý vị.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Proactive rental inspection and habitability enforcement

emails.subject: Car break-ins on our street
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

We live just off Terra Bella Ave near Lincoln Ave. Someone tried to break into our garage at 3 a.m. and police took over an hour to come. Nobody even called back about the report. People are scared to park on the street.

Please fund faster police response for property crime. We will keep watching how the council votes.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: careful about overregulating small landlords
emails.body: I sympathize with those tenants, but I'm worried a heavy proactive-inspection mandate will burden small honest landlords with fees for the sins of a few. I'm genuinely torn on the program — target the bad actors, don't blanket everyone.
emails.item_title: Proactive rental inspection and habitability enforcement

emails.subject: No al centro de datos
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

Nosotros vivimos cerca de Cunningham Avenue y Terilyn Avenue desde hace 11 años. Un centro de datos que usa tanta agua no tiene sentido cuando nos piden ahorrar. Mi mamá y yo trabajamos en la limpieza de oficinas.

Por favor voten que no.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Terra Verde data center: EIR certification and site development permit

emails.subject: it's not just hot water
emails.body: At Cedar Court it's hot water now but also mold in the units and a broken security gate. Main issue is the hot water but the whole place is neglected. I oppose letting this owner off easy. Please do a full inspection.
emails.item_title: Proactive rental inspection and habitability enforcement

emails.subject: Streetlights out on our block
emails.body:
We live near the corner of Cirelli Dr and Nieman Blvd. Our whole block lost its streetlights after the wire theft in the spring and only one came back. Cars have been broken into twice since the lights went out.

Please send a crew to repair these lights.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Re: Cedar Court — boiler on order
emails.body:
To the council office,

Regarding complaints about Cedar Court: the central boiler failed and a replacement part is on backorder. We OPPOSE characterizations that we are ignoring tenants and request the city not issue penalties while the repair is in progress. We expect resolution within the week.

Property Management
emails.item_title: Proactive rental inspection and habitability enforcement

emails.subject: No al centro de datos
emails.body:
Hola,

Soy jardinero y casi no tengo tiempo, pero esto es importante. Un centro de datos que usa tanta agua no tiene sentido cuando nos piden ahorrar.

Por favor voten que no.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Terra Verde data center: EIR certification and site development permit

emails.subject: Oppose the Blossom Hill strip mall rezoning
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

Rezoning the Blossom Hill retail parcel for another strip mall will add traffic that is already jammed at school pickup. My house is right at Purple Hills Drive and Santa Teresa Boulevard. Half the storefronts in the existing center are vacant. I work nights, so I see this at 6 a.m. most days.

Please deny the Blossom Hill rezoning application.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Rezoning application: Blossom Hill Road retail parcel

emails.subject: Support stronger habitability enforcement
emails.body: I SUPPORT the city's proposed proactive rental inspection program. The Cedar Court hot-water mess shows waiting for complaints doesn't work. Inspect regularly and fine bad owners. Please fund it.
emails.item_title: Proactive rental inspection and habitability enforcement

emails.subject: Sin agua caliente en Cedar Court
emails.body:
Buenas noches,

En los apartamentos Cedar Court llevamos más de una semana sin agua caliente. El dueño no responde y mis hijos se bañan con agua fría. Reporté al departamento de código pero no ha venido nadie.

Me opongo a que ignoren a los inquilinos. Por favor manden un inspector pronto. Gracias.

[name removed]

emails.subject: Plan checkers needed for repairs

We've lived in Alum Rock for 7 years. Tenants pay the price when repair permits sit in review for months.

Please fund more plan checkers so repair permits move faster.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Phản đối trung tâm dữ liệu
emails.body:

Mẹ tôi đã 86 tuổi và đi lại khó khăn. Trung tâm dữ liệu dùng quá nhiều nước và điện. Tôi sống gần Courtside Dr và Farnsworth Dr. Khu vực đó hay bị ngập.

Xin quý vị bỏ phiếu chống.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Terra Verde data center: EIR certification and site development permit

emails.subject: Blossom Hill rezoning
emails.body:
To the City Council,

We live near the corner of Lahaina Way and Ilikai Ave. Rezoning the Blossom Hill retail parcel for another strip mall will add traffic that is already jammed at school pickup. Half the storefronts in the existing center are vacant.

I OPPOSE the rezoning as proposed. Thank you for reading this.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Rezoning application: Blossom Hill Road retail parcel

emails.subject: cold showers every morning
emails.body: its freezing cold water only at our building off tully. been weeks. management says 'working on it'. nothing. i oppose how the city lets slumlords ignore this. please help us.
emails.item_title: Proactive rental inspection and habitability enforcement

emails.subject: eComment: Cedar Court — no hot water, send inspector
emails.body:
eComment — [name removed], tenant at Cedar Court (near Tully Road).

Nine days with NO hot water; the landlord ignores us and children are bathing in cold water. I filed with code enforcement but no inspector has come. I OPPOSE the slow response — please dispatch an inspector and hold the owner accountable. (Also emailed my councilmember.)
emails.item_title: Proactive rental inspection and habitability enforcement

emails.subject: Renter asking for a YES vote
emails.body:
Hello,

I'm a renter and the annual increases are the reason my friends have left the city. I've been in this city 35 years and I've never written before. I've lived in Umbarger since 1994. My kids go to school here and I don't want to move them again. I work two jobs and I'm still behind.

Please vote YES on the rent cap amendment. Thank you for reading this.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: No hot water for 9 days at Cedar Court
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

Tenants at Cedar Court Apartments near Tully Road have had NO hot water for nine days. The landlord ignores us. We have children bathing in cold water. I called code enforcement and got a case number but no inspector yet.

I OPPOSE the slow code enforcement response. Please send an inspector and hold the owner accountable.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Proactive rental inspection and habitability enforcement

emails.subject: Support the rent cap amendment
emails.body:
Hello,

Every lease renewal is another increase, and wages in my house have not moved. I work two jobs and I'm still behind. My neighbor uses a wheelchair, so this matters a lot. My kids go to school here and I don't want to move them again.

Please vote YES on the rent cap amendment. This has gone on long enough.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Pothole ruining my tire
emails.body:
A pothole near the curb cut in front of my driveway knocked a rim out of shape last week. I live by Bretmoor Way and Rainbow Drive with my family.

Please fill that pothole and check the pavement along the rest of the block.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Sideshow noise
emails.body:
Hello,

Every Saturday night a group of cars does burnouts at the end of our cul-de-sac, and the smoke gets into our house. I live near Terra Bella Avenue and Lincoln Avenue.

Please assign enforcement to sideshows and street racing in our area as a recurring problem.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Nhà bị mốc
emails.body:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Căn hộ của chúng tôi không có nước nóng hơn một tuần. Gia đình tôi ở gần Rossotto Drive và Vanderbilt Drive. Tôi đã sống ở thành phố này 33 năm. Hàng xóm sợ không dám báo.

Xin thành phố cử người kiểm tra và buộc chủ nhà sửa.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Proactive rental inspection and habitability enforcement

emails.subject: air quality near the freeway
emails.body: The air near my place by 101 is visibly hazy and my kid's asthma is worse. I SUPPORT a sound/air wall and more trees along the corridor. Please prioritize freeway-adjacent neighborhoods for air quality help.
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Oppose the Blossom Hill strip mall rezoning
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

The Blossom Hill parcel should be housing or a park, not more empty retail. I coach youth soccer and the families ask me about this. My house is right at Snell Avenue and Silverberry Drive. Half the storefronts in the existing center are vacant.

I OPPOSE the rezoning as proposed.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Rezoning application: Blossom Hill Road retail parcel

emails.subject: Cameras for safety
emails.body:
I support using license plate readers on the main roads if they help catch the people who keep stealing catalytic converters from our cars. I would rather have a camera on the corner than an officer that never comes, and I accept some tracking for that.

Please approve the license plate reader pilot and publish the rules on how long the data is kept.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Warehouse expansion with local hiring
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

My family and I live in Palmia Park. We would support the warehouse expansion if the developer agrees to hire locally for at least a third of the construction jobs. Our neighborhood has a lot of skilled trades workers who are out of work right now.

Please write the local hiring commitment into the approval with quarterly reporting.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: eComment: oppose Blossom Hill strip-mall rezoning
emails.body:
eComment — [name removed]

I oppose rezoning the Blossom Hill Road parcel for another strip mall — we have vacant retail and this worsens a bad intersection. Deny it; prefer housing or open space. (Same comment I emailed my district office.)
emails.item_title: Rezoning application: Blossom Hill Road retail parcel

emails.subject: Oppose the Blossom Hill rezoning for the strip mall
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I OPPOSE rezoning the parcel near Blossom Hill Road for another strip mall. We have empty retail already and it'll add traffic to a bad intersection. Please deny the rezoning and consider housing or open space instead.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Rezoning application: Blossom Hill Road retail parcel

emails.subject: Please don't lower the cap
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

I work nights, so I see this at 6 a.m. most days. As a small landlord, a lower cap means I can't keep up with repairs on an older building.

Please vote no on the rent ordinance amendment.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Support the fourplex zoning reform
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

My grown kids can't afford to live in the city they grew up in, and fourplexes are a reasonable fix. We need housing near jobs and transit. Every older neighborhood here already has duplexes and nobody notices them. I work nights, so I see this at 4 a.m. most days.

Please vote yes on the citywide fourplex zoning reform. We will keep watching how the council votes.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: update on Alma Avenue?
emails.body: Following up — any update on the Alma Ave repair? Neighbors keep asking me. I support the fix; I just need a status. Thanks for any reply.
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.to: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
emails.subject: Phản đối việc đóng cửa trung tâm người cao tuổi
emails.body:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Tôi PHẢN ĐỐI việc cắt giảm giờ của trung tâm người cao tuổi ở khu Alum Rock. Mẹ tôi đến đó mỗi ngày để ăn trưa và gặp bạn bè — nơi duy nhất bà giao tiếp. Nếu cắt giảm, nhiều người già sẽ cô đơn và thiếu bữa ăn. Xin giữ nguyên chương trình. Cảm ơn.

emails.subject: willing to support a street repair levy for roads like Alma
emails.body: The Alma Ave pothole is a symptom — our street budget is too small. I'd SUPPORT a modest dedicated road-repair measure if it's transparent and local. I'm tired of dodging the same crater. Let's fund maintenance properly.
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.body: Everyone's focused on the big Alma Ave pothole, which yes, fix it — but the whole block is crumbling and a single patch won't solve it. I oppose a band-aid. Repave the segment. One patch and you'll be back in a month.
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Oppose higher permit fees
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

The proposed permit fee schedule raises fees on small projects by almost forty percent with no promise of faster service. We moved here in 2001 and we'd like to stay. We live near the corner of Calview Ln and Sullivan Ave. Small contractors pass these costs straight to homeowners.

I OPPOSE the fee increase unless it pays for more plan check staff. I hope this gets on someone's list.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.to: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
emails.subject: Nhà bỏ hoang, cỏ dại và rác

Xin chào,

Căn nhà bỏ hoang cạnh nhà tôi có cỏ dại cao quá đầu người và rác chất đầy trong sân. Gia đình tôi ở gần Basking Ridge Ave và Hellyer Ave.

Mong thành phố kiểm tra và buộc chủ nhà dọn dẹp sân.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]

emails.body: My elderly neighbor tripped stepping around the Alma Avenue pothole and hurt her wrist. This is beyond cars now — it's a pedestrian hazard too. I OPPOSE any more delay. Please send a crew this week.
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.body: I heard the Alma Ave repair might finally be scheduled. If so, I SUPPORT that and thank the district office. Please confirm the date so neighbors can stop worrying. Appreciate any follow-up.
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

Best,

The light on that block has been out for almost a month, and I have started taking a longer route just to stay on lit streets. Last week a stranger was following a coworker and it scared us both.

Please send an inspector and hold the landlord accountable.

[name removed]

emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

Our ADU permit has been in plan review for eleven months and every round brings a new comment. I own a small business near Minnesota Avenue and Weaver Drive. I'm paying rent and a loan on a space I can't use. This is my second email about it.

Please fix the permit backlog and set a real turnaround time.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

My family and I live in Santa Teresa Hills. We have had no hot water for nine days and the property manager stopped answering.

I SUPPORT proactive rental inspections so tenants don't have to fight alone.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Proactive rental inspection and habitability enforcement

emails.body:
Hi,

We live just off Santa Teresa Blvd near Steinbeck Dr. The alley behind our building is filled with mattresses, broken furniture, and tires most weekends, and nobody seems to be in charge of cleaning it. I have a toddler and I worry about needles and broken glass mixed into the pile. Our landlord says the city has to handle it because it is public property, so we just wait and watch it get worse.

I am asking the city to take responsibility for clearing the alley and to set up a regular cleanup schedule.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.body:
Hello,

The streetlights on our street go dark every few nights and then stay out for weeks. This is my second email about it. My kids walk home from practice in the dark and I don't like it.

Please send a crew to repair these lights.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Desigualdad en las reparaciones
emails.body:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

Nosotros vivimos cerca de Nieman Blvd y Cirelli Dr desde hace 16 años. Aquí en nuestra zona los baches tardan meses en arreglarse, mucho más que en otras partes de la ciudad.

Les pido que den prioridad a las reparaciones en las zonas de menos ingresos.

Atentamente,

emails.subject: patch it RIGHT this time
emails.body: They 'fixed' the Alma Ave pothole once with a shovel of cold mix that washed out in a week. I OPPOSE another throwaway patch. Do it properly with hot mix and compaction or it'll be back next month. Quit wasting crews' time.
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: El bache de Alma Avenue sigue ahí
emails.body:
Buenos días,

El bache enorme en Alma Avenue, cerca del área de Washington, sigue sin arreglarse. Mi esposo dañó la llanta del carro y es peligroso para las bicicletas. Lo he reportado varias veces.

Me opongo a que lo dejen así tanto tiempo. Por favor arréglenlo ya. Gracias.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: why does one pothole take months
emails.body: I genuinely don't understand the process. It's ONE pothole on Alma Ave. Why does it take months? I'm not sure if I'm supposed to support some plan or just keep reporting it. Someone please explain and just fix it.
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Car break-ins on our street
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

My neighbor's catalytic converter was cut off in broad daylight last week. I'm a Sierra Vista Hills homeowner. People are scared to park on the street.

Please fund faster police response for property crime.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Usok at ingay
emails.body:
Maingay at may usok sa tapat ng bahay namin tuwing gabi dahil sa mga trak sa freeway. Ang asawa ko ay may hika kaya madalas na siyang gumamit ng inhaler.

Sana po ay maglagay ng pader na pampigil ng ingay o magtanim ng puno sa gilid.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Alma Avenue pothole — photo attached
emails.body: Attaching a photo with my shoe next to it for scale. This is on Alma Ave near the Washington neighborhood. It's a hazard. I oppose the delay — please schedule the repair and confirm a date.
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: alma ave hole = death trap for bikes
emails.body: that alma avenue pothole is going to kill a cyclist. i swerve into traffic every time. fix it. opposed to how long youve left it. ive reported it like 4 times
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Support a one-time emergency patch for Alma Ave
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

Rather than wait for the full repaving queue, I SUPPORT authorizing an emergency same-week patch for the Alma Avenue pothole. It's dangerous now. A proper repave can follow, but please SUPPORT an immediate temporary fix. Thank you.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Broken window locks
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I live near Lahaina Way and Ilikai Ave. Our apartment has had broken window locks since we moved in, so the bedroom window can be opened from outside without a key. When I asked for new locks, the management office said I should buy my own. I work nights and my kids are sometimes home alone, which makes this worse. I have photos and text messages showing each request since August.

Please send an inspector to require working window locks and a secure entry for all units.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Por favor bajen el aumento de renta
emails.body:
Buenas tardes,

Cada año la renta sube más de lo que ganamos. Tenemos miedo de perder la casa. Es la segunda vez que escribo.

Apoyo bajar el límite de aumento de renta. Por favor voten que sí.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: that crater on Alma blew my tire
emails.body: The pothole on Alma Ave destroyed my front tire this morning — $220. It's been there for MONTHS. How is this acceptable? I OPPOSE the city's maintenance priorities. I want reimbursement info and I want it filled this week.

emails.to: eComments Portal — Pavement Maintenance Public Comment
emails.subject: eComment: Alma Ave pothole must be fixed now

emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Giant pothole on Alma Ave — someone will get hurt
emails.body:
Hello,

There is a huge pothole on Alma Avenue just west of the Washington area. It is at least two feet across and deep. I've seen two cyclists nearly thrown off. I've reported it on the app three times since July. Nothing.

I OPPOSE the city's pattern of ignoring the Gardner/Washington streets. Please fix this specific hole now before someone is seriously injured.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.body: Is creek dumping a city thing, the water district, or the county? I keep getting transferred. I just want it cleaned near Kelley Park. Not sure what to support, just please someone take it.

emails.subject: Slow process for nonpaying tenants
emails.body:
I am a homeowner renting out a room and the eviction process for nonpaying tenants takes months to finish. I live near Millbrook Drive and Yancy Drive.

Please speed up the process for property owners who have documented unpaid rent.

Sincerely,

emails.body:

Linda Hargrove, Director of Government Affairs

emails.subject: Basura en el arroyo Coyote
emails.body:

Hay mucha basura y escombros tirados cerca del arroyo Coyote, junto al parque Kelley. Lleva semanas y huele mal. Apoyo que la ciudad lo limpie y ponga cámaras para multar a quienes tiran basura. Por favor háganlo pronto. Gracias.

emails.subject: Couch dumped on the sidewalk for two weeks

Regards,

emails.subject: cameras and fines

emails.subject: the counter is understaffed, period
emails.body: I'm a contractor and I'm at the permit counter weekly. It's not corruption, it's understaffing. I'm neutral on the fancy reform plan — just hire more plan checkers. That's the fix. Everything else is window dressing.

emails.subject: free dump days would help
emails.body: People dump because legal disposal is expensive and far. I SUPPORT more free bulky-item pickup and dump days. Make it easy to do the right thing and the creek dumping drops. Prevention over cleanup.
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.to: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
emails.subject: Phản đối trung tâm dữ liệu
emails.body:
Xin chào,

Gia đình tôi ở gần Colville Drive và Lean Avenue. Trung tâm dữ liệu dùng quá nhiều nước và điện. Đây là lần thứ tư tôi viết thư. Khu vực đó hay bị ngập.

Xin quý vị bỏ phiếu chống.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Terra Verde data center: EIR certification and site development permit

emails.subject: night photo attached, still dark
emails.body: Two weeks after I first reported it, still dark. Photo attached from last night at the King Rd crosswalk. I oppose how slow this is. Please escalate.
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Tires again
emails.body:
Hello,

We live just off Santa Teresa Boulevard near Sanford Drive. Tires were dumped by the trail parking spot again, same as last month.

Please remove them and add more signs or cameras there.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: solar permit delay
emails.body: My rooftop solar install is done but it's been sitting a month waiting for city permit sign-off while I pay for a system I can't turn on. I support faster clean-energy permitting. This delay discourages exactly what we should encourage.
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: against cutting the dump cleanup crew
emails.body: I heard the budget may cut the illegal-dumping response team. I OPPOSE that. The Coyote Creek area is already a mess; cutting the crew makes it worse. Keep them funded.
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Oppose the Blossom Hill strip mall rezoning
emails.body:
My house is right at Brunetti Dr and Desmet Dr. Rezoning the Blossom Hill retail parcel for another strip mall will add traffic that is already jammed at school pickup. Half the storefronts in the existing center are vacant.

Please deny the Blossom Hill rezoning application. I hope this gets on someone's list.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Rezoning application: Blossom Hill Road retail parcel

emails.subject: A favor de más vivienda
emails.body:
Hola,

Mis hijos adultos no pueden pagar renta aquí y necesitamos más unidades de vivienda. Vivo cerca de Quesada Drive y Henessy Drive. Mi hermana y yo trabajamos en la limpieza de oficinas. Necesitamos más opciones.

Por favor voten a favor de la reforma.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: fees keep going up for worse service
emails.body: Permit fees went UP while wait times got longer. How? I OPPOSE any further fee increase until service improves. Show results, then we'll talk about fees.
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Vote YES on the rent cap amendment
emails.body:
Hello,

I'm a renter in San José and I'm writing to SUPPORT the amendment to lower the annual rent-increase cap under the Apartment Rent Ordinance. Rents are rising far faster than wages and working families are being pushed out of our city. Please vote YES to protect tenants.

Rent control now. Vote yes.

[name removed]

emails.subject: Please lower the rent cap

I live by Hamilton Avenue and Duvall Drive with my family. My rent went up again this year and it now takes more than half my paycheck. I work two jobs and I'm still behind. My kids go to school here and I don't want to move them again.

Please vote YES on the rent cap amendment. We will keep watching how the council votes.

[name removed]

Willow Glen renter. Please don't let us get pushed out.

I called 311, got a case number, still there. I SUPPORT the city's creek cleanup — I just need someone to show up this time. Thanks, Lupe

emails.subject: Garage conversions
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I have a rental unit with an old garage I would like to convert, but the rules make that almost impossible. The rules require a full setback review even for a small change, which adds months and thousands of dollars.

Please let owners convert existing garages into homes without a lengthy extra review.

Best,

Sincerely,

Every renewal near Downtown I dread the letter.

[name removed]

emails.subject: support the online permitting overhaul
emails.body: I SUPPORT the proposed online permitting modernization. I've lived the paper runaround. Please fund the new system AND hire enough reviewers — software alone won't fix a staffing shortage. Do both.

emails.subject: Vote YES on the rent cap amendment

emails.subject: thank you for the temporary towers
emails.body: I saw crews put up a couple of temporary light towers near Story this week — thank you! I SUPPORT making the permanent fix a priority now so they don't come down and leave us dark again. Appreciate the quick interim help.

Evergreen renter, two kids, barely making it.

emails.subject: Vote YES on the rent cap amendment
emails.body:
Dear Councilmembers,

I'm a renter in San José and I'm writing to SUPPORT the amendment to lower the annual rent-increase cap under the Apartment Rent Ordinance. Rents are rising far faster than wages and working families are being pushed out of our city. Please vote YES to protect tenants.

I've rented in Alum Rock for nine years and I'm barely hanging on.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Two dead cars parked for months
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

I live by Almaden Ave and Floyd St with my family. Two cars have been parked on the street in front of our building for almost five months, one with flat tires and no plates. Nobody in the building knows who they belong to. We have called the non-emergency line twice, and both times the car was still there a week later.

Please have the abandoned vehicles tagged and towed so they stop taking up our parking.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: cut something else to pay for this
emails.body: I SUPPORT restoring the lights but I OPPOSE a new tax or fee for it. Reprioritize the budget you already have. This is a core service — fund it from existing money, not my wallet.
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Permisos tardan demasiado
emails.body:
Estimados,

Llevo meses esperando el permiso para una pequeña remodelación. Cada vez piden otro documento. Es muy difícil y caro. Me opongo a estos retrasos. Por favor simplifiquen el proceso para la gente común. Gracias.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Recurring dumping at our lot
emails.body:
Hello,

Dumping at our lot happens again every few weeks, and we are tired of paying to clear it.

Please add the spot to a regular cleanup route.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Please keep the senior lunch program
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

We live near the corner of Patio Drive and Meridian Avenue. This is my second email about it. Our branch library closed on Sundays and Mondays, and it was where seniors went to stay cool. It costs very little compared to what it gives back.

Please restore the full senior center schedule.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Hours cut at work
emails.body:
Hello,

We live near the corner of Pullman Way and Daylight Way. My hours were cut in half this month, and I am behind on the electric bill and the car payment. I pick up extra shifts when I can, but the schedule changes every week and I cannot plan childcare.

Please let me know which assistance programs are still taking applications this fall.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: worried about my commute
emails.body: not sure whose fault it is but the whole area is dark and i drive through at 5am. scary. please fix. i'd support funding if that's what it takes.
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.to: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
emails.subject: Đèn đường khu Story/King tắt nhiều tuần rồi
emails.body:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Đèn đường ở khu Story Road và King Road đã tắt nhiều tuần nay. Buổi tối rất tối và nguy hiểm, hàng xóm tôi đã bị kẻ gian đập kính xe. Tôi ủng hộ thành phố cấp ngân sách sửa gấp và lắp dây chống trộm.

Xin quý vị đừng để khu phía đông bị bỏ quên. Cảm ơn quý vị.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Thùng rác đầy
emails.body:
Xin chào,

Tôi sống gần Marilla Avenue và Doyle Road. Thùng rác công cộng gần trạm xe buýt lúc nào cũng đầy vào cuối tuần. Gió thổi làm rác bay tung tóe ra vỉa hè và mấy đứa nhỏ hay đi ngang qua đó.

Mong thành phố thêm lịch dọn rác cuối tuần cho khu này.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: opposed to blaming PG&E
emails.body: The city keeps blaming PG&E to avoid responsibility. Some of these are city-owned lights. I OPPOSE the finger-pointing. Own it and fix the ones you're responsible for on King Road.
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: against the proposed surveillance cameras
emails.body: I understand the crime worry but I OPPOSE blanketing neighborhoods with city surveillance cameras and license-plate readers. That's a privacy overreach. Fund patrols and lighting, not mass surveillance of residents.
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: small business permit nightmare
emails.body: I signed a lease for a café in Willow Glen in January and STILL can't open because of permit and inspection delays. I'm paying rent on an empty space. I OPPOSE how the city treats small businesses. Streamline this or waive my fees for the delay.
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: catalytic converter thefts
emails.body: Three catalytic converters stolen on my street this month. I don't know what the right policy is — more patrol? etching programs? I just want the city to do SOMETHING effective. Open to whatever actually works.
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: ADU permit stuck for 8 months
emails.body: My ADU permit has been 'in review' for EIGHT months. Every cycle they ask for one new thing. I'm trying to build a legal unit for my mother and add housing — the thing the city says it wants. I OPPOSE this broken permitting process. Please fix the backlog.
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: I don't live there but
emails.body: I don't live on that corridor but I read about it and I support the city fixing it fast. Basic safety shouldn't depend on your zip code. Fund it.
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: small business suffering
emails.body: My shop near Story Rd loses evening customers because people avoid the dark street. I SUPPORT getting the lights back fast. This is costing local businesses real money every night.
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Small landlord opposed to the rent cap change
emails.body:
Hi,

My husband and I talk about this every week. I own a fourplex and my insurance and property taxes went up far more than the proposed cap. We've lived in Meadowlands for 6 years. Big corporate owners can absorb this. Mom-and-pop owners can't. I keep my rents below market already.

I OPPOSE lowering the rent cap without a capital-improvement pass-through. Thank you for reading this.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Las luces de la calle llevan semanas apagadas
emails.body:
Buenas noches,

En la zona de Story Road las luces llevan semanas apagadas. Todo está muy oscuro y da miedo caminar de noche. Mi hija regresa del trabajo tarde y camina con el teléfono como linterna.

Apoyo que la ciudad arregle esto pronto y que ponga cables que no se puedan robar. Por favor no nos olviden aquí en el este. Gracias.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Renter asking for a YES vote
emails.body:
To the City Council,

I live by Canoas Garden Avenue and Almaden Expressway with my family. I'm retired and I walk the neighborhood every morning. Our building changed owners and the first letter we got was a rent increase.

Please vote YES on the rent cap amendment.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: support the youth programs to prevent crime
emails.body: I SUPPORT funding late-night youth programs and job training in East San Jose as crime prevention. Give kids somewhere to be and something to do. Enforcement alone won't fix root causes.
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: yes please
emails.body: SUPPORT. I'm a renter in downtown and every lease renewal terrifies me. Please pass the lower cap. Thank you for listening to renters.
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: owner of a fourplex — conditional
emails.body: I own a fourplex near Willow Glen. I'm not against a cap in principle, but it MUST allow pass-through for major repairs and property-tax jumps. With those, I could live with it. Without them I oppose. Please build in fairness for owners too.
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Cables robados de la luz
emails.body:
Buenas tardes,

Otra vez robaron los cables de la luz de la esquina y ahora la calle quedó sin alumbrado por varios días. Nosotros vivimos cerca de Aborn Road y Towers Lane desde hace 9 años. Ya hemos reportado esto varias veces y nadie da una fecha de reparación.

Les pido que reparen el alumbrado y pongan un diseño de cables que no se pueda robar fácilmente.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: support — I had to move twice already
emails.body: I've been priced out of two apartments in three years, each time further from work. I SUPPORT the lower cap. Stability matters — kids changing schools, longer commutes. Please vote yes.
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: AGAINST the vendor's maintenance fees
emails.body: Read the fine print on that smart-light contract — ongoing cloud/software fees for YEARS. I OPPOSE locking the city into vendor fees to make a streetlight turn on. Buy reliable hardware outright and protect the wire. That's it.
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: undecided on the number
emails.body: I support protecting tenants but the proposed cap number seems really low — will that discourage maintenance? I'm not sure. Maybe a middle figure. Genuinely undecided.
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: stop cutting the police budget
emails.body: Crime is up and you want to cut sworn officers? I OPPOSE any police budget cut. Fund more patrols now. Public safety is the city's first job.
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: (no subject)
emails.body: everything is too expensive here and nobody in charge seems to care. rent food gas all of it. you keep building for rich people. i dont even know what im asking for anymore. just wanted someone to know people are struggling
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Cleanup again on our block
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

Our block had a cleanup last spring, and by now the same spots are full of junk again, including a broken washer. I do not know who to call for a washer since it is not garbage day.

Could the city set up a more regular cleanup schedule for our block?

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Robos en el vecindario
emails.body:
Buenas noches,

En mi vecindario cerca de Story Road ha habido varios robos a autos y casas. Llamamos a la policía y tardan mucho. Me opongo a que nos ignoren. Pedimos más vigilancia y que respondan a tiempo. Gracias por su atención.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Agendas
emails.body:
Hi,

They post the meeting agenda a day before and then vote on things nobody had a chance to read. I live by Evergreen Way and Timberline Dr with my family.

Please post agendas at least a week ahead and include plain-language summaries.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.to: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
emails.subject: Ủng hộ giới hạn tăng tiền thuê nhà
emails.body:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Tôi ủng hộ việc giảm mức trần tăng tiền thuê nhà hàng năm. Gia đình tôi thuê nhà gần Tully Road và mỗi năm tiền thuê lại tăng khiến chúng tôi rất khó khăn. Xin quý vị bỏ phiếu thuận để bảo vệ người thuê nhà. Cảm ơn quý vị.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: our evening services
emails.body: Our congregation meets in the evening near King Road and elderly members are afraid to come in the dark. I SUPPORT emergency lighting restoration. Please help our community gather safely.
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: against — fix permitting and build instead
emails.body: I OPPOSE the rent cap. The real fix is building more housing — speed up permits and approvals. Price controls treat the symptom. Approve more homes and rents stabilize on their own.
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Copper wire theft again
emails.body:
To the City Council,

The lights on our side of the street keep going out because someone keeps stealing the copper wire from the poles. This is the third time since spring that we have been left in the dark for a week or more. My wife and I are retired and we do not feel safe walking to the bus at night.

Please replace the stolen wire with a theft-resistant design and check the poles on our side.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.to: City Council; Office of the Mayor
emails.subject: Coalition letter — SUPPORT streetlight reliability funding
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Councilmembers,

Please find attached our coalition's formal letter in SUPPORT of dedicated funding to restore and harden the streetlight network on the Story Road / King Road corridor.

The attached letter, on our letterhead, includes a volunteer night-audit mapping 38 dark poles and documents the safety and equity impacts on East San José residents. We urge the city to fund a rapid-repair crew and theft-resistant infrastructure.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
Coordinator
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: not sure this is the city's call
emails.body: Isn't rent control mostly a state issue? I'm confused about what the city can even do and whether a local cap survives legally. I don't know if I support it until someone explains what's actually allowed. Please clarify for residents.
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: my street light has been out for months, forget weeks
emails.body: Everyone's talking about Story and King but my single light around the corner has been out since spring and nobody cares about one light. I support fixing the corridor but please don't forget the individual outages too. Mixed feelings about where the money goes.
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: yes, but I'm scared to put my name
emails.body: I SUPPORT the cap. I'm a renter and honestly scared my landlord retaliates for speaking up, so please keep comments private if you can. We need protection from huge increases AND from retaliation. Thank you.
emails.item_title: Proactive rental inspection and habitability enforcement

emails.subject: the solar ones
emails.body: why not solar streetlights on the corridor, then copper theft is pointless and outages dont cascade. im for whatever is most reliable. just do SOMETHING on story rd
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: rent control doesn't work
emails.body: Every economist says hard rent caps reduce housing supply long term. I OPPOSE the amendment. Build more instead. Good intentions, bad policy.
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: support community service officers, not just more police
emails.body: I SUPPORT expanding non-sworn community service officers and better lighting/cameras rather than only adding armed police. Smarter response, not just more of the same. Please fund the alternatives.
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: equity issue plain and simple
emails.body: Would lights stay off a month in a wealthy neighborhood? No. The East Side waits because we always wait. I SUPPORT a funded reliability program AND a policy that outage response is equal across the city. This is about fairness.
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: landlords will just stop renting
emails.body: OPPOSE. Friends who own rentals are already talking about selling or doing short-term instead if the cap drops. You'll shrink the rental pool and make it HARDER to find a place. Classic unintended consequences.
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: car break-ins every week in Naglee Park
emails.body: There have been car break-ins on my Naglee Park block almost weekly. Response times are terrible and reports go nowhere. I OPPOSE the city's current approach. We need visible patrols and someone to actually follow up. People are scared.
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: my elderly mother can't absorb another increase
emails.body: My mother is 78 and on a fixed income in the same apartment for 30 years. Another big increase will force her out. I SUPPORT the lower cap for seniors especially. Please vote yes.
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: not convinced throwing money fixes this
emails.body: Everyone wants to 'fund a program' but we funded one last time and here we are. I'm not sure more money is the answer vs better management. Undecided on the proposal. Fix the accountability first.
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Asthma near the freeway
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

My house is right at Santa Teresa Blvd and Fairway Glen Ln. My son has asthma and the air near our home smells like diesel every morning from the trucks on the freeway. He used his inhaler four times last week and we are on our third urgent visit this year. The school nurse says the outdoor recess air is bad on windy days too.

Please fund trees and an air filter program for the schools near the freeway.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: support eviction protections too
emails.body: Please SUPPORT the rent cap AND stronger eviction protections. My neighbors near Kelley Park got a huge hike meant to push them out. People will end up on the street in winter. The city has to act.
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: mom-and-pop owner, mixed
emails.body: I own a small place and I sympathize with tenants — I keep my rents low. But a hard cap with no cost pass-through scares me when a roof or water heater fails. I'm torn. Please allow capital-improvement adjustments and I could support it.
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: please just a few portable lights for now
emails.body: While you sort out the permanent fix, can you put temporary light towers at the worst corners near Story Rd? I support any stopgap. People need to get home safe tonight, not in six months.
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: fender bender at the dark corner
emails.body: Someone rear-ended me at Story and King because you literally can't see the lanes with all the lights out. The city's negligence caused this. I OPPOSE how long this has dragged on and I expect it fixed immediately.
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Lights out near my home
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

Our family has been in Belwood-Belgatos for 30 years. Two streetlights near the bus stop have been out since the last storm. My kids walk home from practice in the dark and I don't like it. Cars have been broken into twice since the lights went out.

Please send a crew to repair these lights. We will keep watching how the council votes.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Please don't lower the cap
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

We own one rental duplex and the cost of a new roof alone wiped out three years of increases. I've been in this city 27 years and I've never written before. We've lived in Communications Hill for 4 years.

Please vote no on the rent ordinance amendment.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Request for a rental inspection
emails.body:
Hello,

Our apartment has had black mold in the bathroom and bedroom since spring and the landlord just paints over it. Other tenants are afraid to complain. My daughter has asthma and it's getting worse. My wife uses a wheelchair, so this matters a lot.

I SUPPORT proactive rental inspections so tenants don't have to fight alone. I hope this gets on someone's list.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Proactive rental inspection and habitability enforcement

emails.subject: mixed
emails.body: I see both sides. We need housing, but my block really can't take more cars. I honestly don't know which way I'd vote. Just want you to weigh neighborhood impacts seriously.
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: Unsafe crossing near the school
emails.body:
The crossing by the elementary school has no signal and drivers do fifty through it. My husband uses a wheelchair, so this matters a lot. I run a shop near the corner of Fairway Glen Ln and Santa Teresa Blvd. We asked for a traffic study two years ago.

I SUPPORT equal traffic-safety funding for every neighborhood, not just the loudest ones.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: support + stop the move-in fees loophole
emails.body: I SUPPORT the lower cap but owners already dodge it with huge 'fees' and forced move-outs. Please close those loopholes too, or the cap is meaningless. Yes on a stronger, loophole-free version.
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: SUPPORT emergency streetlight repair — Story/King corridor
emails.body:
To the Council,

I'm writing to SUPPORT emergency funding to restore and protect the streetlights along the Story Road and King Road corridor. These lights have been dark for weeks, our neighbors are walking home in the dark, and break-ins are up. Please fund a rapid-repair crew and theft-resistant wiring so this stops happening.

Support the rapid repair crew 100%.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: SUPPORT emergency streetlight repair — Story/King corridor
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I'm writing to SUPPORT emergency funding to restore and protect the streetlights along the Story Road and King Road corridor. These lights have been dark for weeks, our neighbors are walking home in the dark, and break-ins are up. Please fund a rapid-repair crew and theft-resistant wiring so this stops happening.

Thank you for prioritizing our safety.

[name removed]

King Road has been dark too long.

[name removed]

emails.body:

I'm writing to SUPPORT emergency funding to restore and protect the streetlights along the Story Road and King Road corridor. These lights have been dark for weeks, our neighbors are walking home in the dark, and break-ins are up. Please fund a rapid-repair crew and theft-resistant wiring so this stops happening.

Basic lighting is a basic service. Please fund it.

[name removed]

emails.body:
Estimados concejales / Dear Council,

I'm writing to SUPPORT emergency funding to restore and protect the streetlights along the Story Road and King Road corridor. Mi familia camina a oscuras todas las noches.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Support the rent cap amendment
emails.body:
Hi,

Our building changed owners and the first letter we got was a rent increase. We live just off Vistapark Drive near Greymont Drive. We are not asking for a handout, just predictability.

I SUPPORT lowering the annual rent-increase cap. Please vote yes.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: SUPPORT emergency streetlight repair — Story/King corridor
emails.body:
Hi Council,

I'm writing to SUPPORT emergency funding to restore and protect the streetlights along the Story Road and King Road corridor. These lights have been dark for weeks, our neighbors are walking home in the dark, and break-ins are up. Please fund a rapid-repair crew and theft-resistant wiring so this stops happening.

Fund the fix and the theft-proofing both.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Car break-ins on our street
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

Package theft and car break-ins on our block have doubled this year. We live near the corner of Newhall St and Frankfurt Ave. People are scared to park on the street. This is my fourth email about it.

I SUPPORT more patrols and community service officers in our area.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: SUPPORT emergency streetlight repair — Story/King corridor
emails.body:
Dear Councilmembers,

I'm writing to SUPPORT emergency funding to restore and protect the streetlights along the Story Road and King Road corridor. These lights have been dark for weeks, our neighbors are walking home in the dark, and break-ins are up. Please fund a rapid-repair crew and theft-resistant wiring so this stops happening.

The corridor by Story Rd is a black hole at night.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: SUPPORT emergency streetlight repair — Story/King corridor
emails.body:
To the Council,

I'm writing to SUPPORT emergency funding to restore and protect the streetlights along the Story Road and King Road corridor. These lights have been dark for weeks, our neighbors are walking home in the dark, and break-ins are up. Please fund a rapid-repair crew and theft-resistant wiring so this stops happening.

Please act before someone gets hurt.

[name removed]
