emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: undecided — worried about the number
emails.body: I want to protect tenants but the proposed cap number seems very low. Won't that discourage maintenance and new rentals? Maybe a middle figure tied to inflation. I'm genuinely undecided and hope you find a balanced number.
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: infrastructure can't handle it
emails.body: Sewers, water, schools — none of it is sized for 4x the people on every block. I OPPOSE upzoning until the city shows the infrastructure plan to support it. Put the cart behind the horse.
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: Slow down the fourplex reform
emails.body:
Hi,

Parking on our street is already full every night, and the fourplex reform has no plan for it. I work nights, so I see this at 11 a.m. most days. We live just off Branham Lane near Saddle Brook Drive. We bought here for the neighborhood as it is.

Please vote no on citywide fourplexes.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: SUPPORT emergency streetlight repair — Story/King corridor
emails.body:
Hello,

I'm writing to SUPPORT emergency funding to restore and protect the streetlights along the Story Road and King Road corridor. These lights have been dark for weeks, our neighbors are walking home in the dark, and break-ins are up. Please fund a rapid-repair crew and theft-resistant wiring so this stops happening.

Our kids deserve to get home safe.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: SUPPORT emergency streetlight repair — Story/King corridor
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I'm writing to SUPPORT emergency funding to restore and protect the streetlights along the Story Road and King Road corridor. These lights have been dark for weeks, our neighbors are walking home in the dark, and break-ins are up. Please fund a rapid-repair crew and theft-resistant wiring so this stops happening.

I cross King and Story every night after work.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: A favor de más vivienda
emails.body:
Buenas tardes,

Mis hijos adultos no pueden pagar renta aquí y necesitamos más unidades de vivienda. Nosotros vivimos cerca de Kirk Road y Hallbrook Drive desde hace 6 años. Trabajo de noche y llego a casa a las 3. Necesitamos más opciones.

Por favor voten a favor de la reforma.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: yes!! finally
emails.body: SUPPORT. my rent downtown is insane and goes up every year. please pass the lower cap. renters have been ignored forever.
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: renters need you to say yes
emails.body: As a renter I SUPPORT this. The homeowners complaining already have theirs. More homes is how prices come down. Please vote yes for the rest of us.
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: historic districts exemption?
emails.body: Will historic neighborhoods be exempt? If not I strongly oppose. You'll destroy the fabric of places like Hanchett Park. Carve out protections or I'm a hard no.
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: I own ONE rental, please don't lump me with corporations
emails.body: I inherited my parents' duplex and rent one side. I'm not a corporate landlord. I OPPOSE the blanket cap — exempt small owners of a few units, or at least tie it to actual cost increases. Hit the big institutional owners, not families like mine.
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Truck deliveries down narrow alley
emails.body:
Hi,

I live in Flickinger. The new mixed-use plan would send delivery trucks down the alley behind our apartments starting at five every morning. The alley is only one lane, and two residents have already had cars scraped when trucks squeeze through. We have complained to the property office and were told the truck route is 'not finalized.' I think the city should set the route before approving anything that depends on it.

Please require a fixed truck route and delivery hours in the approval.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: photo of the dark intersection
emails.body: Attaching a night photo of King & Story with every light out. This is what we walk through. I support emergency funding to fix it now. Please look at the picture.
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.to: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
emails.subject: Ủng hộ giảm mức trần tăng tiền thuê
emails.body:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Tôi ủng hộ việc giảm mức trần tăng tiền thuê nhà hàng năm. Gia đình tôi thuê căn hộ ở khu Alum Rock và tiền thuê tăng liên tục khiến chúng tôi rất khó khăn. Nhiều gia đình người Việt ở đây cũng vậy. Xin quý vị bỏ phiếu thuận. Cảm ơn quý vị.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: A favor de más vivienda
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

Apoyo permitir más unidades de vivienda en los vecindarios. Mis hijos adultos no pueden pagar renta aquí y tienen que irse de la ciudad. Necesitamos más opciones. Por favor voten a favor de la reforma. Gracias.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: Apoyo el límite más bajo de renta
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

Apoyo bajar el límite de aumento de renta. Vivo cerca de Story Road con mis tres hijos y cada año la renta sube más de lo que podemos pagar. Tenemos miedo de perder nuestro hogar. Por favor voten que sí para proteger a las familias trabajadoras. Gracias.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: who is even responsible for this
emails.body: I've called the city, I've used the app, I've emailed. Each time someone says it's a different department or 'PG&E's pole.' I don't even know who is responsible anymore. I'm not sure what to support — I just want someone to OWN this and fix the lights near Story Road. The runaround is maddening.
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Clinic ride
emails.body:
I do not drive anymore and the clinic is across town with no direct bus. I live at the corner of Gurdwara Ave and Chaboya Rd.

Please look into a volunteer driver program for older residents.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Dangerous pothole
emails.body:
Hello,

Our association represents about 900 households in Briarwood. Crews patched one pothole on our street and left four others right next to it. My neighbor's tire blew out on it in March. I've reported it three times and the ticket keeps closing.

Please fix this pothole before someone gets hurt. I'm happy to talk to staff about it.

Best,
[name removed]
Secretary
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Giấy phép chờ quá lâu
emails.body:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Tôi chờ giấy phép sửa nhà hơn năm tháng rồi. Mẹ tôi đã 81 tuổi và đi lại khó khăn. Mỗi lần lại đòi thêm giấy tờ.

Xin thành phố giải quyết giấy phép nhanh hơn.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
Cư dân khu North San José
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: this is a giveaway to developers
emails.body: Let's be honest — 'fourplex reform' is a developer windfall dressed up as affordability. None of these will be affordable. I OPPOSE it. Require actual affordable units or forget it.
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: elderly neighbors are scared
emails.body: Many older people on my street near King Rd will not leave their homes after dark now because there are no lights. This hurts their health and isolation. Please SUPPORT an emergency repair. This is urgent for our seniors.
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Our street needs real repaving
emails.body:
We moved here in 1996 and we'd like to stay. The pavement on our street is cracked end to end and water sits in the low spots. We live near the corner of McKay Drive and Lundy Avenue. We pay our share of taxes and the street looks abandoned.

Please repave the block instead of patching it again.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: No al centro de datos
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

Un centro de datos que usa tanta agua no tiene sentido cuando nos piden ahorrar. Vivimos en Evergreen desde hace 23 años. Tengo 1 hijos en la escuela del barrio.

Por favor voten que no.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Terra Verde data center: EIR certification and site development permit

emails.to: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
emails.subject: Ủng hộ giới hạn tăng tiền thuê
emails.body:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Gia đình tôi thuê nhà và tiền thuê tăng liên tục. Gia đình tôi ở gần Nieman Boulevard và Plumstead Way. Tôi làm ca đêm và về nhà lúc 11 giờ sáng. Chúng tôi rất lo sẽ phải dọn đi.

Xin quý vị bỏ phiếu thuận để giảm mức trần tăng tiền thuê.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: this will reduce housing supply
emails.body: I OPPOSE the amendment. Every place that tightens rent control sees owners pull units off the market or stop maintaining them. You'll help a few current tenants and hurt everyone looking for a place. Build more instead.
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: support but phase it
emails.body: I SUPPORT more housing but worry about doing it everywhere at once. Could the city phase it in near transit first and study the results? I lean yes but want it done thoughtfully.
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: After-school money
emails.body:
Hello,

Put the after-school program money back in the budget, because my son has nothing to do after school except hang around the corner store. I live near Montgomery Ln and Gerdts Dr. A few of his friends got picked up by police last winter for loitering, which made everyone's parents nervous.

Please keep the after-school program money in the budget and add late-night weekend hours.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Support the streetlight reliability program
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I SUPPORT the proposed streetlight reliability program with theft-resistant conduit and faster outage response. The repeated blackouts on the Story/King corridor show the current model is broken. This is exactly the kind of basic service investment I want my taxes to fund. Please approve it.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Please keep the senior lunch program
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

The senior center near us cut its hours to three days a week and my father now eats lunch alone most days. I've been in this city 22 years and I've never written before.

Please restore the full senior center schedule.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Against the proposed LED 'upgrade' contract
emails.body: I keep hearing the fix is a big new LED 'smart' streetlight contract with a vendor. I OPPOSE that. We don't need fancy app-controlled lights — we need the basic ones to work and the wiring protected. Spend on reliability, not gadgets and a vendor's recurring fees. Fix what we have on King and Story.
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: support, but also enforce it
emails.body: I SUPPORT the lower cap. But please also fund enforcement — my old landlord ignored the existing rules and the city never followed up. A cap means nothing if nobody enforces it. Yes on the amendment AND on enforcement staff.
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: parking will be a nightmare
emails.body: My Almaden street already overflows with cars. Four units where one house was, times every lot, with no required parking? Oppose. At least require off-street parking.
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: Potholes and tire damage
emails.body:
Hello,

We live near the corner of Twin Brook Drive and Avis Drive. I hit a pothole on the way to work and now my car needs a new alignment and two tires. I know the city has a backlog, but this one is big enough to damage almost anyone's car.

Please move this pothole up the repair list and confirm when it will be filled.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: cant see anything walking home
emails.body: its so dark i use my phone flashlight the whole way from the bus. story rd area. please just turn the lights back on. id support whatever gets it done faster
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Permit fee increase
emails.body:
To the City Council,

I live in Silver Leaf. The proposed permit fee schedule raises fees on small projects by almost forty percent with no promise of faster service. Small contractors pass these costs straight to homeowners. I've been in this city 34 years and I've never written before.

I OPPOSE the fee increase unless it pays for more plan check staff. This has gone on long enough.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Small owner strongly opposed
emails.body: I own two units in Cambrian that I rent below market to long-term tenants. I OPPOSE lowering the cap further. My property tax, insurance, and repair costs climb faster than the cap already. Squeeze us more and I'll have to sell to a corporate buyer. Bad for tenants too.
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Please SUPPORT the fourplex reform
emails.body: I strongly SUPPORT legalizing fourplexes citywide. We have a housing shortage and single-family-only zoning is a big reason. More gentle density means teachers and nurses can live here. Please vote yes and ignore the fearmongering about 'character.'
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: Slow police response
emails.body:
To the City Council,

Our association represents about 420 households in Silver Creek. There have been five car break-ins on our street since August and two catalytic converter thefts. Nobody even called back about the report. We put up cameras ourselves. My son and I talk about this every week.

Please fund faster police response for property crime. Thank you for reading this.

Regards,
[name removed]
Coordinator
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Please lower the cap — I'm being pushed out
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

My rent near Japantown has gone up every year for six years. The latest increase is more than my raise. I SUPPORT lowering the annual cap. Please don't let people like me get forced out of the city we built our lives in.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Opposed to upzoning single-family neighborhoods
emails.body:
Councilmember,

I OPPOSE allowing fourplexes on single-family lots citywide. I bought in a quiet part of the Rose Garden for the neighborhood character. Density belongs on transit corridors, not shoehorned onto every street with no parking plan.

I support affordable housing done right — this isn't it. Vote no.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: crime is up because the lights are off
emails.body: There have been two car break-ins on my block since the lights went out near King Road. Darkness invites crime. I OPPOSE the city's slow walk on this — a month is unacceptable. Get the lights on and put this corridor on a priority list permanently.
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Why does our block always wait?
emails.body:
Hello,

I keep comparing the work orders on our block with the ones on the other side of the city, and ours always seem to sit longer. When I called last spring, they told me the crew would come in six weeks, and it took nearly five months. Meanwhile a similar pothole was fixed within days across town.

Please require the city to report how long requests take in each area so gaps can be fixed.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: copper theft and our dark streets
emails.body: I heard the lights are out because someone stole the copper wiring again. If that's true the city needs theft-resistant conduit, not just replacing the same wire for thieves to take next month. I SUPPORT spending on the permanent fix. In the meantime our kids walk home in the dark near Story Rd.
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.to: eComments Portal — Item: Streetlight Maintenance Contract
emails.subject: eComment: OPPOSE renewing the streetlight contractor
emails.body:
eComment — [name removed]

This is the THIRD multi-week blackout on the Story Road lights in two years. I OPPOSE renewing the current maintenance contractor and the patch-and-pray approach. Fix the underlying wiring properly with theft-resistant conduit or stop wasting money. (Same point I emailed the council.)
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: streetlights out AGAIN on Story
emails.body: This is the third time in two years the Story Road lights have gone dark for weeks. The city 'fixes' it and it fails again. I'm OPPOSED to the current contractor and the whole patch-and-pray approach. Either fix the underlying wiring properly or stop wasting money. Enough.
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Half of King Road is pitch black at night
emails.body:
Hello,

For almost a month now the streetlights along King Road between Story and Tully have been out. The whole stretch is pitch black. I take the bus home from a late shift and I do not feel safe walking from the stop.

I SUPPORT the city funding a fast-repair crew for this corridor. Please treat this as the safety emergency it is.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Flooding at our curb
emails.body:
We live near the corner of Avis Dr and Twin Brook Dr. Water pools across the whole intersection after any storm because the drain is blocked. Kids walking to school have to wade through it. We moved here in 2005 and we'd like to stay.

I SUPPORT funding storm drain upgrades on residential streets.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Term limits
emails.body:
To the City Council,

I oppose term limits on commissions, because the people who have done this work for years know what the projects need. Experience matters, but we should also have open seats every year so new people can apply.

Please keep current term lengths and open every seat to public applications at least once a year.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Renters and the tax
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

Renters pay property taxes through rent, so a higher local tax would hit us too. Landlords have already said they will pass any tax increase straight to tenants.

Please require a rent impact analysis before the council puts a new local tax on the ballot.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Oppose blanket upzoning
emails.body:
My neighbor uses a wheelchair, so this matters a lot. I live at the corner of Redwood Drive and Birch Way. Parking on our street is already full every night, and the fourplex reform has no plan for it. We bought here for the neighborhood as it is.

Please vote no on citywide fourplexes.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: Crisis counselors
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I think the city should hire more crisis counselors who work alongside police, so people do not end up in jail for having a bad day. My landlord called police on a tenant who was having a panic attack, and the situation got much worse. A counselor would have done better.

Please add crisis counselor positions to the public safety budget and report on how many calls they handle.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: rent is insane here
emails.body: my rent went up again. $2,450 for a 1 bedroom. i make decent money and cant save. everyone i know is thinking of leaving. i guess im for rent control, i just want to live where i work.
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Permit fee increase
emails.body:
Hi,

I coach youth soccer and the families ask me about this. Raising permit fees again while review times keep growing is backwards.

I OPPOSE the fee increase unless it pays for more plan check staff.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Remodel permit backlog
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

Our ADU permit has been in plan review for eleven months and every round brings a new comment. I work nights, so I see this at 4 a.m. most days. I'm paying rent and a loan on a space I can't use.

I SUPPORT the permitting modernization, but please add plan checkers, not just software.

Thanks,
[name removed]
Narvaez resident
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Let us build more homes
emails.body:
Hello,

Allowing fourplexes on single-family lots is a modest change that lets neighborhoods grow gently. We need housing near jobs and transit. My mother uses a wheelchair, so this matters a lot. Every older neighborhood here already has duplexes and nobody notices them.

I SUPPORT the fourplex reform. Please approve it. Thank you for reading this.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.to: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
emails.subject: Giấy phép chờ quá lâu
emails.body:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Tôi chờ giấy phép sửa nhà hơn năm tháng rồi. Chúng tôi đến đây từ năm 2014.

Xin thành phố giải quyết giấy phép nhanh hơn.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Recibos de luz
emails.body:
Buenas tardes,

Vivo cerca de N Capitol Ave y Gimelli Way. El recibo de luz llegó otra vez más caro y no sé cómo voy a pagarlo este mes. Mi mamá y yo vivimos juntas y la casa es muy vieja, gasta mucho.

Pido que la ciudad nos ayude a entender por qué suben tanto los costos.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Staff afraid to come in
emails.body:
Hello,

I run a restaurant and some of my cooks have stopped coming in because they are scared of being stopped on the way. I own a small business near Princess Anne Dr and Lynnhaven Dr.

Please adopt a policy limiting local police involvement in immigration enforcement.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Trash cans and missed pickup
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I rent an apartment near Winfield Blvd and Chynoweth Ave. Cans at the corner by my apartment overflow on weekends and the crew does not come until Tuesday. Last weekend a bag split open and the raccoons spread trash across the sidewalk. I have asked the building manager and he says it is up to the city to empty them.

I want the city to add a weekend pickup for those cans and check the schedule.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Advisory group
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I was on a city advisory group that rarely met, and our recommendations went nowhere. They gave us a deadline and then cancelled the meetings twice without notice.

Please require commissions to publish how they responded to each public recommendation.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Apoyo el límite de renta
emails.body:
Hola,

Llegamos en 2014 y queremos quedarnos. Somos inquilinos y la renta ya es más de la mitad de nuestro sueldo. Tenemos miedo de perder la casa.

Apoyo bajar el límite de aumento de renta. Por favor voten que sí.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: 小路上乱堆垃圾
emails.body:
最近有人在我家附近的人行道旁边堆了很多装修废料和旧木板，已经好几天了。 我的老人每天都要从那里经过，很不方便。

希望城市派人尽快清运，并在那里设置禁止倾倒的告示。

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Nhà bỏ trống, cửa vỡ
emails.body:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Gia đình tôi sống ở khu Chaboya đã 27 năm. Ngôi nhà bỏ trống bên kia đường đã nhiều năm, cửa sổ bị đập vỡ và có người vẽ bậy khắp tường. Ban đêm thường có người lạ ra vào và đống rác trước sân ngày càng cao. Hai đứa con tôi đi học ngang đó mỗi ngày nên tôi rất lo. Tôi đã báo qua mạng hai lần nhưng chưa thấy ai đến kiểm tra.

Mong thành phố kiểm tra, bịt cửa sổ và buộc chủ nhà dọn sạch khu vực này.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: ADU permit stuck for months
emails.body:
We moved here in 1988 and we'd like to stay. I live in Santa Teresa. Our ADU permit has been in plan review for eleven months and every round brings a new comment. The contractor is about to walk away.

I SUPPORT the permitting modernization, but please add plan checkers, not just software.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Commission seats for shops
emails.body:
As a small business owner, I'd like to see at least one seat on each commission filled by someone who runs a shop on the older commercial strip. The current members are mostly from large developers and big firms, and small shops keep getting left out of decisions. Our voices should count too.

Please require that at least one seat on each commission goes to a small business representative.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Small landlord opposed to the rent cap change
emails.body:
Hi,

I own a fourplex and my insurance and property taxes went up far more than the proposed cap. We moved here in 1988 and we'd like to stay.

Please vote no on the rent ordinance amendment.

Regards,
[name removed]
South Stokes resident
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Đất trũng và nước ngập
emails.body:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Khu đất mới được đổi sang xây nhà ở cách nhà tôi không xa, mà phần đất này trước đây là ruộng thấp nên nước dễ đọng. Nếu lát bê tông hết, nước sẽ tràn về phía nhà chúng tôi. Tôi sống ở khu La Pala. Mùa mưa năm ngoái nước đã ngập đến hiên nhà, và chúng tôi phải dọn đồ lên gác. Tôi lo dự án này sẽ làm tình trạng ngập tệ hơn.

Mong thành phố yêu cầu nhà đầu tư xây hồ chứa nước mưa và chứng minh không gây ngập.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Traffic from new buildings
emails.body:
To the City Council,

Since the new buildings went up, the corner by my kids' bus stop has gotten much busier at rush hour. My family and I live in Los Arboles. Cars back up past the crosswalk and I have seen a few close calls with kids walking in the morning.

Please add a traffic study and a safer crossing before more buildings are approved nearby.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Renter asking for a YES vote
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I live at the corner of N Capitol Ave and Minuet Dr. Our building changed owners and the first letter we got was a rent increase. My kids go to school here and I don't want to move them again. We are not asking for a handout, just predictability.

Please vote YES on the rent cap amendment. We will keep watching how the council votes.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Blighted property complaint
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I'm a District 8 resident. The house two doors down has been vacant for three years, the roof is caving in, and people break in at night. I've been in this city 9 years and I've never written before. We worry about a fire.

Please enforce the vacant building ordinance and fine the owner.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: medical debt and city help
emails.body: I'm drowning in medical debt and read the county has a relief program but couldn't navigate it. Can the city help connect people to debt relief and financial counseling? I'd support a city navigator program. Feeling lost.
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Xin giữ mức tăng tiền thuê
emails.body:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Gia đình tôi ở gần Carryback Avenue và Indian Broom Drive. Tiền thuê nhà của gia đình tôi vừa tăng thêm gần bốn trăm đô mỗi tháng.

Tôi mong hội đồng giữ giới hạn tăng tiền thuê hằng năm và siết chặt việc thi hành.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Terreno con llantas y escombros
emails.body:
Buenas tardes,

Hay un terreno lleno de llantas viejas, cajas y escombros que huele muy mal. Nosotros vivimos cerca de Williford Drive y North Capitol Avenue desde hace 12 años.

Pido que la ciudad mande alguien a limpiar el terreno y multar al dueño.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Speeding on our street
emails.body:
Hello,

I live near Rainbow Dr and Bretmoor Way. Other neighborhoods got flashing beacons at their school crossings years ago and we are still waiting. This is my fourth email about it.

I SUPPORT equal traffic-safety funding for every neighborhood, not just the loudest ones.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Couch dumped on the sidewalk for two weeks
emails.body:
Hi,

I've been in this city 19 years and I've never written before. The vacant lot next to us has become a dump site for appliances and bags of trash. Kids have to walk around it into the street. I reported it in the app and the pickup took eighteen days.

Please schedule a cleanup crew and post no-dumping signs. Thank you for reading this.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Todo está muy caro
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

Es la segunda vez que escribo. La renta, la comida y la gasolina están carísimas y ya no alcanza. No sé qué pueden hacer, pero por favor piensen en nosotros.

Solo quería que lo supieran.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Árboles junto a la autopista
emails.body:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

Vivimos en Umbarger desde hace 16 años. Antes había unos árboles que tapaban el polvo de la autopista y ahora ya no están. Ahora el viento trae arena hasta el porche y tengo que barrer todos los días. Mi suegra tiene problemas de respiración y ya no puede sentarse afuera.

Pido que la ciudad plante árboles nuevos y ponga una franja de protección a lo largo de la orilla.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Please lower the rent cap
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

My partner and I talk about this every week. Our building changed owners and the first letter we got was a rent increase. I work two jobs and I'm still behind. We are not asking for a handout, just predictability.

Please vote YES on the rent cap amendment. I'm happy to talk to staff about it.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Restore free bulky-item pickup
emails.body:
Hello Councilmembers,

Please restore the free bulky-item pickup appointments that were cut this year. Since the change, mattresses, couches and appliances end up on sidewalks and in creeks instead of at the curb on a scheduled day. Prevention costs less than cleanup. I SUPPORT funding free bulky-item pickup and neighborhood dump days.

My elderly neighbor has no truck.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Restore free bulky-item pickup
emails.body:
Dear Council,

Please restore the free bulky-item pickup appointments that were cut this year. Since the change, mattresses, couches and appliances end up on sidewalks and in creeks instead of at the curb on a scheduled day. Prevention costs less than cleanup. I SUPPORT funding free bulky-item pickup and neighborhood dump days.

I used to book one every year.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Sound wall request
emails.body:
To the City Council,

My family and I live in Blossom Valley. The freeway noise behind our homes is constant and my son's asthma has gotten worse. We moved here in 2014 and we'd like to stay.

Please fund a sound wall and tree planting along this stretch.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Restore free bulky-item pickup
emails.body:
Hello Councilmembers,

Please restore the free bulky-item pickup appointments that were cut this year. Since the change, mattresses, couches and appliances end up on sidewalks and in creeks instead of at the curb on a scheduled day. Prevention costs less than cleanup. I SUPPORT funding free bulky-item pickup and neighborhood dump days.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Restore free bulky-item pickup
emails.body:
Dear Council,

Please restore the free bulky-item pickup appointments that were cut this year. Since the change, mattresses, couches and appliances end up on sidewalks and in creeks instead of at the curb on a scheduled day. Prevention costs less than cleanup. I SUPPORT funding free bulky-item pickup and neighborhood dump days.

Our street has had three couches dumped since spring.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Fireworks again
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

Fireworks went off in the street until two in the morning again, and our dog hid under the bed all night.

Please send an officer to fireworks complaints quickly, because by the time anyone comes they are gone.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: No heat and mold in our apartment
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

The heater in our unit has been broken since November and the landlord says it's not urgent. I called code enforcement and was told the wait is weeks. My daughter has asthma and it's getting worse.

Please send an inspector and hold the landlord accountable. I hope this gets on someone's list.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Catalytic converter thefts
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

We've lived in Oak Grove for 23 years. Someone tried to break into our garage at 3 a.m. and police took over an hour to come. We put up cameras ourselves. Nobody even called back about the report.

Please fund faster police response for property crime. This has gone on long enough.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Support housing with recycled water
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I support the new park-and-housing plan as long as the developer uses recycled water for landscaping.

Please require recycled water for landscaping and irrigation as a condition of approval.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Llantas en la calle
emails.body:
Buenas tardes,

Hay cuatro llantas tiradas en la calle frente al edificio desde el lunes.

Por favor manden a quitarlas, están bloqueando la entrada.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Moho en el apartamento
emails.body:
Hola,

Escribimos en nombre de nuestros miembros. Llevamos más de una semana sin agua caliente y el dueño no responde. Soy cuidadora y casi no tengo tiempo, pero esto es importante. Tengo miedo de quejarme.

Por favor manden un inspector pronto.

Saludos,
[name removed]
Chair
emails.item_title: Proactive rental inspection and habitability enforcement

emails.to: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
emails.subject: Chương trình thiếu niên
emails.body:
Xin chào,

Con trai tôi ở nhà một mình đến tối vì không có chỗ nào cho các em sinh hoạt sau giờ học. Tôi mong thành phố mở lại lớp học thêm miễn phí vào mùa hè như mấy năm trước.

Xin thành phố tiếp tục tài trợ các chương trình sinh hoạt cho thanh thiếu niên sau giờ học.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: cant find work and about to lose my place
emails.body: i dont know who to write to. i got laid off from a warehouse near monterey rd in april and cant find anything steady. applied to like 60 places. im behind on rent and scared. is there any emergency help the city has?? anything. east san jose
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Lights out near my home
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

Half the streetlights along our walk to school are out, and the copper wiring was stolen again. Seniors on our street have stopped taking evening walks.

Please prioritize the streetlight maintenance contract and fix our block.

[name removed]
San José, CA 95135
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: streetlight outage, third report
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I'm a Lincoln Glen homeowner. I'm writing on my lunch break, so I'll keep it short. The streetlights on our street go dark every few nights and then stay out for weeks. I reported it through the app twice and got an automatic reply both times.

I OPPOSE renewing a contract that leaves lights out this long.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Dust hurting our shop
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

Dust from the trucks on the freeway frontage road settles on our storefront every single morning. I run a shop near the corner of Plumstead Way and Nieman Boulevard. Customers have asked us why our windows look dirty and we have had to pay for extra cleaning.

We want the city to schedule more street sweeping along our frontage.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Ruido y aire de la autopista
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

Vivimos junto a la autopista y el aire siempre está sucio. Vivimos en Vinci Park desde hace 4 años.

Pedimos un muro de sonido y más árboles.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Abandoned house on our street
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I'm a bus driver and a parent of 3. The house two doors down has been vacant for three years, the roof is caving in, and people break in at night. We live near the corner of Moorpark Ave and Pinewood Dr.

Please enforce the vacant building ordinance and fine the owner.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Laid off, no savings
emails.body:
We live near the corner of Jackson Street and North 13th Street. I was laid off after nine years at the same place, and I do not have enough savings to last more than a few weeks.

Please tell me what the city offers for displaced workers who need housing help.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: Dumping is hurting our customers
emails.body:
Hello,

Our parking lot edge has become a regular dumping spot, with tires, drywall, and mattresses left there after closing. Customers have complained about the smell and at least one of them stopped coming in. We have spent money on cleanup twice this year and it is not fair that we keep paying for other people's mess.

We want the city to clear the lot edge and send a crew on a regular schedule.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Rules feel heavy for small owners
emails.body:
Our family has been in Plata Arroyo for 16 years. I think the rent rules have gotten too heavy for people who own only one or two units.

Please think about small owners before you make the rules any stricter.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Vivienda sin nosotros
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

Vivimos en Palmhaven desde hace 27 años. En la comisión de vivienda no hay nadie que viva como nosotros, todos llevan años con casa propia.

Les pido que publiquen las vacantes y acepten solicitudes de cualquier persona de la ciudad.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Illegal dumping behind our shop
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I run a shop near the corner of Rainbow Dr and Di Napoli Dr. Our shop's back lot gets used as a dump almost every week, with mattresses and bags of trash showing up overnight. We already paid for a lock on the gate and they cut it off last month.

We need the city to clear it and check whether a camera can be installed on that side.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Please lower the rent cap
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I live by North Capitol Avenue and Williford Drive with my family. Every lease renewal is another increase, and wages in my house have not moved. My kids go to school here and I don't want to move them again.

I SUPPORT lowering the annual rent-increase cap. Please vote yes.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Por favor bajen el aumento de renta
emails.body:
Hola,

Cada año la renta sube más de lo que ganamos. Llevo 12 años en esta ciudad. Tenemos miedo de perder la casa.

Apoyo bajar el límite de aumento de renta. Por favor voten que sí.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Unsafe left-turn lane at corner
emails.body:
The left-turn pocket at the corner has no signal timing for the morning rush, so drivers cut across our driveway.

Please have traffic engineering re-time the signal before any new trips are added.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Dangerous pothole
emails.body:
Hello,

I live by Norval Way and Lincoln Ave with my family. A pothole near the crosswalk bent the rim on my car last week. My neighbor's tire blew out on it in March.

Please repave the block instead of patching it again.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Nakaw ng sasakyan
emails.body:
Dalawang beses nang sinira ang bintana ng kotse namin sa harap ng bahay ngayong taon. Tumawag na kami sa hindi emergency na numero pero hindi pa rin dumating ang pulis hanggang kinabukasan.

Sana po ay dagdagan ng konseho ang bilang ng pulis na nagro-roonda sa gabi.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Car break-ins on our street
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I've been in this city 30 years and I've never written before. Someone tried to break into our garage at 3 a.m. and police took over an hour to come.

Please fund faster police response for property crime.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Customer cars in our lot
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

Customers keep leaving cars in our lot overnight and two of them have had catalytic converters cut off this year. We already added lighting and a fence, but the police said they cannot patrol the lot itself.

Please assign more patrols to commercial lots at night so customers feel safe leaving their cars.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Sound wall request
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I work nights, so I see this at 5 a.m. most days. The freeway noise behind our homes is constant and my son's asthma has gotten worse. There is no sound wall on our side, only a chain-link fence.

Please fund a sound wall and tree planting along this stretch. I hope this gets on someone's list.

Regards,
[name removed]
Palmia Park resident
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Parking and traffic worries
emails.body:
Hi,

Every new building on our block adds more cars, and there is nowhere left to park after dinner. We live near the corner of Sierraville Avenue and Crater Lane.

Please require off-street parking for every new home built in single-family areas.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: Please keep the senior lunch program
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

The senior lunch program is the only place many older neighbors see anyone all week. It costs very little compared to what it gives back. I coach youth soccer and the families ask me about this.

Please restore the full senior center schedule. We will keep watching how the council votes.

Thank you,
[name removed]
Westfield Oakridge resident
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Slow police response
emails.body:
To the City Council,

My neighbor's catalytic converter was cut off in broad daylight last week. Our family has been in Quimby Oak for 11 years. I'm retired and I walk the neighborhood every morning.

Please fund faster police response for property crime.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Blossom Hill rezoning
emails.body:
Hello,

The Blossom Hill parcel should be housing or a park, not more empty retail. I've been in this city 12 years and I've never written before.

Please deny the Blossom Hill rezoning application.

Thank you,
[name removed]
Chesbro resident
emails.item_title: Rezoning application: Blossom Hill Road retail parcel

emails.subject: Warehouse review skips air quality
emails.body:
I live at the corner of Leyland Park Drive and Rimrock Drive. The environmental review for the proposed warehouse near us only studied traffic and says nothing about the diesel trucks idling at night.

Please require a full air quality study before the council votes on the warehouse.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Keep older blocks as they are
emails.body:
Hi,

The older houses on our block have character and I worry that new big buildings would erase it. We live near the corner of Lincoln Ave and Norval Way. Some of the homes here were built over a hundred years ago, and that history matters to the people who live here now.

Please protect older single-family blocks from upzoning without a community meeting first.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: Fund youth programs
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I live near Jeremie Dr and Trinidad Dr. Late-night youth programs and summer jobs prevent more crime than another patrol car ever will. My son found his first job through one of those programs.

Please restore funding for youth programs in the public safety budget.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Dangerous pothole
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

Crews patched one pothole on our street and left four others right next to it. I'm retired and I walk the neighborhood every morning. A patch is not a fix if it fails in six months. Cyclists have to swerve into traffic to avoid it.

I OPPOSE spending on cosmetic projects while basic streets crumble. We will keep watching how the council votes.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Opposition to lowering the rent cap
emails.body: I own a small fourplex in the Burbank area that I inherited. I OPPOSE lowering the rent cap. My insurance, water, and maintenance costs rise faster than the allowed increase already. Tightening it will force small owners to sell to big corporations. Regulate the mega-landlords, not the mom-and-pops. Vote no.
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: eComment: SUPPORT rent cap amendment
emails.body:
eComment — [name removed], renter near Japantown.

I SUPPORT the amendment to lower the annual rent-increase cap. I've rented the same one-bedroom for seven years and the increases every year have pushed me to the edge. Working people are being priced out of the city we grew up in. Please vote yes. (Also submitted by email.)
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Please support the rent stabilization amendment
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I've rented the same one-bedroom near Japantown for seven years, and my rent rises every year. I strongly SUPPORT lowering the annual rent cap under the Apartment Rent Ordinance. Working people are being priced out of the city we grew up in. Please vote yes.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Robos en el vecindario
emails.body:
Buenas tardes,

Nosotros vivimos cerca de Bermuda Way y Ocala Avenue desde hace 15 años. Tengo 3 hijos en la escuela del barrio. Nos robaron el convertidor catalítico del carro.

Pedimos más vigilancia y que respondan a tiempo.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.to: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
emails.subject: Nghẹt cống, nước tràn bếp
emails.body:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Tôi là chủ căn nhà cho thuê hai phòng, nhưng hệ thống thoát nước đã bị tắc từ tháng trước. Người thuê báo nước tràn ra sàn bếp và có mùi hôi rất khó chịu. Tôi đã gọi thợ, nhưng thợ nói phải đào vỉa hè để kiểm tra đường ống nên cần giấy phép.

Mong thành phố hướng dẫn thủ tục xin giấy phép và cử người kiểm tra đường ống thoát nước.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Tráfico escolar sin estudiar
emails.body:
Hola,

Nosotros vivimos cerca de Irwindale Dr y Aborn Rd desde hace 9 años. Con el edificio nuevo habrá muchísimos más carros en la calle y la escuela ya tiene problemas con el tráfico a la salida.

Pido que la ciudad revise el tráfico en horas de escuela antes de aprobar el proyecto.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Overgrown yard with junk
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

I live by Purple Hills Drive and Santa Teresa Boulevard with my family. The yard across the street is overgrown with blackberries and piled with broken furniture.

Please send someone to cite the owner for the weeds and junk.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Permiso de remodelación atorado
emails.body:
Hola,

Nosotros vivimos cerca de Foxworthy Ave y Cherry Ave desde hace 12 años. Mi casero quiere arreglar el baño y la cocina de nuestro edificio, pero el permiso lleva casi cinco meses en revisión sin respuesta. Mientras tanto seguimos con el agua fría y la estufa rota porque no pueden empezar.

Pido que la ciudad agilice la revisión del permiso para que puedan empezar las reparaciones.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Rusted truck leaking oil
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

The lot behind us has had a rusted pickup on blocks for over a year, with its hood open and oil dripping into the gravel. There is also a pile of drywall, a dead tree, and old tires that have been sitting out in the rain. When it rains, the oil runs toward the storm drain, and I am worried about the creek. We have asked the owner, and he just says he will get to it when he can.

Please order the owner to remove the vehicle, the tires, and the debris, and check for illegal dumping.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Oppose higher permit fees
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

Raising permit fees again while review times keep growing is backwards. My neighbor uses a wheelchair, so this matters a lot.

I OPPOSE the fee increase unless it pays for more plan check staff.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Por favor bajen el aumento de renta
emails.body:
Hola,

Somos inquilinos y la renta ya es más de la mitad de nuestro sueldo. Trabajo en dos lugares y no alcanza. Llegamos en 1996 y queremos quedarnos.

Apoyo bajar el límite de aumento de renta. Por favor voten que sí.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Restaurant slow season
emails.body:
Our food truck has not had enough customers for three months and I am paying the loan from my own pocket. I own a small business near Aborn Rd and Bradbury Dr.

Please share any help available for small food businesses.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Vacant building is a hazard
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

A boarded-up commercial building on our corner has trash piling up and the fence is falling onto the sidewalk. I've lived in Eastridge since 2008.

Please send code enforcement back out and keep the case open until it's secured.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Calefacción rota en casa
emails.body:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

Vivo en Umbarger. La estufa de mi casa no prende y el cuarto se pone muy frío por las noches. Ya llamé al dueño dos veces y no vino nadie.

Necesito que la ciudad mande un inspector a revisar la calefacción.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Collapsed carport next door
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

The apartment complex's old carport has collapsed onto a car, and the rest of the structure is leaning toward the sidewalk. I've lived in Sakamota since 2018.

Please have an inspector assess the carport and require it to be removed.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Please repave our street
emails.body:
A pothole near the crosswalk bent the rim on my car last week. We've lived in Coyote Valley for 11 years. My neighbor's tire blew out on it in March.

Please fix this pothole before someone gets hurt.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Unsafe crossing near the school
emails.body:
Hi,

I've been a homeowner near Halkins Drive and Mystic Drive for 19 years. Other neighborhoods got flashing beacons at their school crossings years ago and we are still waiting.

Please install a flashing beacon and a marked crosswalk this year.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Support the fourplex zoning reform
emails.body:
I live in Sierra Vista Hills. Allowing fourplexes on single-family lots is a modest change that lets neighborhoods grow gently. Every older neighborhood here already has duplexes and nobody notices them.

Please vote yes on the citywide fourplex zoning reform.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: Vacant storefront with graffiti
emails.body:
The storefront next to my shop has been vacant for three years, with plywood on the windows and tags all over the door. I own a small business near Redmond Ave and Monteverde Dr.

Please require the owner to repair the boards and remove the graffiti.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Permit fee increase
emails.body:
Hello,

I live near Lynnhaven Drive and Princess Anne Drive. Raising permit fees again while review times keep growing is backwards. Small contractors pass these costs straight to homeowners.

I OPPOSE the fee increase unless it pays for more plan check staff. We will keep watching how the council votes.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Man on the sidewalk
emails.body:
Hi,

There is a man who sleeps near our apartment entrance and he is clearly having a breakdown most nights, but nobody comes who knows how to help him.

Please send mental health outreach workers instead of police for calls like this.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Lonely after my husband passed
emails.body:
Hello,

My husband passed earlier this year, and I have not found anything to do during the day since then. My family and I live in McKean. The church group stopped meeting and the senior center's classes are full.

I hope the city can add more low-cost activities for widows and widowers.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Eviction after I asked for repairs
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

After I reported a broken heater to the landlord, I got a notice ending my tenancy with no reason given. Our family has been in Strawberry Park for 27 years. My kids have been sleeping in coats because the unit stays so cold, and I have a copy of every text I sent. I went to a legal aid clinic and they said I might have some protection, but the process is confusing and expensive.

Please fund free legal help for tenants who get eviction notices after requesting repairs.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Permiso para cuarto en el patio
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

Llevo tres meses esperando el permiso para construir un cuarto chico en el patio y nadie me dice en qué etapa va.

Pido que la ciudad me diga en qué etapa está mi permiso y cuánto falta.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Permit fees up, service still slow
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

The permit fees for a basic water heater swap are now more than three hundred dollars, yet the inspection still takes weeks to schedule. Paying more for slower service does not seem fair to homeowners.

Please reconsider the fee increase unless the city commits to faster permit reviews.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Road dips getting worse
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

The street outside my unit has several dips that fill with water and get deeper every winter. I have seen the same area crack open again each time it rains, and I worry it is going to be a serious hazard soon.

Please re-pave the worst section of our street this year instead of patching it again.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.to: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
emails.subject: Rác bị vứt bừa bãi
emails.body:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Có người vứt nệm cũ và rác ở góc đường nhà tôi. Tôi đã báo nhưng lâu lắm mới dọn. Đây là lần thứ tư tôi viết thư.

Tôi ủng hộ phạt nặng người vứt rác.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Bulky pickup steps
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

Nobody told us how to request a bulky pickup and the form was hard to find. Our family has been in Country Lane for 27 years.

Please post the steps clearly on the 311 app and the city website.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: ADU permit stuck for months
emails.body:
I live in Meadowfair. A simple kitchen remodel permit has taken five months and three resubmittals. I'm a small business owner and a parent of 2.

Please fix the permit backlog and set a real turnaround time.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Cost of living
emails.body:
Hello,

I live in Communications Hill. I make a decent salary and still can't save anything after rent and childcare. I don't know what the council can do, but please do something.

I just wanted someone to hear it.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Costs keep rising
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

We live just off Cherry Ave near Marcia Ave. The cost of everything is rising, from car insurance to a loaf of bread.

Please push for relief for working families.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Sound wall please
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

The noise from the freeway is loud enough to hear through the closed windows.

Please prioritize a sound wall for our side of the freeway.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Freeway noise and air
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

We live close enough to the freeway that the windowsills are black with soot every week. I'm a teacher and a parent of 4. I live near Forest Avenue and North Monroe Street.

Please fund a sound wall and tree planting along this stretch.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Tires by the trail
emails.body:
To the City Council,

Six tires got dumped next to the bike trail entrance over the weekend.

Please pick them up and fine whoever is doing this.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Ilaw sa kalsada
emails.body:
Patay ang ilaw sa poste sa tapat ng bahay namin nang halos dalawang linggo na. Nakapag-report na kami sa 311 app pero wala pa ring dumarating na tao para ayusin.

Hinihiling namin na ayusin agad ang ilaw at tingnan kung may ninakaw na kable.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Dumped furniture on sidewalk
emails.body:
Hello,

There's a mattress and two broken chairs dumped on the sidewalk outside the empty lot. I've lived in Norwood since 2015.

Please ask the city to remove the dumped items and cite whoever owns the lot.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Old fridge in the alley
emails.body:
Hello,

We live just off Beckley Drive near Watkins Way. An old refrigerator has been sitting in the alley for almost three weeks now, and the door is hanging open. A raccoon got into it and made a mess of the trash bins next to it.

I would like the city to pick it up and make sure it does not come back.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Todo está muy caro
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

La renta, la comida y la gasolina están carísimas y ya no alcanza. Mi mamá y yo trabajamos en la limpieza de oficinas.

Solo quería que lo supieran.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Slow down the fourplex reform
emails.body:
Our sewer lines and school classrooms are already at capacity, and fourplexes on every lot will make that worse. I work nights, so I see this at 6 a.m. most days. We bought here for the neighborhood as it is.

Please vote no on citywide fourplexes.

Thank you,
[name removed]
San José, CA 95129
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: Late pickup
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

The bulky pickup came two weeks late and someone had already picked through the pile. I rent an apartment near Blossom Hill Road and Harvard Drive.

Please shorten the wait time for bulky pickups.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Rezoning application: Blossom Hill Road retail parcel

emails.subject: Please repave our street
emails.body:
Hello,

A pothole near the crosswalk bent the rim on my car last week. I live near Creekwood Dr and Doyle Rd. I've been in this city 37 years and I've never written before. I've reported it three times and the ticket keeps closing. We pay our share of taxes and the street looks abandoned.

I SUPPORT more road-repair funding for residential streets. I'm happy to talk to staff about it.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Alumbrado apagado en mi cuadra
emails.body:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

Nosotros vivimos cerca de Chynoweth Ave y Colony Crest Dr desde hace 5 años. Se apagó el alumbrado de nuestra cuadra y la noche se siente peligrosa para los niños.

Les pido que manden una cuadrilla a revisar el cableado y reparar el alumbrado.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Against more officer money
emails.body:
To the City Council,

I do not think the city should keep adding to the police budget when the response times are already this bad. I live by Union Avenue and Rosswood Drive with my family. The problem in my view is how the department is run, and that should be looked at before any new hires.

Please vote against the new officer hiring line until there is an audit of how the department spends its money.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Oppose the new housing bond
emails.body:
Hello,

I live at the corner of Foxworthy Ave and Plummer Ave. I am opposed to another bond measure because our property taxes are already high and we are on a fixed income. I have seen past bonds take years to produce housing, and I want the city to show results before asking for more.

Please delay any new housing bond until the city publishes results from the last one.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: No quiero que nos vigilen
emails.body:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

No quiero que nos vigilen con cámaras que leen las placas de nuestros carros, porque mucha gente aquí tiene miedo de ser rastreada.

Les pido que no compren ese sistema sin garantías de que la información no se comparta con nadie.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.to: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
emails.subject: Ủng hộ chung cư có điều kiện
emails.body:
Xin chào,

Tôi ủng hộ dự án chung cư mới nếu chủ đầu tư giới hạn giờ thi công đến 6 giờ chiều và giữ đường đi bộ an toàn. Trẻ con trong khu phố đi học qua đây mỗi ngày nên tôi rất quan tâm.

Mong thành phố đưa điều kiện giờ thi công và đường đi bộ vào giấy phép.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Stipend for commissioners
emails.body:
To the City Council,

I've lived in Meadowlands since 2004. I support paying a small stipend to commission members so that people who work hourly jobs can still afford to serve. Right now only retirees and people with savings can sit on these boards, and that does not reflect the city. A modest stipend is a small line in the budget compared to the consultants we already pay.

Please add a commission stipend to the next budget and tie it to attendance.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Rent cap should stay strong
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

We live just off Foxborough Dr near Tradewinds Dr. Another rent increase notice arrived this month and it is more than my raise at work.

Please keep the annual rent cap strong and close any loopholes that let landlords avoid it.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Bills and taxes
emails.body:
To the City Council,

I opened my bills this morning and I had to sit down for a minute. Half of it is for the car insurance and the other half is for the phone and internet we cannot cut. I keep telling myself it will get better but it has not in three years.

Please take the cost of living seriously in the next budget.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Please repave our street
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

The pothole patch from last year already crumbled and the hole is back, deeper. This is my third email about it. I've lived in Moreland West since 2016. A patch is not a fix if it fails in six months. We pay our share of taxes and the street looks abandoned.

I SUPPORT more road-repair funding for residential streets. I'm happy to talk to staff about it.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Sparking light and roof leak
emails.body:
Hello,

The upstairs hallway light fixture sparks whenever someone turns it on, and the ceiling near it has a brown water stain that keeps growing. I reported both to the management office last month. I live at the corner of Leeward Dr and Sunnyglen Dr. Nothing has been done, and the stain is now the size of a dinner plate.

Please have an inspector check the wiring and the roof leak above the hallway.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Agua para el desarrollo nuevo
emails.body:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

El desarrollo de vivienda nuevo cerca de nosotros no incluye un estudio de agua, y solo dicen que el agua de los pozos vecinos no se afectará. Nadie nos ha mostrado cómo lo comprobaron. Vivo cerca de South Capitol Avenue y Ocala Avenue. Varios vecinos ya tienen agua con poca presión en el verano.

Pido que la ciudad exija un estudio de agua actualizado antes de aprobar el proyecto.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Speeding on our street
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I live at the corner of Satinwood Dr and Murillo Ave. I coach youth soccer and the families ask me about this. Other neighborhoods got flashing beacons at their school crossings years ago and we are still waiting. A crossing guard was nearly hit in September. We asked for a traffic study two years ago.

Please install a flashing beacon and a marked crosswalk this year. I hope this gets on someone's list.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: flooding every rain on my block downtown
emails.body:
Hi,

I live near 5th and William downtown. Every rain over an inch the storm drain backs up and water reaches the driveways. Last January it got into my garage. Public Works or Water District? Starting here. Please look before winter. Photo below.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Potholes on my corner
emails.body:
The asphalt on the corner by my house is cracking into pieces and water pools there after every rain. I've been a homeowner near Leigh Avenue and Hamilton Place for 9 years.

Please repair the corner and fix the drainage that is making the pavement fail.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Concerns about fourplex upzoning
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

We live near the corner of Rainbow Dr and Alderbrook Ln. Blanket upzoning of single-family neighborhoods ignores the water and sewer infrastructure underneath them. I'm not against housing, I'm against doing it without a plan. We bought here for the neighborhood as it is.

I OPPOSE the fourplex reform as written. Please phase it in with an infrastructure plan. I hope this gets on someone's list.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: Cámaras en la calle
emails.body:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

Estoy de acuerdo con poner cámaras en las calles principales si de verdad ayudan a encontrar a los que roban carros. Vivimos en Gimelli-Delano Manongs desde hace 7 años. Prefiero que haya una cámara que vigile la esquina a que nadie venga cuando hay un robo.

Les pido que aprueben el programa de cámaras y que digan cuánto tiempo guardan las grabaciones.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Affordable housing tax
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I'm in favor of a local tax for affordable housing, but only if voters can approve it with a simple majority. I rent an apartment near Turtlerock Dr and Tobago Ave. Renters feel every rent increase, and nobody in the council has really talked about that. If the money actually brings rent down, I would vote yes.

Please let voters decide an affordable housing tax by simple majority next year.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Road crumbling at the edges
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

The edge of the road by our curb has broken apart into chunks, and bikes have to swerve into traffic to get around. I've been a homeowner near Lundy Avenue and North King Road for 27 years. My teenager's bike got caught in one of the gaps last month and she fell badly.

Please schedule a repair for the broken pavement along our curb before someone gets hurt.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Catalytic converter thefts
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

We moved here in 2005 and we'd like to stay. There have been five car break-ins on our street since August and two catalytic converter thefts. Nobody even called back about the report.

I SUPPORT more patrols and community service officers in our area.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Both sides of the rule
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

I oppose a blanket ban on working with federal partners, since the police need to be able to act on serious crimes in our area. I do not want neighbors harassed, but a blanket rule could block investigations into the robberies we keep having. A narrow rule that targets civil immigration checks would make more sense to me.

Please vote against a blanket ban and support narrower limits instead.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Support the fourplex zoning reform
emails.body:
Hello,

My grown kids can't afford to live in the city they grew up in, and fourplexes are a reasonable fix. I'm retired and I walk the neighborhood every morning. We need housing near jobs and transit. Every older neighborhood here already has duplexes and nobody notices them.

I SUPPORT the fourplex reform. Please approve it. I'm happy to talk to staff about it.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: Support new homes with an infrastructure plan
emails.body:
Hi,

Our business depends on workers who need places to live, so I support new housing if it comes with real infrastructure planning. We have lost employees because they could not find anywhere to live nearby. Better roads, sewers, and parking would make these projects work for everyone in the area.

Please tie each major housing approval to a written plan for roads, water, and schools.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.to: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
emails.subject: Bị ép dọn nhà
emails.body:
Xin chào,

Gia đình tôi ở gần Nieman Blvd và Plumstead Way. Gia đình tôi có 3 con nhỏ. Chủ nhà bắt chúng tôi dọn đi để sửa nhà nhưng thật ra là để tăng giá. Chúng tôi đã ở đây hơn mười năm.

Xin thành phố bảo vệ người thuê nhà và đóng lỗ hổng này.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: pothole damage to my car
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I work nights, so I see this at 2 a.m. most days. Crews patched one pothole on our street and left four others right next to it. Cyclists have to swerve into traffic to avoid it.

Please repave the block instead of patching it again.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Blossom Hill rezoning
emails.body:
The Blossom Hill parcel should be housing or a park, not more empty retail. Half the storefronts in the existing center are vacant.

Please deny the Blossom Hill rezoning application. I'm happy to talk to staff about it.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
Bagby resident
emails.item_title: Rezoning application: Blossom Hill Road retail parcel

emails.subject: Tòa nhà cao gây bóng râm
emails.body:
Xin chào,
