Tòa nhà mới cao tám tầng sẽ che hết ánh nắng cho sân sau nhà tôi, và đường trước nhà đã kẹt xe mỗi giờ tan tầm. Tôi sống ở khu Village Oaks. Vợ tôi trồng rau trong sân và đã mất gần hết mùa vì bóng râm.

Mong thành phố giảm chiều cao tòa nhà hoặc yêu cầu lùi đường xây về sau để bớt bóng râm.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Streetlights out on our block
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

Half the streetlights along our walk to school are out, and the copper wiring was stolen again. Our family has been in River Glen for 23 years. We moved here in 2005 and we'd like to stay.

I SUPPORT funding a faster repair crew and theft-proof wiring.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Street lights have been out for weeks
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

Two streetlights near the bus stop have been out since the last storm. I've been in this city 38 years and I've never written before. Seniors on our street have stopped taking evening walks.

I OPPOSE renewing a contract that leaves lights out this long.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Oppose blanket upzoning
emails.body:
Hi,

I live near Timberline Dr and Evergreen Way. Our sewer lines and school classrooms are already at capacity, and fourplexes on every lot will make that worse. We bought here for the neighborhood as it is. I'm not against housing, I'm against doing it without a plan.

I OPPOSE the fourplex reform as written. Please phase it in with an infrastructure plan. I'm happy to talk to staff about it.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: Let us build more homes
emails.body:
To the City Council,

We live just off Quail Crest Way near Hollow Lake Way. My grown kids can't afford to live in the city they grew up in, and fourplexes are a reasonable fix. Every older neighborhood here already has duplexes and nobody notices them. We need housing near jobs and transit.

I SUPPORT the fourplex reform. Please approve it. We will keep watching how the council votes.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: Tenant protections needed
emails.body:
Our landlord sent notices to six units saying we have to leave for renovations that never seem to happen. I rent an apartment near Hallbrook Drive and Kirk Road. I've been in this city 10 years and I've never written before. Most of us have lived here more than ten years.

Please close the remodel loophole and require relocation payments.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Basura en el callejón
emails.body:
Buenas tardes,

Cada semana aparecen bolsas de basura y muebles viejos en el callejón atrás de nuestro edificio. Ya llamé al 311 dos veces y solo lo limpian una vez.

Quisiera que la ciudad ponga cámaras o pase más seguido por ahí.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Let us build more homes
emails.body:
I'm writing on my lunch break, so I'll keep it short. Allowing fourplexes on single-family lots is a modest change that lets neighborhoods grow gently.

I SUPPORT the fourplex reform. Please approve it.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: Rent due Friday
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I live at the corner of South 15th Street and East San Antonio Street. Rent is due Friday and I only have half of it, so I am asking what I can do.

Please tell me who to call for rent assistance before the late fee hits.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Support the officer proposal
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I support the proposal to add more patrol officers in the budget, because our block watch has done what it can and we still get break-ins. We live just off Hillsdale Avenue near Dow Drive. Most of us are renters who cannot afford private cameras, so we rely on the city.

Please approve the officer hiring line as proposed and track response times on a public dashboard.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Slow down the fourplex reform
emails.body:
To the City Council,

I coach youth soccer and the families ask me about this. I live near Curtner Ave and Fairhill Ln. Our sewer lines and school classrooms are already at capacity, and fourplexes on every lot will make that worse. I'm not against housing, I'm against doing it without a plan.

Please vote no on citywide fourplexes.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: Casa abandonada con pintas
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

La casa vacía de enfrente tiene las ventanas tapiadas con madera y ya le salieron pintas enormes en la barda. Desde hace un año nadie cuida el terreno y se llena de basura. Mis nietos juegan en la calle y me preocupa que alguien entre a esa casa.

Pido que la ciudad obligue al dueño a limpiar el terreno y borrar las pintas.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Repeated graffiti at our store
emails.body:
Hello,

Our hardware store has had graffiti on the back alley wall for six months, and the nearby vacant building has broken windows that keep getting broken. Customers complain about the mess, and the trash cans get knocked over every night. I have paid to repaint the wall twice, and it gets tagged again within days.

Please have code enforcement require the vacant property owner to clean up the graffiti and secure the windows.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Pothole that keeps coming back
emails.body:
Hello,

There is a pothole on our street the size of a manhole cover and it has been there since winter. Cyclists have to swerve into traffic to avoid it. A patch is not a fix if it fails in six months.

Please fix this pothole before someone gets hurt. I'm happy to talk to staff about it.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
Los Gatos Memorial resident
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Support the fourplex zoning reform
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I live in Meadowlands. My grown kids can't afford to live in the city they grew up in, and fourplexes are a reasonable fix. I've been in this city 34 years and I've never written before. Every older neighborhood here already has duplexes and nobody notices them.

Please vote yes on the citywide fourplex zoning reform.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: Which rent limits apply to my unit?
emails.body:
I rent out a condo I bought ten years ago and I am still confused about which rent limits apply to it. I'm a Welch Park homeowner. The city website explains the cap in general terms, but I could not find a clear answer for units built after a certain year. I have called the office several times and waited on hold for a long time.

Please publish a simple chart showing which rental units are covered by the cap and which are exempt.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Casa abandonada
emails.body:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

Nosotros vivimos cerca de Markingdon Avenue y Ramsgate Way desde hace 6 años. La casa abandonada de la esquina está llena de basura y entra gente de noche. Tengo 2 hijos en la escuela del barrio.

Pedimos que la ciudad obligue al dueño a limpiar.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Catalytic converter thefts
emails.body:
We moved here in 2001 and we'd like to stay. Package theft and car break-ins on our block have doubled this year.

I SUPPORT more patrols and community service officers in our area.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Permit delays are killing my business
emails.body:
To the City Council,

I live at the corner of Basking Ridge Ave and Silicon Valley Blvd. Our ADU permit has been in plan review for eleven months and every round brings a new comment. The contractor is about to walk away.

Please fix the permit backlog and set a real turnaround time.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Couch dumped on the sidewalk for two weeks
emails.body:
To the City Council,

I live near Chynoweth Avenue and Winfield Boulevard. There is a pile of dumped furniture and trash bags on the sidewalk that has been there two weeks. Kids have to walk around it into the street.

Please clean it up and put a camera at this spot.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Mold, leak, and no heat
emails.body:
Hello,

Black mold has spread across the bathroom ceiling and up the wall behind the tub, and the landlord painted over it twice without fixing the leak above it. The unit also has no working heat in the bedroom, so we run a space heater with an extension cord. I rent an apartment near Newhall St and Frankfurt Ave. My son has had a cough since October, and the doctor said the air in our home could be part of it. We have sent three written requests to the management office and have not gotten a repair date.

Please send a housing inspector to the unit to cite the mold, the leak, and the heating problem.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: streetlight outage, third report
emails.body:
To the City Council,

I live by Brigadoon Way and Innerwick Lane with my family. Three streetlights on our block have been out for almost a month. The service request says closed, but nothing was fixed. Seniors on our street have stopped taking evening walks.

I OPPOSE renewing a contract that leaves lights out this long. We will keep watching how the council votes.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Pothole that keeps coming back
emails.body:
To the City Council,

There is a pothole on our street the size of a manhole cover and it has been there since winter. I live at the corner of Clovercrest Dr and Glen Brae Ln. Cyclists have to swerve into traffic to avoid it.

I OPPOSE spending on cosmetic projects while basic streets crumble.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Building too tall for street
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

The building is too tall for the street, and it feels out of place next to our one-story homes.

Please ask the design review board to reconsider the height.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.to: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
emails.subject: Chọn người vào ghế trống
emails.body:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Ghế trống trong hội đồng nên được bầu lại, vì tôi không biết ai được chọn và tại sao. Gia đình tôi sống ở đây đã lâu nhưng chưa bao giờ được hỏi ý kiến về người thay thế.

Xin thành phố tổ chức bầu cử đặc biệt cho ghế trống để người dân có tiếng nói.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Cameras at the dump spot
emails.body:
Hello,

I've lived in Los Paseos since 2004. Our dumping hotspot needs cameras, because cleanups alone do not stop it.

Please install cameras and post signs on the poles.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Apoyo la protección a inmigrantes
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

Muchas familias tienen miedo de salir por las redadas de inmigración. Llevo 25 años en esta ciudad.

Apoyo la resolución para proteger a las familias inmigrantes.

Gracias,
[name removed]
Residente de La Colina
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Apoyo con vivienda accesible
emails.body:
Buenas tardes,

Vivo cerca de Leeward Dr y Lucerne Way. Apoyo el proyecto de vivienda si reservan una parte para familias de ingreso bajo.

Pido que la ciudad ponga esa condición por escrito en el permiso.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Oppose blanket upzoning
emails.body:
I'm retired and I walk the neighborhood every morning. Parking on our street is already full every night, and the fourplex reform has no plan for it.

Please vote no on citywide fourplexes.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: Officer funding in the budget
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I think the budget should fund more patrol officers, because right now a report can sit for a whole shift. My husband works nights and came home to find the tailgate of his truck pried open, and nobody came until morning. We are tired of paying taxes and getting this kind of response.

Please keep the officer hiring money in the budget and report back on how it will shorten response times.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: 关于新住房与基础设施
emails.body:
新建住房可以，但是我们这边的排水和供水设施跟不上了。

希望市政府在批准新项目前，先检查供水和排水能力。

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Slow down the fourplex reform
emails.body:
Hi,

Blanket upzoning of single-family neighborhoods ignores the water and sewer infrastructure underneath them. I've lived in Los Alamitos Creek since 2008. I'm not against housing, I'm against doing it without a plan. We moved here in 2014 and we'd like to stay. We bought here for the neighborhood as it is.

Please vote no on citywide fourplexes. This has gone on long enough.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: Slow down the fourplex reform
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

We moved here in 2001 and we'd like to stay. I've been a homeowner near Airport Boulevard and Coleman Avenue for 4 years. Parking on our street is already full every night, and the fourplex reform has no plan for it.

I OPPOSE the fourplex reform as written. Please phase it in with an infrastructure plan.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: Please repave our street
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

I live at the corner of Ridgemont Dr and Ocala Ave. The pothole patch from last year already crumbled and the hole is back, deeper. My mother uses a wheelchair, so this matters a lot.

Please repave the block instead of patching it again.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Hole by the bus stop
emails.body:
We live near the corner of Chynoweth Ave and Pearl Ave. There is a deep hole at the edge of the lane near the bus stop that my son stepped into last week.

Please fill the hole and mark it until the repair crew can come out.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Support the rent cap amendment
emails.body:
Hi,

This is my fourth email about it. We live near the corner of Cherry Avenue and Foxworthy Avenue. I'm a renter and the annual increases are the reason my friends have left the city. My kids go to school here and I don't want to move them again. We are not asking for a handout, just predictability.

I SUPPORT lowering the annual rent-increase cap. Please vote yes. Thank you for reading this.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Upstream paving adds runoff
emails.body:
Paving the lot upstream would send more runoff straight into the drain that already backs up.

Please require stormwater retention before the project gets a permit.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Surveillance cameras
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

I don't want my daily movements logged by surveillance cameras with no clear rule on who can see the data. We live near the corner of Sweetbriar Drive and Curtner Avenue. I'm writing on my lunch break, so I'll keep it short.

I OPPOSE expanding surveillance cameras without a privacy ordinance first.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Oppose higher permit fees
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

My family and I live in Los Paseos. Raising permit fees again while review times keep growing is backwards. Small contractors pass these costs straight to homeowners. We moved here in 1996 and we'd like to stay.

I OPPOSE the fee increase unless it pays for more plan check staff.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Name the candidates
emails.body:
To the City Council,

Before any vote happens, the council should say out loud who it is considering for the seat. I've been a homeowner near Ione Dr and Sierraville Ave for 5 years.

Please hold a public interview for each candidate before the council votes on a replacement.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Please repave our street
emails.body:
We've lived in Mount Pleasant Foothills for 23 years. The pothole patch from last year already crumbled and the hole is back, deeper. I've been in this city 21 years and I've never written before.

Please repave the block instead of patching it again.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Who gets appointed to commissions
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I live in Flickinger. Almost every member of the planning commission lives in the same few neighborhoods, and it shows in their votes. Working parents can't take off for a daytime interview.

Please hold evening interviews and publish the applicant pool for every commission.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Surveillance cameras
emails.body:
Hi,

The plan to add license-plate readers and surveillance cameras on every arterial goes too far for a city that values privacy. There's no public data retention policy in the staff report.

I OPPOSE expanding surveillance cameras without a privacy ordinance first. This has gone on long enough.

Thanks,
[name removed]
Willow Glen West resident
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Slow police response
emails.body:
To the City Council,

I live at the corner of Symphony Lane and Coyote Road. There have been five car break-ins on our street since August and two catalytic converter thefts. People are scared to park on the street.

I SUPPORT more patrols and community service officers in our area.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Recoger muebles
emails.body:
Buenas tardes,

Vivimos en Santa Teresa desde hace 27 años. Necesito que alguien recoja un refrigerador viejo y no sé cómo pedir la cita.

Por favor díganme cómo hacer la cita y cuándo pasan.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Culvert clogs behind apartments
emails.body:
To the City Council,

The rezoned parcel behind our apartment has a culvert that clogs every year, and nobody says what happens to it once the lot is built. Our unit is on the ground floor. Last spring the parking lot filled with water and two cars were stuck in it.

Please require an inspection of the culvert and a plan to keep runoff off our property.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Proactive rental inspection and habitability enforcement

emails.subject: Senior center closed
emails.body:
Hello,

We live just off Fairway Glen Ln near Santa Teresa Blvd. The senior center near the apartments we rent has been closed on Thursdays for months, and nobody says when it will open again. Half the people who used to come now just sit in their rooms all day. I am worried about my neighbors, and I do not know who to ask about it.

Please give us a clear date for when the Thursday hours will return.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Afraid to report problems
emails.body:
To the City Council,

I rent an apartment near Trowbridge Way and Country Club Pkwy. I am scared to complain about mold because the last person who did got a rent hike two weeks later.

Please add stronger penalties for landlords who retaliate against tenants who report code problems.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Proactive rental inspection and habitability enforcement

emails.subject: Support the fourplex zoning reform
emails.body:
Hello,

My partner uses a wheelchair, so this matters a lot. I live near Shawcroft Drive and Calero Avenue. Allowing fourplexes on single-family lots is a modest change that lets neighborhoods grow gently.

Please vote yes on the citywide fourplex zoning reform.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: Dumping near our loading dock
emails.body:
Hello,

Someone is dumping furniture and tires next to the loading dock behind our store, probably at night. I run a shop near the corner of Tobago Ave and Boa Vista Dr. It blocks the delivery truck every time, and drivers have complained.

We want the city to remove it promptly and check whether a camera can be placed there.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Suporta sa pabahay na proyekto
emails.body:
Suportado ko ang bagong proyekto ng pabahay sa lote malapit sa amin, basta may malinaw na tuntunin para sa ingay at trapiko. Gusto ko lang masiguro na hindi aabalahin ang mga batang pumapasok sa paaralan tuwing umaga.

Sana ay isama ng lungsod ang oras ng konstruksyon at limitasyon sa ingay sa permit.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Las luces de la calle no funcionan
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

Mi esposo y yo trabajamos en la limpieza de oficinas. Las luces de la calle llevan semanas apagadas en nuestra cuadra. Lo reporté por la aplicación y nadie vino.

Apoyo que la ciudad arregle las luces pronto.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Thiếu chỗ đậu xe
emails.body:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Lối đi trước khu nhà chúng tôi đã không còn chỗ đậu xe sau 6 giờ tối, nay thêm tòa nhà mới thì càng chật.

Mong thành phố yêu cầu chủ dự án có kế hoạch chỗ đậu xe ngay trong khu đất.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Bakery permit stuck since spring
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

My bakery's tenant improvement permit has been stuck in review since spring, and our opening date keeps moving. I own a small business near Rainbow Drive and Petal Way.

Please assign a staff member to tell us what is blocking the permit.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: pothole damage to my car
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

The road surface on our block is so broken that delivery trucks swerve into the bike lane. I've reported it three times and the ticket keeps closing. My neighbor uses a wheelchair, so this matters a lot. We pay our share of taxes and the street looks abandoned.

Please fix this pothole before someone gets hurt. I'm happy to talk to staff about it.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Crisis de salud mental
emails.body:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

Mi vecino que vive en la calle empezó a gritar y a empujar a la gente en la cuadra, y la policía llegó con las luces prendidas y lo asustó más. Vivo en Warner Heights. Creo que alguien que sepa de salud mental debió venir primero, porque él estaba muy enfermo y no era un criminal.

Les pido que el presupuesto financie equipos de salud mental que respondan sin policías en llamadas como esta.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.to: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
emails.subject: Pháo nổ
emails.body:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Pháo nổ bất hợp pháp suốt đêm trước Tết và trẻ nhỏ trong nhà tôi sợ hãi, khóc không ngừng.

Xin thành phố tăng cường xử phạt pháo nổ để các gia đình được yên ổn.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Ruido y aire de la autopista
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

Mi hermana y yo trabajamos en la limpieza de oficinas. Vivimos junto a la autopista y el aire siempre está sucio.

Pedimos un muro de sonido y más árboles.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Surveillance cameras
emails.body:
I live by Arbuckle Drive and Crowder Avenue with my family. The plan to add license-plate readers and surveillance cameras on every arterial goes too far for a city that values privacy. We moved here in 2019 and we'd like to stay.

I OPPOSE expanding surveillance cameras without a privacy ordinance first.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Crisis team
emails.body:
When my brother was in a mental health crisis last spring, the only option was calling police, and it turned into a scary situation for everyone. I live at the corner of Duvall Dr and Hamilton Ave.

Please fund a crisis response team of mental health workers who can respond without officers for calls like this.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Oppose the Blossom Hill strip mall rezoning
emails.body:
We live near the corner of Mancuso Street and Redmond Avenue. The Blossom Hill parcel should be housing or a park, not more empty retail. Half the storefronts in the existing center are vacant.

I OPPOSE the rezoning as proposed. I hope this gets on someone's list.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Rezoning application: Blossom Hill Road retail parcel

emails.subject: Thành viên ủy ban
emails.body:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Gia đình tôi ở gần Overland Way và Springfield Way. Các thành viên ủy ban đều là người có tiếng tăm, còn những người thường như chúng tôi không biết làm sao để ứng cử.

Xin thành phố công bố cách nộp đơn và tiêu chí chọn người rõ ràng cho mọi người.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: A favor de más vivienda
emails.body:
Hola,

Mis hijos adultos no pueden pagar renta aquí y necesitamos más unidades de vivienda. Necesitamos más opciones. Llegamos en 2001 y queremos quedarnos.

Por favor voten a favor de la reforma.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: Trộm cắp trong khu phố
emails.body:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Khu phố tôi bị trộm xe và đập kính xe nhiều lần. Tôi sống gần Quesada Dr và Grafton Way. Cảnh sát đến rất trễ. Tôi làm ca đêm và về nhà lúc 2 giờ sáng.

Xin tăng cường tuần tra trong khu phố.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Storm drain backs up every rain
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

I live at the corner of Chynoweth Avenue and Colony Crest Drive. The storm drain on our block has been clogged with leaves and silt since October. Kids walking to school have to wade through it. Last winter it got into two of our neighbors' garages.

I SUPPORT funding storm drain upgrades on residential streets. I'm happy to talk to staff about it.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Graffiti on vacant apartment building
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

The apartment building on the corner has graffiti covering every window of its ground floor, and the paint has been there since the summer. Kids cut through the parking lot to get to the vacant units at night. Some of the tags look like gang signs, and they are getting bigger every week.

Please have graffiti removed from the vacant building and the owner cited if it is not done.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Trộm xe
emails.body:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Gia đình tôi sống ở khu Mount Pleasant Foothills đã 5 năm. Trong tháng này xe của gia đình tôi bị đập kính hai lần ngay trong con hẻm trước nhà. Tôi đã gọi số không khẩn cấp nhưng phải chờ hơn bốn tiếng, và cảnh sát chỉ ghi biên bản rồi về.

Xin thành phố tăng thêm cảnh sát tuần tra ban đêm ở khu nhà chúng tôi.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Bond measure is too expensive
emails.body:
To the City Council,

I've been a homeowner near Evans Ln and Canoas Garden Ave for 20 years. The new proposal would add a large tax on property owners, and I think the cost should be spread differently. My neighbors and I are retired and we already stretch to pay for our homes each year. Some of us are considering selling because the bills keep going up.

Please reconsider the funding plan and use general revenue instead of a new property tax.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Road surface is falling apart
emails.body:
To the City Council,

The road surface on our block is so broken that delivery trucks swerve into the bike lane. I work nights, so I see this at 2 a.m. most days. We live just off W Hedding St near N Monroe St. We pay our share of taxes and the street looks abandoned.

Please repave the block instead of patching it again.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Giá cả quá đắt
emails.body:
Xin chào,

Tiền nhà, tiền chợ, tiền xăng đều tăng, gia đình tôi rất khó khăn. Xin quý vị nghĩ đến những gia đình như chúng tôi. Tôi làm ca đêm và về nhà lúc 5 giờ sáng.

Tôi chỉ muốn quý vị biết.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
Cư dân khu Rosenbaum
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Casa abandonada con puerta abierta
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

Vivo cerca de Leigh Ave y Kingman Ave. En la esquina hay una casa abandonada con la puerta abierta y basura en el porche.

Quisiera que la ciudad la revise y obligue a cerrarla.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Ruido y aire de la autopista
emails.body:
Hola,

Vivimos junto a la autopista y el aire siempre está sucio. Es la tercera vez que escribo.

Pedimos un muro de sonido y más árboles.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Broken bathroom exhaust fan
emails.body:
Hello,

I live near South 15th Street and East San Carlos Street. The bathroom exhaust fan has been broken since spring, and the room stays damp enough to grow mold on the grout.

Please have the owner fix the fan and inspect the moisture problem.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Cruce peligroso
emails.body:
Buenas tardes,

Llevo 3 años en esta ciudad. Vivo cerca de Tradewinds Drive y Foxborough Drive. No hay paso de peatones cerca de la escuela y los carros pasan muy rápido. Casi atropellan a un niño el mes pasado.

Pedimos que pongan un cruce con luces.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.to: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
emails.subject: Ổ gà nguy hiểm trên đường
emails.body:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Tôi sống ở khu Good Samaritan. Tôi làm ca đêm và về nhà lúc 4 giờ sáng. Có một ổ gà rất lớn trên đường nhà tôi từ mấy tháng nay. Tôi đã báo nhiều lần.

Xin thành phố cho sửa đường sớm.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Construction debris in the alley
emails.body:
I've been a homeowner near Creekwood Dr and Doyle Rd for 16 years. Somebody keeps dumping drywall, broken tile, and paint cans in the alley behind my house. I have called the 311 line three times and each time the pile gets smaller for a day and then comes back bigger. The rain washes paint into the storm drain and I worry about the dog drinking from the puddles.

I want the city to clean the alley fully and check the cameras or patrol more often at night.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Car break-ins on our street
emails.body:
Hello,

We live just off Williams Road near Nazarene Way. My neighbor's catalytic converter was cut off in broad daylight last week. People are scared to park on the street.

I SUPPORT more patrols and community service officers in our area.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Let us build more homes
emails.body:
Hi,

Allowing fourplexes on single-family lots is a modest change that lets neighborhoods grow gently. I coach youth soccer and the families ask me about this.

Please vote yes on the citywide fourplex zoning reform.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: Overreach concern
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I live near Verona Road and Yerba Buena Road. I think city cameras in parks are an overreach, because they are going up where kids play and nobody asked us.

Please require a public hearing before any new camera is installed in a park or on a school route.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: streetlight outage, third report
emails.body:
To the City Council,

Half the streetlights along our walk to school are out, and the copper wiring was stolen again. I've been in this city 19 years and I've never written before.

I SUPPORT funding a faster repair crew and theft-proof wiring.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: No patrols
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

Nobody has come out to our complex in months, even though car windows keep getting smashed. We live near the corner of Nazarene Way and Williams Road.

Please fund more night patrols for our complex.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Dumping keeps happening by the creek
emails.body:
Hi,

People keep leaving couches, bags of yard waste, and a shopping cart near the creek trail behind our homes. My husband and I picked up two bags last weekend just so the kids would not walk past it. The city crew came once in the spring but nothing has been done since.

Please schedule regular cleanups along that stretch and post signs about fines.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Dry-year water supply unclear
emails.body:
Hi,

The data center review lists a cooling water figure but does not say where the water comes from during a dry year. I would like to understand the plan before I form an opinion. I live by Bloomsbury Way and Piedmont Rd with my family. I have no problem with new jobs, but I want the numbers to hold up.

Please publish the water source and dry-year supply plan for the data center.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Terra Verde data center: EIR certification and site development permit

emails.subject: Diesel smell at night
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

Diesel exhaust from the trucks drifts into our bedroom window every night after eleven. I live by Rossotto Drive and Vanderbilt Drive with my family. I wake up with a sore throat, and I have called the city twice about it.

Please look into whether the trucks are routed correctly and whether a filter program is possible.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Madilim ang kalye namin
emails.body:
Mahal na Konseho,

Ilang linggo na pong patay ang mga ilaw sa kalye namin. Natatakot ang mga kapitbahay na maglakad sa gabi.

Pakiayos po agad. Salamat.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Graffiti keeps coming back
emails.body:
The graffiti on the wall by our bus stop gets painted over and then it is back within a week. It looks like the same tags, so I think the crew should wait for a better fix rather than a quick paint job.

Please use a longer-lasting coating and remove it faster when people report it.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Our street needs real repaving
emails.body:
The pothole patch from last year already crumbled and the hole is back, deeper. I coach youth soccer and the families ask me about this.

Please fix this pothole before someone gets hurt.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Broken gate lock and window latch
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

We live just off South Bascom Avenue near Foxworthy Avenue. The back bedroom of my rental house has a window that will not latch, and the lock on the side gate is broken so anyone can walk in.

Please tell me whether a broken gate lock and window latch are code violations I need to fix right away.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Desalojo sin razón clara
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

Recibimos un aviso de desalojo con un mes de plazo y no nos dieron ninguna razón por escrito. Mi esposo trabaja de noche y estamos buscando dónde vivir con tres niños, lo cual es muy difícil con este tipo de aviso.

Les pido que hagan más fuertes las protecciones para familias que reciben avisos de desalojo sin causa.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Missed garbage pickup again
emails.body:
Our garbage was missed for the third week in a row, and the cans sit at the curb until the next day and the raccoons get into them. I called the 311 line each time and got a ticket number but no explanation. Our elderly neighbor cannot drag her bins back up the driveway, so her trash just stays out.

Please check our route and make sure the crew comes on the scheduled day.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Our street needs real repaving
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

The road surface on our block is so broken that delivery trucks swerve into the bike lane. My mother uses a wheelchair, so this matters a lot. I'm a Willow Glen South homeowner. My neighbor's tire blew out on it in March. I've reported it three times and the ticket keeps closing.

I SUPPORT more road-repair funding for residential streets. Thank you for reading this.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Please fix our streetlights
emails.body:
My house is right at Echo Valley Drive and Leyland Park Drive. Two streetlights near the bus stop have been out since the last storm. My kids walk home from practice in the dark and I don't like it.

I OPPOSE renewing a contract that leaves lights out this long.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Interpreters
emails.body:
To the City Council,

Meetings have no interpreter for Vietnamese, so my parents sit in the back and cannot follow what is happening.

Please provide interpretation in Vietnamese and Spanish at every commission meeting.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Cuadrilla de trabajo
emails.body:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

Vivimos en Berryessa Creek desde hace 5 años. Tengo una empresa de jardinería con trabajadores inmigrantes y el mes pasado una de nuestras camionetas la detuvieron en un retén cerca de la carretera. Ese día perdimos un día completo de trabajo y uno de mis muchachos ya no quiere regresar.

Les pido que aprueben una norma local que mantenga a la policía fuera de las redadas de inmigración.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Apoyo la protección a inmigrantes
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

Trabajo de noche y llego a casa a las 1. Muchas familias tienen miedo de salir por las redadas de inmigración.

Apoyo la resolución para proteger a las familias inmigrantes.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Calle oscura en la noche
emails.body:
Hola,

Ya no puedo caminar a casa de noche porque la calle está completamente a oscuras desde hace semanas.

Les pido que reparen la luz de inmediato porque hay niños que caminan por aquí.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Không có nước nóng
emails.body:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Đây là lần thứ tư tôi viết thư. Căn hộ của chúng tôi không có nước nóng hơn một tuần. Tôi sống gần Lahaina Way và Ilikai Ave.

Xin thành phố cử người kiểm tra và buộc chủ nhà sửa.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Proactive rental inspection and habitability enforcement

emails.subject: Kitchen remodel permit pending
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

My landlord applied for a kitchen remodel permit in April, and it is still not approved as of today. We live near the corner of Chynoweth Avenue and Colony Crest Drive. Our upstairs neighbors are waiting on the same permit, so everyone's repairs are stuck.

Please speed up the review so the repairs can start before the lease ends.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Dark stairwell and loose railing
emails.body:
Hello,

I rent an apartment near Everglade Ave and Chiplay Dr. The front stairwell light has been out for three weeks, and the handrail is loose.

Please ask the owner to fix the lighting and railing before someone falls.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Concerns about fourplex upzoning
emails.body:
Our association represents about 900 households in Guadalupe Oak Grove. I'm retired and I walk the neighborhood every morning. Blanket upzoning of single-family neighborhoods ignores the water and sewer infrastructure underneath them. I'm not against housing, I'm against doing it without a plan. We bought here for the neighborhood as it is.

Please vote no on citywide fourplexes. Thank you for reading this.

Thanks,
[name removed]
Secretary
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: Keep the two-thirds rule
emails.body:
Hi,

I oppose lowering the voter threshold for local taxes, because a simple majority could raise our property taxes without enough input.

Please keep the two-thirds requirement for local tax measures and do not put a lower threshold on the ballot.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: pothole damage to my car
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

I work nights, so I see this at 11 a.m. most days. A pothole near the crosswalk bent the rim on my car last week.

I SUPPORT more road-repair funding for residential streets.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Más vivienda accesible
emails.body:
Buenas tardes,

Mi familia vive en un cuarto y los precios siguen subiendo porque hay muy pocas casas disponibles. Nosotros vivimos cerca de Di Salvo Ave y Bailey Ave desde hace 16 años.

Les pido que permitan más casas pequeñas y edificios de cuatro unidades en toda la ciudad.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: Ruido de la autopista
emails.body:
Hola,

El ruido de los camiones de la autopista no me deja dormir, sobre todo los que pasan de madrugada. Vivo cerca de Woosley Drive y Felder Drive. Mis nietos ya no quieren dormir en el cuarto de atrás porque se oye demasiado.

Pido que pongan una barda de contención de sonido en nuestra cuadra.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Cans overflowing near the playground
emails.body:
The trash cans near the playground are overflowing by Monday every week, and the wind blows the bags across the grass. We live near the corner of Pinewood Drive and Moorpark Avenue. Parents have started bringing their own bags to haul trash out.

Please add pickups on weekends so these cans get emptied before the week starts.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Miedo de llamar
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

Mi familia tiene miedo de llamar a la policía desde que se corrió el rumor de que agentes federales andan por el barrio. Mi esposo maneja para trabajar y ya no quiere que salgamos a comprar nada de noche.

Les pido que la policía local no ayude con redadas de inmigración y que lo dejen por escrito.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Restaurant worried about generators
emails.body:
Hello,

I own a restaurant two blocks from the proposed data center, and the environmental review does not address the backup generators at all. Testing them could mean monthly diesel noise and exhaust. I run a shop near the corner of Bluefield Dr and Vistapark Dr. Customers already complain about freeway noise, and I cannot afford another source.

Please require the review to analyze generator emissions and testing schedules before the project moves forward.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Terra Verde data center: EIR certification and site development permit

emails.subject: Majority votes
emails.body:
Hello,

The two-thirds rule is too high for the things we actually need, and it keeps the same few projects stuck for years.

Please support a state-level change that lets cities pass public safety taxes by majority vote.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Restore youth funding
emails.body:
Hi,

I oppose the cut to youth programs in next year's budget, because these programs cost less than police overtime. A summer program kept my nephew off the streets, and I have seen the difference firsthand.

Please restore the youth program funding before the budget is final.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: No hot water for over a week
emails.body:
Hello,

The water heater in my apartment has been dead for nine days now. My landlord keeps saying the part is on order. I live near E St James St and N 13th St.

Please send an inspector to check the water heater and cite the owner if it is not fixed.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Proactive rental inspection and habitability enforcement

emails.subject: What it costs
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

We pay council salaries and staff for a reason, and I expect the council to pick the option with the lowest cost to taxpayers. The last vacancy cost several thousand dollars in staff time, and nobody published the breakdown.

Please publish the cost estimate for both the appointment process and any special election.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Cống bị nghẹt
emails.body:
Xin chào,

Gia đình tôi có 2 con nhỏ. Tôi sống gần W Walbrook Dr và Heckman Way. Mỗi lần mưa nước ngập vào sân vì cống bị nghẹt. Nước tràn vào nhà hàng xóm.

Xin cho người đến thông cống trước mùa mưa.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Air filters for schools
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

My daughter's school is right beside the freeway, and the windows there are old and the air coming in is full of dust and exhaust. The classroom air purifier they got last year broke and nobody has replaced it. She comes home with a cough almost every week in the fall.

I support adding air filters and upgraded windows at schools next to the freeway.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Cameras on corners
emails.body:
Hi,

We have had cameras on our corner for two years and they helped solve a hit and run.

Please keep the current camera program and expand it to the blocks where thefts are most common.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.to: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
emails.subject: Đánh giá bỏ sót bụi và ồn
emails.body:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Báo cáo đánh giá môi trường cho dự án nhà ở gần nhà tôi chỉ đo lưu lượng xe vào buổi sáng, chưa xét đến tiếng ồn và bụi xây dựng. Gia đình tôi có người già và trẻ nhỏ, nên bụi và tiếng ồn ảnh hưởng nhiều.

Mong thành phố yêu cầu bổ sung đo bụi và tiếng ồn trước khi phê duyệt.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Bike lanes and crosswalk funding
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I'm for the new bike lanes and two-story condos on the lot if the builder pays for the new crosswalk. I live at the corner of Redmond Avenue and McAbee Road.

Please require the developer to fund the crosswalk before occupancy.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Neighborhood changing too fast
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I just don't like how fast the area is changing. There used to be a family-owned bakery and a shoe repair place here.

Please consider neighborhood character when the council reviews the project.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: General support for mixed-use
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

Overall I think a mixed-use building would be good for the corner, and I would rather see it than another vacant lot. I am not going to pretend I have all the technical answers, but I trust the planning staff to set fair conditions.

Please approve it only after the conditions on parking and shade are written into the permit.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Two lights down on my block
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

Two of the four lights on our block are out and the other two flicker when it rains. We live near the corner of Basking Ridge Ave and Silicon Valley Blvd.

Please check all four poles and replace the parts that are failing.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Landlord won't fix anything
emails.body:
Hi,

I'm retired and I walk the neighborhood every morning. Our apartment has had black mold in the bathroom and bedroom since spring and the landlord just paints over it. My family and I live in Sheppard. My daughter has asthma and it's getting worse.

I SUPPORT proactive rental inspections so tenants don't have to fight alone.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Proactive rental inspection and habitability enforcement

emails.subject: Freeway noise and air
emails.body:
This is my second email about it. We live close enough to the freeway that the windowsills are black with soot every week. There is no sound wall on our side, only a chain-link fence.

Please fund a sound wall and tree planting along this stretch. I'm happy to talk to staff about it.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Clases después de la escuela
emails.body:
Buenas tardes,

Nosotros vivimos cerca de Plumstead Way y Nieman Boulevard desde hace 12 años. Mis hijos salen de la escuela a las tres y no tienen dónde estar hasta que yo llego del trabajo a las seis. Hay un programa de tarea que cerró el año pasado y no lo han vuelto a abrir.

Les pido que financien un programa de tarea y actividades después de clases en nuestra zona.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: dumping problem
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

There is a pile of dumped furniture and trash bags on the sidewalk that has been there two weeks. I reported it in the app and the pickup took eighteen days. I've been in this city 23 years and I've never written before.

Please clean it up and put a camera at this spot.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Catalytic converter thefts
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I run a shop near the corner of Medallion Dr and Redmond Ave. There have been five car break-ins on our street since August and two catalytic converter thefts. I'm retired and I walk the neighborhood every morning. Nobody even called back about the report.

Please fund faster police response for property crime.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Sagging bathroom ceiling
emails.body:
The ceiling in our bathroom sags more each month, and last winter a chunk of plaster fell into the tub. The owner painted over the stain and says it's cosmetic. There is a light fixture hanging just above the bathtub that worries me.

Please have an inspector check the ceiling for structural problems and cite the owner if needed.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Catalytic converter thefts
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

There have been five car break-ins on our street since August and two catalytic converter thefts. I live at the corner of Glen Angus Way and Tully Rd. I'm writing on my lunch break, so I'll keep it short.

Please fund faster police response for property crime.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Todo está muy caro
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

Todo sube y los sueldos no. No sé qué pueden hacer, pero por favor piensen en nosotros. Trabajo de noche y llego a casa a las 6.

Solo quería que lo supieran.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Store cameras and readers
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

As a business owner I use cameras on my lot, but I am not sure a city-run plate reader adds much beyond what private systems already do. I own a small business near Diamond Ave and Torrance Ave. It seems like the money would be better spent on lighting and patrols at night than on a database that nobody reviews.

Please ask for an independent review of plate readers before the city signs any contract.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Keep single-family zoning
emails.body:
I think single-family zoning is part of why our area still feels like a real community.

I hope the council will think carefully before changing those rules again.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: Programas para jóvenes
emails.body:
Buenas tardes,

Vivimos en Cadwallader desde hace 19 años. El centro comunitario cerró los programas para jóvenes en la noche. Los jóvenes no tienen a dónde ir.

Apoyo que la ciudad pague más programas para jóvenes.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Tall dry weeds on empty lot
emails.body:
Hi,

I rent an apartment near Foxworthy Ave and Julio Ave. The empty lot next to our complex is covered in tall dry weeds, and there's a broken shopping cart in the middle of it.

Please send someone to mow the lot and clear the weeds before fire season.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Vacant building is a hazard
emails.body:
Hi,

My neighbor uses a wheelchair, so this matters a lot. The house two doors down has been vacant for three years, the roof is caving in, and people break in at night. I live near Suncrest Avenue and Bay Laurel Lane.

Please send code enforcement back out and keep the case open until it's secured.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Ruido y aire de la autopista
emails.body:
Buenas tardes,

Vivimos junto a la autopista y el aire siempre está sucio. Trabajo de noche y llego a casa a las 5.

Pedimos un muro de sonido y más árboles.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Repeated hot water tank failures
emails.body:
Hi,

The hot water tank in our building was replaced twice this year, and it still runs out after about ten minutes. Our downstairs neighbor has no hot water at all right now. I rent an apartment near Airport Blvd and Coleman Ave. Everyone in the building has been asked to shower at different times, which does not work for families with school schedules.

Please order an inspection of the building's water heaters and require a permanent fix.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Proactive rental inspection and habitability enforcement

emails.subject: Scanning everyone
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

Scanning every car that drives past our house feels like the city is tracking us for no good reason.

Please do not approve plate readers on residential streets.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Outdated water study for new homes
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

The developers of the housing complex next to us used an old water study from before the drought, and nobody has checked whether the aquifer can handle the new units. I live by Loop Road and Bernal Road with my family. The older homes on our street already report low pressure in the summer.

Please order an updated water supply analysis that reflects current drought conditions.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Keep the teen center open late
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

Late-night youth programs and summer jobs prevent more crime than another patrol car ever will. I'm writing on my lunch break, so I'll keep it short.

Please restore funding for youth programs in the public safety budget.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
Almaden Valley resident
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Pavement falling apart on our street
emails.body:
To the City Council,

Our street has had the same potholes for two years, and every repair crew only fills them for a few months. I have photos from each season showing the same spot breaking up again, and the repair dates never match the ticket notes. Our car repair bills have added up to more than my monthly grocery budget.

Please assign a permanent repair plan for our street instead of short-term patching.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Flooded loading dock
emails.body:
Hi,

I run a shop near the corner of Curtner Ave and Heritage Dr. Our loading dock sits lower than the street, and runoff from the storm drain backs up into our building. We had to throw out inventory last January when the water came in, and our insurance claim is still pending.

Please raise the priority of cleaning the storm drain next to our business loading dock.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Poste sin luz
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

El poste de la luz frente a mi casa está apagado desde hace casi tres semanas. Vivimos en Umbarger desde hace 27 años.

Les pido que lo reparen esta semana porque mis hijas tienen que caminar en la oscuridad.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Slow down the fourplex reform
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I've lived in Lincoln Glen since 2003. Our sewer lines and school classrooms are already at capacity, and fourplexes on every lot will make that worse. We bought here for the neighborhood as it is. This is my fourth email about it.

Please vote no on citywide fourplexes.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: Couch dumped on the sidewalk for two weeks
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

We live just off Vistapark Dr near Bluefield Dr. We moved here in 1996 and we'd like to stay. People dump old tires and paint cans by the creek path behind our homes. It smells and the rats are getting into yards. I reported it in the app and the pickup took eighteen days.

Please clean it up and put a camera at this spot. I'm happy to talk to staff about it.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Xe rác không tới đúng giờ
emails.body:
Xin chào,

Tôi sống gần Bucknall Rd và Woodglen Dr. Xe rác không đến đúng lịch trong hai tuần qua, và thùng rác của khu chung cư đầy tràn. Mấy người ở đây phải để túi rác ngoài hành lang và mùi hôi rất khó chịu.

Mong thành phố kiểm tra lịch thu gom và báo lại cho cư dân biết.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Concerns about license plate cameras
emails.body:
Hi,

I don't want my daily movements logged by surveillance cameras with no clear rule on who can see the data. My house is right at Yerba Buena Rd and Fowler Rd. There's no public data retention policy in the staff report.

I OPPOSE expanding surveillance cameras without a privacy ordinance first.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Ý kiến về giới hạn tăng tiền thuê
emails.body:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Tôi cho thuê một căn nhà nhỏ và chi phí bảo trì, bảo hiểm tăng liên tục nên giới hạn hiện nay làm tôi khó xoay sở. Gia đình tôi ở gần McKean Road và Cahen Drive. Tôi đã phải hoãn sửa mái nhà hai năm vì không đủ tiền thu từ tiền thuê.

Tôi đề nghị hội đồng xem xét cho phép tăng thêm khi chủ nhà có chi phí thực tế được chứng minh.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Proyecto nuevo y charcos
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

Si construyen el proyecto nuevo de vivienda, el agua de lluvia va a bajar directo a las casas de abajo. Ya hay charcos cada vez que llueve fuerte. Mi sótano se inundó en 2019 y nadie del gobierno nos explicó por qué.

Pido que la ciudad revise el plan de drenaje y exija bombas o tanques de retención.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Vivienda asequible para trabajadores
emails.body:
Buenas tardes,

Trabajo en una fábrica y mi sueldo no alcanza para pagar un departamento, aunque trabajo todos los días. Muchos compañeros duermen en carros o se mudan lejos porque no encuentran algo accesible. Un fondo de vivienda asequible podría cambiar eso para la gente que trabaja todos los días.

Les pido que aprueben el fondo de vivienda asequible y que den prioridad a los trabajadores de bajos ingresos.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Car break-ins on our street
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

My neighbor's catalytic converter was cut off in broad daylight last week. This is my third email about it.

Please fund faster police response for property crime.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: 小餐馆与停车压力
emails.body:
我在这条街上经营一家小餐馆，新的住宅楼如果建成，门口的停车位会更加紧张，外卖和送货车也会堵在路上。 每到周末晚上，街口已经排了很长的车，顾客经常找不到车位。

希望城市在审批前评估停车和送货车的影响，并要求开发商提供停车方案。

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Đường băng qua nguy hiểm
emails.body:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Tôi sống ở khu Mount Pleasant Foothills. Gần trường học không có vạch qua đường và xe chạy rất nhanh. Tôi làm ca đêm và về nhà lúc 1 giờ sáng.

Xin thành phố làm vạch qua đường và đèn báo.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.to: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
emails.subject: Hồ sơ xin phép sửa nhà
emails.body:
Xin chào,

Tôi nộp hồ sơ xin phép sửa nhà từ tháng Năm nhưng đến nay vẫn chưa có kết quả. Mỗi lần gọi họ chỉ nói hồ sơ đang chờ xử lý. Tôi phải thuê nhà tạm vì căn bếp đã tháo dỡ mà chưa được xây lại.

Mong thành phố cho biết hồ sơ đang ở bước nào và đẩy nhanh việc duyệt.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Streetlights out on our block
emails.body:
Hi,

I work nights, so I see this at 1 a.m. most days. I live in Shasta Hanchett Park. Two streetlights near the bus stop have been out since the last storm.

Please prioritize the streetlight maintenance contract and fix our block.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Drain clogged again
emails.body:
Hello,

We live just off Laddie Way near Brigadoon Way. Water pools across the whole intersection after any storm because the drain is blocked. Kids walking to school have to wade through it. Last winter it got into two of our neighbors' garages.

I SUPPORT funding storm drain upgrades on residential streets. Thank you for reading this.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Please fix our streetlights
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

Three streetlights on our block have been out for almost a month. It's the darkest stretch in the neighborhood now. I reported it through the app twice and got an automatic reply both times.

I SUPPORT funding a faster repair crew and theft-proof wiring. This has gone on long enough.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Unsafe crossing near the school
emails.body:
The crossing by the elementary school has no signal and drivers do fifty through it. A crossing guard was nearly hit in September. I'm a pharmacist and a parent of 1. We asked for a traffic study two years ago.

Please install a flashing beacon and a marked crosswalk this year. I hope this gets on someone's list.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
Buena Vista resident
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Five-story building next to homes
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

I've lived in Hellyer since 2010. The developer wants a five-story building right next to a single-family street, and the zoning would let them block our afternoon sun. We are not against housing, just against a building that size in the middle of a quiet block. Our homes are one and two stories, and the new building would tower over the back fences.

Please keep the height limit at three stories along our side of the street.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: Air monitor too far from site
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

Our family has been in La Pala for 16 years. The developer's air study for the new apartment complex used data from a monitor six miles away, not from the lot itself. The truck route in the report goes right past the playground where my daughter's school lets out. We already breathe dust from the freeway, and I am not sure this report accounts for that. A new monitor placed on the site would give us real numbers.

Please require an air monitor on the site and a corrected truck route analysis before approval.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Gas and bills
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

Gas is expensive and my electric bill jumped again, and I am on a fixed income. The car repair last month cost more than my whole grocery budget.

Please help people like me stay ahead of these costs.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Tired of the loop
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

Our neighbor who is unhoused gets moved along by police every few weeks and returns to the same corner within a day.

Please coordinate outreach so people get connected to services rather than just moved along.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: We need a crosswalk
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

I'm a District 10 resident. The crossing by the elementary school has no signal and drivers do fifty through it. I work nights, so I see this at 3 a.m. most days.

I SUPPORT equal traffic-safety funding for every neighborhood, not just the loudest ones.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Rooftop solar permit stalled
emails.body:
To the City Council,

We applied for a rooftop solar permit in February, and the online portal still says 'under review.' The installer has our panels sitting in the garage. Every month we wait is another bill with no savings, and we have already paid the full fee. The installer keeps asking whether we have heard anything.

Please post a realistic processing timeline for residential solar permits and move ours forward.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Cost of living
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

Everything in this city costs more every year and nobody in charge seems to notice. We're thinking about leaving the Bay Area.

I just wanted someone to hear it.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Negocio y robos
emails.body:
Hola,

Vivo en Spanish Cove. Tengo una tienda de reparación de llantas y dos veces este año me robaron las herramientas de la parte de atrás. La policía tardó más de dos horas en venir ambas veces y después ya no quise llamar.

Les pido que pongan más patrullas en las zonas comerciales por la noche.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Medical bills and a car
emails.body:
Hi,

I live at the corner of South Kiely Boulevard and Norwalk Drive. The ER bill from last spring is still unpaid, and now my car needs repairs to get to my new job. Using the bus adds two hours a day, which I cannot afford either.

Please tell me whether there is a hospital charity program I can apply to.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Trucks and dust
emails.body:
Hello,

Heavy trucks going past the freeway ramp kick up so much dust that my kid's asthma flared up twice this month. My family and I live in College Park. We keep the windows closed in the summer, which makes the apartment too hot.

I want the city to require water trucks or street sweeping on our route.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: No heat and mold in our apartment
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

Our apartment has had black mold in the bathroom and bedroom since spring and the landlord just paints over it. I called code enforcement and was told the wait is weeks. Other tenants are afraid to complain.

I SUPPORT proactive rental inspections so tenants don't have to fight alone. This has gone on long enough.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Proactive rental inspection and habitability enforcement

emails.subject: Appointments
emails.body:
To the City Council,

Every time the council fills a commission seat it seems to go to someone who has already donated to a campaign.

Please publish the applicant list and donor disclosures before any appointment vote.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Catalytic converter thefts
emails.body:
To the City Council,

Package theft and car break-ins on our block have doubled this year. My house is right at Almaden Expressway and Foxworthy Avenue. We put up cameras ourselves. Nobody even called back about the report.

I SUPPORT more patrols and community service officers in our area. This has gone on long enough.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Trash in the bushes
emails.body:
To the City Council,

We live near the corner of North Capitol Avenue and Giannotta Way. Bags of trash are piled in the bushes by the trail entrance again.

Can someone clear it out this week?

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Yes on fourplexes
emails.body:
Hello,

We've lived in Santa Teresa for 11 years. I'd like to build a small fourplex on my lot so my parents and my daughter can live nearby. Every older neighborhood here already has duplexes and nobody notices them.

I SUPPORT the fourplex reform. Please approve it.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: Truck trips missing from traffic count
emails.body:
The proposed warehouse would add about four hundred truck trips a day on our two-lane road, and the traffic report counted only passenger cars.

Please require the traffic study to count truck trips and include our street in the analysis.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: 社区街灯问题
emails.body:
尊敬的市议会：

我们街区的路灯已经坏了一个多月，晚上非常黑，老人不敢出门散步。我已经在网上报修两次，但一直没有人来修理。

请尽快派人修好路灯。谢谢！

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Muchachos en la calle
emails.body:
Buenas tardes,

Los muchachos de la cuadra andan en la calle hasta la madrugada porque no hay nada para ellos, y ya hubo una pelea grande. Nosotros vivimos cerca de Saddle Brook Dr y Canyon Trail Way desde hace 9 años. Yo sé que la mayoría son buenos chicos, pero les falta algo que hacer.

Les pido que pongan un programa nocturno de deportes o clases para los jóvenes.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Our commercial strip gets ignored
emails.body:
Hello,

Our shops are on a road that has been on the repair list for three years while corridors in other parts of town get repaved every year. Customers avoid parking near our storefronts because the pavement is so bad, and that hurts sales.

Please schedule our road for repaving on the same cycle as other commercial corridors.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Let us build more homes
emails.body:
We live just off Prescott Ave near Crowder Ave. Allowing fourplexes on single-family lots is a modest change that lets neighborhoods grow gently. I'm retired and I walk the neighborhood every morning. Every older neighborhood here already has duplexes and nobody notices them. We need housing near jobs and transit.

I SUPPORT the fourplex reform. Please approve it. I'm happy to talk to staff about it.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: Todo está muy caro
emails.body:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

Mi esposo y yo trabajamos en la limpieza de oficinas. Todo sube y los sueldos no. No sé qué pueden hacer, pero por favor piensen en nosotros.

Solo quería que lo supieran.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Mattresses and trash dumped on our street
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

My wife and I talk about this every week. I own a small business near Kirk Road and Foxworthy Avenue. There is a pile of dumped furniture and trash bags on the sidewalk that has been there two weeks. I reported it in the app and the pickup took eighteen days.

I SUPPORT more dumping enforcement and faster cleanup.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Thanks for hearing renters
emails.body:
Hello,

I am a renter who really wants the council to care about people who get pushed out. We live near the corner of Hanchett Ave and Sequoia Ave. Many of my friends have moved away from the area because of this problem, and I think that is sad.

I hope the council keeps working on tenant protections in the coming months.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Basura en la calle
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

Nosotros vivimos cerca de Almaden Expressway y Foxworthy Avenue desde hace 12 años. Los botes de basura de la calle están llenos y la gente deja bolsas afuera.

Por favor vacíenlos más seguido.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Old sofa
emails.body:
An old sofa is sitting at the end of our driveway and nobody has picked it up.

Please send someone to take it away.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Giấy phép chờ quá lâu
emails.body:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Tôi sống gần Charlotte Drive và Raleigh Road. Tôi chờ giấy phép sửa nhà hơn năm tháng rồi. Mỗi lần lại đòi thêm giấy tờ. Tôi làm ca đêm và về nhà lúc 5 giờ sáng.

Xin thành phố giải quyết giấy phép nhanh hơn.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Không có nước nóng
emails.body:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Gia đình tôi ở gần Trinidad Dr và Akio Way. Máy nước nóng trong căn hộ của tôi đã hỏng từ tuần trước. Chủ nhà hẹn sửa nhưng đến giờ vẫn chưa có ai đến.
