Xin thành phố cử thanh tra đến kiểm tra và yêu cầu chủ nhà sửa máy nước nóng.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Proactive rental inspection and habitability enforcement

emails.subject: Boiler failure in a rental unit
emails.body:
Hi,

The tenant in unit three reports the boiler has been shutting off for days at a time, and the thermostat in the hall barely responds. I hired a licensed plumber who said the heat exchanger needs replacing, and that job is expensive. My house is right at Sierra Rd and Braebridge Rd. The tenant has a toddler and is asking me to move them to a hotel, which I cannot afford. I want to do this right, so I am asking what permit and inspection steps apply before I start the replacement.

Please tell me what permit and inspection the city requires for a boiler replacement in a rental.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Elección especial
emails.body:
Buenas tardes,

Creo que cuando se vacía un lugar en el concejo debe haber una elección especial, porque la gente de aquí merece escoger a su representante. Cuando el lugar se llenó sin votación, mucha gente sintió que las decisiones ya estaban hechas. Eso no debe repetirse en nuestra ciudad.

Les pido que pongan la elección especial en la boleta antes de nombrar a alguien.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Insurance costs and the cap
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

Our small rental business cannot absorb a cap that stays flat while insurance keeps climbing. We've lived in Vinci Park for 9 years.

Please build in an adjustment for insurance and repair costs when setting the cap.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: More homes please
emails.body:
Hi,

Rents keep climbing because there are too few homes for the number of people who want to live here.

Please approve more small multi-unit homes in every part of the city.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: 热水器长期不能用
emails.body:
我租住的公寓热水器已经坏了两个星期，房东一直说会派人来修，但到现在也没有人来。冬天洗澡只能用冷水，老人和孩子都很难受。 我们已经用微信和书面信件通知过房东三次。

希望城市派检查员来检查，并要求房东尽快修好热水器。

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Bụi từ xe tải
emails.body:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Gia đình tôi ở gần Trinidad Dr và Mt Pakron Dr. Xe tải chạy gần đường cao tốc làm bụi bay vào nhà tôi suốt cả ngày. Con gái tôi bị hen suyễn và phải dùng thuốc xịt thường xuyên hơn.

Mong thành phố tưới nước hoặc quét đường thường xuyên ở khu này.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Just-cause rules for owners
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I am a retired homeowner with one rental unit and I need to know the rules before I ever evict anyone.

Please post clear just-cause rules so owners like me can follow them correctly.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Humedad y moho en el cuarto
emails.body:
Hola,

En mi cuarto hay humedad y manchas negras en la pared desde el invierno pasado. Cada vez que llueve entra agua por la ventana rota y el dueño no la ha arreglado. Mi hija tiene asma y el doctor dice que el moho le empeora la respiración.

Pido que la ciudad revise la humedad y el moho y que se obligue al dueño a repararlo.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Support backyard units
emails.body:
Hi,

I want to build a small backyard unit so my parents can live close to us without moving far.

Please keep the process for backyard units fast and make permit fees affordable.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Recording meetings
emails.body:
Hello,

Meetings should be recorded and posted online so people who cannot come still know what was decided. I live in Thousand Oaks. My mom is a caregiver and cannot leave the house in the afternoon, but she follows city news closely on the radio. We should not need to attend in person to hold the council accountable.

Please record every commission meeting and post the video within 48 hours.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: 老人中心开放时间
emails.body:
市议员您好：

老人活动中心把开放时间减少到每周三天，我母亲现在大部分时间一个人在家吃午饭，很孤单。

请恢复原来的开放时间。谢谢。
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Basura sa daan
emails.body:
Hindi nakukuha ang basura namin sa tapat ng bahay nang tatlong linggo na, kaya dumarami ang daga. Nagrereklamo na rin ang mga kapitbahay pero wala pa ring pumupunta.

Pakisuri po ang ruta ng trak at tiyaking makukuha ang basura sa takdang araw.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Agua y drenaje para las casas nuevas
emails.body:
Hola,

Hay muchas construcciones nuevas y la tubería del agua en mi calle ya tiene fugas frecuentes.

Les pido que revisen la capacidad de agua y drenaje antes de aprobar más proyectos.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.to: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
emails.subject: Tiếng ồn xa lộ
emails.body:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Nhà tôi sát xa lộ, bụi và tiếng ồn suốt ngày. Tôi đã sống ở thành phố này 17 năm.

Xin xây tường cách âm và trồng cây.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: ADU permit stuck in plan check
emails.body:
Hi,

I've lived in Ocala since 2015. Our backyard ADU application has been sitting in plan check since June with no comments from the city. We have paid the fees and answered every question the reviewer sent.

Please assign a plan checker to finish the review or tell us exactly what is still missing.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Calle oscura otra vez
emails.body:
Hola,

Es la segunda vez que escribo. Varias luces de la calle están apagadas desde hace un mes.

Por favor manden a alguien a repararlas.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Speeding on our street
emails.body:
I work nights, so I see this at 1 a.m. most days. The crossing by the elementary school has no signal and drivers do fifty through it.

Please install a flashing beacon and a marked crosswalk this year.

Regards,
[name removed]
McKean resident
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Streetlight out since the storm
emails.body:
Hi,

The light pole at the end of our street has been out since the last big storm and no one has come to fix it. I have seen city trucks parked nearby on other days, so this should not be hard to schedule.

Please add this pole to the next repair list and tell us the date.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Creek flooding on our street
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I live at the corner of W Walbrook Dr and Heckman Way. Every time the creek rises, our street gets water up to the curb, and the proposed warehouse would cover more ground.

Please require the developer to show how the site will drain without adding water to our street.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Landlord won't fix anything
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

Our apartment has had black mold in the bathroom and bedroom since spring and the landlord just paints over it. I called code enforcement and was told the wait is weeks. I've been in this city 9 years and I've never written before.

Please send an inspector and hold the landlord accountable.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Dangerous pothole
emails.body:
Hello,

My house is right at Red Maple Way and Trailside Ln. The pothole patch from last year already crumbled and the hole is back, deeper. Cyclists have to swerve into traffic to avoid it.

I SUPPORT more road-repair funding for residential streets.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Permisos tardan demasiado
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

Llevo meses esperando el permiso para una pequeña remodelación. Nosotros vivimos cerca de Thackeray Lane y Lido Way desde hace 4 años. Llegamos en 1988 y queremos quedarnos.

Por favor simplifiquen el proceso de permisos.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Senior lunch hours
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I've been a homeowner near Glen Angus Way and Tully Rd for 27 years. The senior lunch program closes too early and I cannot make it there after my doctor visits.

Please extend the meal hours on Fridays.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Lost my job
emails.body:
Hello,

I got laid off last week and I have no idea how I will cover next month's rent.

Please tell me where to get emergency rent help.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Civilian responders
emails.body:
To the City Council,

I think trained civilians should handle mental health crises instead of officers, because officers are not trained for them and it often goes badly. We live near the corner of Curie Dr and Galen Dr. My neighbor's son was taken to jail after a psychotic episode and released a week later with no treatment. The city already runs other social programs, so it can run this one too.

Please fund a civilian crisis response program with clinicians and peer support workers and report on the first year.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Dangerous pothole
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

The road surface on our block is so broken that delivery trucks swerve into the bike lane. Cyclists have to swerve into traffic to avoid it. My neighbor's tire blew out on it in March.

I SUPPORT more road-repair funding for residential streets. I'm happy to talk to staff about it.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: No heat and mold in our apartment
emails.body:
To the City Council,

The heater in our unit has been broken since November and the landlord says it's not urgent. My mother uses a wheelchair, so this matters a lot. Other tenants are afraid to complain. My daughter has asthma and it's getting worse.

I SUPPORT proactive rental inspections so tenants don't have to fight alone. We will keep watching how the council votes.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Proactive rental inspection and habitability enforcement

emails.subject: Hoyo peligroso
emails.body:
Buenas tardes,

Nosotros vivimos cerca de Arbuckle Drive y Crowder Avenue desde hace 9 años. Hay un hoyo a la orilla de la calle que ya le rompió la llanta a mi vecina.

Les pido que lo tapen y pongan señal hasta que venga la cuadrilla.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Parking can't keep up
emails.body:
Our block has too few spots already, and the new apartments going up are not providing enough parking. Delivery trucks block the lane almost every morning, and I have had to park three streets away.

Please require developers to pay for added parking or transit before new projects are approved.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Behind on utilities
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I am two months behind on water and power, and the shutoff notice came in the mail today.

Please tell me where to apply for utility bill help.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Still waiting on our street
emails.body:
We keep calling about the same broken curb and nothing happens, even though the blocks nearby got done last summer.

Please move our street up the list so families here get the same service as everyone else.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Giữ giờ mở cửa trung tâm người cao tuổi
emails.body:
Xin chào,

Trung tâm người cao tuổi giảm giờ mở cửa, mẹ tôi không còn nơi gặp bạn bè. Tôi sống gần Sierra Rd và Braebridge Rd. Bà rất buồn và cô đơn. Gia đình tôi có 2 con nhỏ.

Xin giữ nguyên giờ mở cửa như trước.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Landlord won't fix anything
emails.body:
The heater in our unit has been broken since November and the landlord says it's not urgent. I work nights, so I see this at 1 a.m. most days. I've lived in Palmhaven since 2003.

Please send an inspector and hold the landlord accountable.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Unsafe crossing near the school
emails.body:
Hi,

I live by Bucknall Road and Woodglen Drive with my family. Cars speed down our street every morning and there is no marked crosswalk for the kids. A crossing guard was nearly hit in September.

Please install a flashing beacon and a marked crosswalk this year.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Trash pile on the trail
emails.body:
Hello,

There is a big pile of construction scraps just off the creek trail where people walk their dogs every morning. I've lived in San Tomas Aquino Park since 2010. I reported it through the app and got a case number but no crew has come yet.

Please send someone to haul it away as soon as possible.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Eviction after a complaint
emails.body:
To the City Council,

I was given thirty days to leave after I asked the office to fix the back door lock. The notice did not give a reason, and I believe it was because of the complaint I filed with the city. My daughter has asthma and I cannot move her across town during the school year.

Please pass protections that bar eviction notices filed within six months of a city complaint.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Youth over patrol
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I think the money should go to youth programs rather than patrols, because the teen center closed and the kids in my building have nowhere to go. My daughter is thirteen and spends the nights alone, and I work doubles so I cannot be there. Programs that keep her busy would do more than any patrol car on our street.

Please move part of the proposed patrol increase into late-night youth programs in the next budget.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Bache en la calle
emails.body:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

Hay un bache enorme en medio de la calle y los carros dan vuelta para no caerse.

Les pido que lo rellenen esta semana antes de que alguien tenga un accidente.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Ổ gà nguy hiểm trên đường
emails.body:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Gia đình tôi ở gần Glenview Dr và Hollow Lake Way. Có một ổ gà rất lớn trên đường nhà tôi từ mấy tháng nay. Tôi đã báo nhiều lần. Chúng tôi đến đây từ năm 1996.

Xin thành phố cho sửa đường sớm.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Senior bus pass
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

The reduced fare card for seniors is hard to renew, and I missed the deadline last time.

Please make the renewal available online for older adults.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Preguntas de papeles
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

Cuando llamamos a la policía por un robo, lo primero que preguntan los oficiales es si tenemos papeles. Vivo cerca de Yerba Buena Road y Fowler Road.

Les pido que la policía de aquí no pregunte por el estatus migratorio al reportar un delito.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Dangerous pothole
emails.body:
Hello,

I've been in this city 26 years and I've never written before. I live in Baker West. Crews patched one pothole on our street and left four others right next to it. We pay our share of taxes and the street looks abandoned.

I SUPPORT more road-repair funding for residential streets.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Bathroom remodel on hold
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

Our bathroom remodel permit has been on hold for six weeks because a single inspection report hasn't been logged.

Please check why the inspection report is missing and clear the hold.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.to: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
emails.subject: Giá cả quá đắt
emails.body:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Tiền nhà, tiền chợ, tiền xăng đều tăng, gia đình tôi rất khó khăn. Gia đình tôi có 1 con nhỏ.

Tôi chỉ muốn quý vị biết.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Basura tirada en la calle
emails.body:
Buenas tardes,

Hay colchones y basura tirados junto al arroyo. Mi esposa y yo trabajamos en la limpieza de oficinas.

Por favor vengan a limpiar pronto.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Oppose workarounds
emails.body:
To the City Council,

I live by Yerba Buena Rd and Altia Ave with my family. I want the council to oppose any local measure that tries to get around the property tax limits that have kept my taxes predictable.

Please take a stand against any local property tax measure that uses a loophole around the state limits.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Mga camera sa kalsada
emails.body:
Sa tingin ko makakatulong ang mga camera sa kalsada para mahuli ang mga magnanakaw ng sasakyan sa aming lugar. Pero sana may malinaw na patakaran kung gaano katagal itatago ang mga video at sino ang makakakita nito.

Sana po ay magkaroon muna ng pampublikong pagdinig bago pumasok ang mga bagong camera sa aming kalye.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Rec field evenings
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

My house is right at Seven Trees Boulevard and Rancho Drive. The city cut evening hours at the rec field this summer, so the kids who used to play soccer until dark are back on the street. The sign-up fees went up to cover rentals, and most families cannot afford it.

Please restore the evening recreation hours and cover the costs with the existing youth budget.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Cống bị nghẹt
emails.body:
Xin chào,

Mỗi lần mưa nước ngập vào sân vì cống bị nghẹt. Tôi làm ca đêm và về nhà lúc 5 giờ sáng. Nước tràn vào nhà hàng xóm.

Xin cho người đến thông cống trước mùa mưa.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
Cư dân khu English Estates
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Landlord won't fix anything
emails.body:
Our apartment has had black mold in the bathroom and bedroom since spring and the landlord just paints over it. I live near Skylark Dr and Kingfisher Dr. My husband uses a wheelchair, so this matters a lot. My daughter has asthma and it's getting worse.

Please send an inspector and hold the landlord accountable.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.to: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
emails.subject: Sửa đường chậm ở khu chúng tôi
emails.body:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Khu nhà của chúng tôi chờ sửa đường lâu hơn nhiều so với các khu khá giả hơn trong thành phố. Đường bị hư đã hơn một năm trong khi các con đường gần đó được sửa xong trong vài tuần.

Tôi đề nghị thành phố công bố thời gian sửa chữa theo từng khu vực để mọi người được đối xử công bằng.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Entregas en el terreno comercial
emails.body:
Hola,

Quieren cambiar el terreno a uso comercial y eso significa camiones de entrega todo el día frente a nuestras casas. Ya hay ruido y basura desde que cerró la tienda vieja. Mi mamá vive sola y ya no puede cruzar la calle por el tráfico de los fines de semana.

Pido que la ciudad limite los horarios de entrega y revise el impacto en la calle antes de aprobar el cambio.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Streetlight out for weeks
emails.body:
Hello,

The streetlight in front of my house has been out for almost three weeks and the block is pitch black at night.

Please repair the streetlight on my block and check the wiring for theft.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Permit fee increase
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

Raising permit fees again while review times keep growing is backwards. I work nights, so I see this at 3 a.m. most days. I own a small business near N King Rd and Lundy Ave. Small contractors pass these costs straight to homeowners.

I OPPOSE the fee increase unless it pays for more plan check staff.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Illegal dumping again
emails.body:
To the City Council,

The vacant lot next to us has become a dump site for appliances and bags of trash. My house is right at Colony Crest Dr and Chynoweth Ave. I'm writing on my lunch break, so I'll keep it short.

Please clean it up and put a camera at this spot.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: We need more patrols
emails.body:
My neighbor's catalytic converter was cut off in broad daylight last week. I've been in this city 4 years and I've never written before. Nobody even called back about the report.

Please fund faster police response for property crime.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Centro para personas mayores
emails.body:
Hola,

El centro para personas mayores redujo sus horas y mi mamá ya no tiene a dónde ir. Nosotros vivimos cerca de East Julian Street y North 13th Street desde hace 30 años. Ella se siente muy sola. Trabajo de noche y llego a casa a las 3.

Por favor regresen el horario completo.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Todo está muy caro
emails.body:
Buenas tardes,

Nosotros vivimos cerca de Castlemont Avenue y Payne Avenue desde hace 3 años. La renta sube cada año y el súper cada mes, ya no alcanza el sueldo.

Pido que la ciudad busque la manera de ayudar a las familias que trabajamos.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Streetlights out on our block
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

The streetlight in front of our house has been flickering and then off entirely for six weeks. I've been a homeowner near Rubion Dr and Marten Ave for 23 years. My son and I talk about this every week. I reported it through the app twice and got an automatic reply both times.

I OPPOSE renewing a contract that leaves lights out this long.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Data center groundwater draw
emails.body:
To the City Council,

We live just off Ford Rd near Summer Dr. The proposed data center plans to pull groundwater for cooling, and the report only says the impact will be 'minimal.' Nobody has told us what minimal means for the wells that homes on our street still use. Our neighbor's well went dry in 2022 during the drought, and the county never investigated. Once a project draws from the same layer, the impact is hard to undo.

Please require the developer to quantify groundwater draw and commit to recycled water for cooling.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Terra Verde data center: EIR certification and site development permit

emails.subject: Storm drain backs up every rain
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

This is my second email about it. The storm drain on our block has been clogged with leaves and silt since October. I live in Pinehurst.

Please have Public Works clear the drain before the rainy season.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Rent went up again
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

Another increase notice showed up in my mailbox and I am tired of guessing what the next one will be. I live at the corner of Lanning Way and N Jackson Ave. I have rented in the same place for nine years, and the total increase now is almost a third of my monthly pay.

I hope the council keeps caring about renters when it reviews these rules.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: El bache sigue ahí
emails.body:
Hola,

El bache de nuestra calle dañó la llanta de mi carro. Lo reporté varias veces. Llevo 16 años en esta ciudad.

Me opongo a que lo dejen así tanto tiempo.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Cost of living
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

I rent an apartment near Blossom River Way and Winfield Boulevard. Between rent, groceries and gas, my family is falling further behind every month. We're thinking about leaving the Bay Area.

I just wanted someone to hear it.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Ổ gà nguy hiểm trên đường
emails.body:
Xin chào,

Có một ổ gà rất lớn trên đường nhà tôi từ mấy tháng nay. Tôi sống gần McKean Road và Cahen Drive. Xe máy và xe đạp rất dễ bị ngã. Tôi làm ca đêm và về nhà lúc 5 giờ sáng.

Xin thành phố cho sửa đường sớm.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Vacancy tax
emails.body:
I support a new local tax on vacant units owned by large companies, since they are not paying their share.

Please put a vacancy tax measure on the ballot with a simple majority threshold.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Sharing a two-bedroom
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

I share a two-bedroom with my sister and her two kids because nothing else in our price range is available. I rent an apartment near Coakley Drive and Holly Hock Court. If the city allowed more small buildings in areas that already have buses and sidewalks, we would have more options. We are tired of waiting on lists that never seem to move.

Please let fourplexes and small apartments be built on more lots so that families can find homes.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: Water reaching the garage
emails.body:
During the last big storm, water came up over the curb and reached the edge of our garage door. I live by Bay Laurel Ln and Suncrest Ave with my family. We have lived here for twenty years and this is the first time it has come that close. Our neighbor down the block had water inside his shed, and he is still cleaning up the mess.

Please review the drainage capacity on our block and fix any bottleneck the review finds.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Chairs and a TV
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

Someone left a TV and three folding chairs in the alley by our garage, and they have been there for over a week. The rain has ruined the chairs and the TV is starting to leak something onto the pavement.

I want the city to remove them and tell residents how to request a bulky pickup.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Paint cans in the gutter
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I live near Farnsworth Dr and Courtside Dr. Somebody emptied paint cans and motor oil into the gutter near the creek bridge, and it runs right toward the water. The smell is strong enough that we keep the windows shut in the afternoon.

Please have someone test it and clean it up before the next rain.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Customers in crisis
emails.body:
Hello,

I run a shop near the corner of Meridian Avenue and Patio Drive. Our coffee shop keeps getting customers in crisis who need help, and we are not trained for that. Last month a customer had a psychotic episode at the counter and I had to call police, which I hate doing.

Please fund a mental health responder program that businesses can call instead of the police.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Dumping near the bus stop
emails.body:
To the City Council,

People are leaving bags of trash and a broken dresser right next to the bus stop on our corner. Seniors waiting for the bus have to stand in the street to avoid it.

Could the city remove it and check if the bus stop area needs a camera?

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Rodent smell under the unit
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

There is a dead rat smell in the crawlspace under my unit, and the building has droppings by the back door. I live at the corner of Downing Avenue and Rickenbacker Street.

Please send an inspector to check for rodents and require the owner to seal the entry points.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: dumping problem
emails.body:
To the City Council,

There is a pile of dumped furniture and trash bags on the sidewalk that has been there two weeks. I run a shop near the corner of Tobin Dr and Camargo Dr. We cleaned it up ourselves twice and it came right back. It smells and the rats are getting into yards.

Please clean it up and put a camera at this spot. Thank you for reading this.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Giá cả tăng quá
emails.body:
Xin chào,

Tôi sống gần Piedmont Road và Salinas Court. Giá thực phẩm và tiền điện mỗi tháng đều tăng, gia đình tôi không còn đủ tiền để dành. Mỗi tháng tôi phải cắt bớt tiền đi chợ để trả hóa đơn điện.

Mong thành phố nghĩ đến người lao động thu nhập thấp khi đưa ra quyết định.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Streetlights out on our block
emails.body:
Hi,

I live near Rancho Drive and Seven Trees Boulevard. Two streetlights near the bus stop have been out since the last storm.

I SUPPORT funding a faster repair crew and theft-proof wiring.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Another mattress
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

We live near the corner of Gaundabert Ln and Chynoweth Ave. Another mattress showed up on the corner last night, right next to the stop sign.

Please remove it and check the corner more often.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.to: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
emails.subject: Đổ rác bừa bãi bên suối
emails.body:
Xin chào,

Có người đổ đồ đạc cũ, bao rác và gạch vỡ dọc bờ suối đi bộ phía sau nhà tôi. Gia đình tôi ở gần Saddle Brook Drive và Branham Lane. Các bạn nhỏ hay chạy qua đó nên tôi rất lo về kim tiêm hoặc mảnh kính. Tôi đã gọi cho đường dây 311 hai lần nhưng sau đó nhiều rác hơn lại xuất hiện.

Mong thành phố dọn sạch và đặt lịch kiểm tra định kỳ dọc bờ suối.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Cold shower and cracked wall
emails.body:
Hi,

The shower only runs cold, and when I asked for a fix the landlord sent a handyman who just tightened the knob. The grout behind the tub is also cracked enough that water seeps into the wall. My kids have to shower at my sister's place on weekends.

Please send an inspector to check the water supply and the wall damage in my unit.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Checklist for owners filing eviction
emails.body:
Hello,

I live by Ridgemont Drive and Ocala Avenue with my family. I manage my late father's old duplex and I want to follow the eviction rules without making a mistake. I have been told that the notice period differs depending on the reason, and I would like a clear list of each reason.

Please provide a checklist for owners who need to file for eviction.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Tope de renta anual
emails.body:
Hola,

Mi renta subió otra vez este año y ya no alcanza para la comida y la luz. Mi casero ni siquiera explicó por qué subió tanto, y cada año es lo mismo.

Les pido que mantengan el tope anual de renta y que no permitan excepciones para los dueños.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Free dump day
emails.body:
Hello,

We need a free dump day closer to our side of town.

Please schedule one this spring.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Camera money
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I do not see how a camera on the corner stops a break-in when the police never show up.

Please put the camera money toward patrol staffing instead.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Thuế tài sản
emails.body:
Xin chào,

Tôi không đồng ý tăng thuế địa phương vì thuế nhà đất ở đây đã cao hơn nhiều năm trước. Gia đình tôi ở gần Alexian Drive và North Jackson Avenue. Gia đình tôi đang dành dụm để trả nợ, và mỗi lần có thông báo tăng thuế là lại lo lắng.

Xin hội đồng bỏ phiếu chống bất kỳ đề xuất nào làm giảm ngưỡng bỏ phiếu.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Se inunda la calle
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

Trabajo de noche y llego a casa a las 11. Nosotros vivimos cerca de Payne Ave y Castlemont Ave desde hace 19 años. Cada vez que llueve la calle se inunda porque el drenaje está tapado.

Por favor limpien el drenaje antes de las lluvias.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Gutter overflow on our street
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I've been a homeowner near Kingfisher Dr and Skylark Dr for 12 years. The drain by my mailbox overflows every time there is a heavy rain and the sidewalk turns into a pond.

Please clean the drain and check whether the pipe underneath is cracked.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Las luces de la calle no funcionan
emails.body:
Buenas tardes,

Varias luces de la calle están apagadas desde hace un mes. Trabajo de noche y llego a casa a las 6. Nosotros vivimos cerca de Daylight Way y Pullman Way desde hace 11 años. Mis hijos caminan de noche y da miedo.

Por favor manden a alguien a repararlas.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Calle oscura otra vez
emails.body:
Hola,

Las luces de la calle llevan semanas apagadas en nuestra cuadra. Vivo cerca de Viceroy Way y Foxridge Way. Lo reporté por la aplicación y nadie vino. Trabajo de noche y llego a casa a las 2.

Por favor manden a alguien a repararlas.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Our street needs real repaving
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

I live near Trailside Ln and Trestlewood Dr. We moved here in 2011 and we'd like to stay. Crews patched one pothole on our street and left four others right next to it.

Please repave the block instead of patching it again.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Yes on fourplexes
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I'd like to build a small fourplex on my lot so my parents and my daughter can live nearby. We need housing near jobs and transit.

Please vote yes on the citywide fourplex zoning reform.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
Valley View Reed resident
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: Question about fourplex rules
emails.body:
To the City Council,

I am thinking about adding a fourplex on my lot and I want to understand the rules before I spend money. Some neighbors told me the process has changed twice in the last few years.

Could the city summarize recent fourplex rule changes in one place?

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Support the rent cap amendment
emails.body:
Hello,

I live in Las Plumas. I've been in this city 33 years and I've never written before. Our building changed owners and the first letter we got was a rent increase.

Please vote YES on the rent cap amendment.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Lost my contract
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

A big contract I was counting on fell through, and I am now behind on payroll for my two part-time workers. I do not want to lay them off but I may not have a choice next month.

I would like the city to tell me about any bridge loans or fee waivers for small businesses.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Dust from apartment construction
emails.body:
To the City Council,

I live by Rainbow Drive and Arlington Lane with my family. The study for the new apartment block near our building looked at hazardous soil but not construction dust, which would blow directly into our windows. Our kids have asthma. Construction could go on for two years, and we have no idea who will check the dust controls.

Please require a dust and construction noise plan with enforceable limits for the apartment project.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: We need a crosswalk
emails.body:
The crossing by the elementary school has no signal and drivers do fifty through it. I coach youth soccer and the families ask me about this. I own a small business near Croft Dr and Pavan Dr. A crossing guard was nearly hit in September.

I SUPPORT equal traffic-safety funding for every neighborhood, not just the loudest ones.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Pickup line busy
emails.body:
To the City Council,

The bulky pickup phone line is always busy when I call in the morning.

Please add an online option that works for renters.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Solar permit still pending
emails.body:
Hello,

I signed a lease for my bakery last winter and still can't open because the permit is stuck. I live in Valley Christian. This is my second email about it. The contractor is about to walk away.

I SUPPORT the permitting modernization, but please add plan checkers, not just software.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Sin agua caliente desde hace semanas
emails.body:
Buenas tardes,

Vivo en Thompson Creek. El calentador de agua de mi departamento no funciona desde hace casi tres semanas. Mi casera dice que va a mandar a alguien, pero nunca llega nadie. Tenemos dos niños pequeños y tenemos que calentar agua en la estufa para bañarlos.

Quisiera que la ciudad mande un inspector y obligue a que reparen el calentador.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Proactive rental inspection and habitability enforcement

emails.subject: Dark street again
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

The streetlight in front of our house has been flickering and then off entirely for six weeks. I'm retired and I walk the neighborhood every morning. My kids walk home from practice in the dark and I don't like it. Seniors on our street have stopped taking evening walks.

Please send a crew to repair these lights. This has gone on long enough.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Weekend meals
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

I've been a homeowner near Yerba Buena Road and Altia Avenue for 16 years. The meal delivery I depend on only comes on weekdays and my weekends are very long. I skipped dinner two Saturdays last month because the food ran out.

Please ask the program to add weekend deliveries for seniors who live alone.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Prevention over hiring
emails.body:
To the City Council,

We live just off Kirk Road near Foxworthy Avenue. I am against spending more on officers when we have not seen results from the current patrols on our street. My kids are scared of the crime, but I think money for after-school programs would do more than another round of hiring.

Please redirect new public safety money to youth and prevention programs instead of new hires.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.to: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
emails.subject: Khói từ đường cao tốc
emails.body:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Khói và bụi từ đường cao tốc bay vào sân nhà tôi mỗi chiều.

Mong thành phố trồng thêm cây chắn bụi dọc theo hàng rào.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Blighted property complaint
emails.body:
The abandoned property next door has a pool full of green water and the weeds are taller than the fence. Code enforcement opened a case and closed it without anything changing.

Please enforce the vacant building ordinance and fine the owner.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
Willow Glen resident
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Agua del pozo en riesgo
emails.body:
Hola,

Nos preocupa que el agua del pozo baje si construyen todas esas casas nuevas en la zona.

Pido que la ciudad exija un estudio del agua subterránea antes de aprobar el proyecto.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Dumping at night
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I think it is the same people every time, since the dumping always happens late at night after the restaurant lot closes. I saw a pickup truck last Thursday but could not read the plate in the dark.

Please add lighting or a camera on the alley side so the city can catch them.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Apoyo el límite de renta
emails.body:
Buenas tardes,

Nosotros vivimos cerca de Almaden Avenue y Floyd Street desde hace 15 años. Somos inquilinos y la renta ya es más de la mitad de nuestro sueldo. Mi esposo y yo trabajamos en la limpieza de oficinas.

Apoyo bajar el límite de aumento de renta. Por favor voten que sí.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Renter asking for a YES vote
emails.body:
To the City Council,

I'm a District 8 resident. My rent went up again this year and it now takes more than half my paycheck.

I SUPPORT lowering the annual rent-increase cap. Please vote yes.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Street lights have been out for weeks
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I've been in this city 40 years and I've never written before. Our whole block lost its streetlights after the wire theft in the spring and only one came back.

I SUPPORT funding a faster repair crew and theft-proof wiring.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Car break-ins on our street
emails.body:
Package theft and car break-ins on our block have doubled this year. People are scared to park on the street. Nobody even called back about the report.

I SUPPORT more patrols and community service officers in our area. I'm happy to talk to staff about it.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Humo cerca de la autopista
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

Nosotros vivimos cerca de Irwindale Dr y Aborn Rd desde hace 12 años. Hay humo de una quema cerca de la autopista y me arden los ojos otra vez.

Por favor avisen cuando la calidad del aire esté mala para quedarnos adentro.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Mattress by the fence
emails.body:
Hi,

I've lived in Blossom Valley since 1999. A mattress was dumped against our back fence, and the frame underneath is now on the sidewalk too. It is the third time this year the back fence has been used as a drop spot.

Please remove the whole pile and check the lot behind us for more.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Storm drain backs up every rain
emails.body:
Our association represents about 420 households in Cambrian Park. Every time it rains the storm drain at our curb backs up and water reaches the garages. Last winter it got into two of our neighbors' garages. Kids walking to school have to wade through it.

I SUPPORT funding storm drain upgrades on residential streets. I hope this gets on someone's list.

Thanks,
[name removed]
Chair
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Car break-ins on our street
emails.body:
To the City Council,

Someone tried to break into our garage at 3 a.m. and police took over an hour to come. People are scared to park on the street. We moved here in 1996 and we'd like to stay.

Please fund faster police response for property crime.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Catalytic converter thefts
emails.body:
Hi,

There have been five car break-ins on our street since August and two catalytic converter thefts. I coach youth soccer and the families ask me about this. People are scared to park on the street.

Please fund faster police response for property crime.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Contractor supports smaller homes
emails.body:
Hi,

I run a small contracting business and I have turned down jobs because the current rules make small projects too expensive. Smaller projects would keep my crew busy and bring more homes onto the market faster.

Please simplify the rules for adding one or two units on existing residential lots.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: Goteras y moho en el baño
emails.body:
Buenas tardes,

Desde que empezó la temporada de lluvias, el techo del baño tiene goteras y el moho ya llega hasta la cama de mi hijo. El dueño pintó encima sin reparar nada y el olor es insoportable. Nosotros vivimos cerca de Comanche Dr y Calero Ave desde hace 3 años. Mi hijo de seis años tiene alergias y ya fuimos dos veces a la clínica este mes. Hemos pagado el agua caliente por nuestra cuenta porque el calentador tampoco sirve.

Pido que la ciudad mande un inspector para obligar al dueño a reparar el techo y el calentador.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Proactive rental inspection and habitability enforcement

emails.subject: Estación de gasolina sin estudio de suelo
emails.body:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

La estación de gasolina que quieren construir enfrente de mi casa necesita revisar el suelo, pero el estudio solo llega hasta el frente del terreno. Hay tanques viejos que nadie ha revisado. Mi esposa tiene problemas de los pulmones y no quiero que el vapor de gasolina nos afecte.

Pido que la ciudad exija análisis del subsuelo en todo el terreno antes de aprobar el proyecto.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Caregiver tired
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

I am the only one who takes care of my dad and I am running out of ideas for respite help. I live at the corner of Gurdwara Avenue and John Sorci Drive.

Please share more respite care options for family caregivers.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: We need a crosswalk
emails.body:
Hi,

I live at the corner of Yerba Buena Rd and McLaughlin Ave. We moved here in 2011 and we'd like to stay. Other neighborhoods got flashing beacons at their school crossings years ago and we are still waiting.

I SUPPORT equal traffic-safety funding for every neighborhood, not just the loudest ones.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Ủng hộ quỹ nhà ở giá rẻ
emails.body:
Xin chào,

Tôi sống gần Terra Bella Ave và Lincoln Ave. Tôi là chủ nhà ở đây nhiều năm và ủng hộ việc dùng quỹ để xây nhà giá rẻ cho người lao động. Con cái của nhiều hàng xóm phải chuyển đi xa vì không đủ tiền thuê nhà gần trường.

Tôi mong hội đồng thông qua quỹ này và công khai tiến độ xây dựng.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Gastos del hospital
emails.body:
Buenas tardes,

Me llegó una factura del hospital por más de cinco mil dólares y no sé cómo pagarla. Vivo cerca de Ocala Ave y Darwin Way. Solo trabajo medio tiempo desde que me operaron y ya no alcanza.

Por favor díganme a qué programas de ayuda para gastos médicos puedo aplicar.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: We need a crosswalk
emails.body:
Hello,

We live near the corner of N 3rd St and E Julian St. The crossing by the elementary school has no signal and drivers do fifty through it. This is my fourth email about it. A crossing guard was nearly hit in September.

Please install a flashing beacon and a marked crosswalk this year.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Basura y muebles en la esquina
emails.body:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

En la esquina de mi casa siempre queda la basura de la semana sin recoger y la gente deja muebles encima. Vivimos en Dry Creek desde hace 20 años. Ya fui a la oficina de la ciudad dos veces y me dijeron que esperara. Mi hijo se pone enfermo del olor cuando hace calor y no tenemos a dónde irnos.

Pido que la ciudad ponga cámaras y pase más seguido por esa esquina.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Las luces de la calle no funcionan
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

Vivo en Owsley. Mi esposo y yo trabajamos en la limpieza de oficinas. Varias luces de la calle están apagadas desde hace un mes. Lo reporté por la aplicación y nadie vino.

Apoyo que la ciudad arregle las luces pronto.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Support fees tied to staffing
emails.body:
To the City Council,

I would support a fee increase if the money went toward hiring more plan checkers, because my ADU file has been waiting since spring. Right now the fees are being paid and the backlog keeps growing. We were quoted four months for a simple review, and the quote has already slipped twice.

Please tie any fee increase to a published plan-check staffing plan with target turnaround times.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Polvo de la carretera
emails.body:
Hola,

Hay mucho polvo de los camiones y se mete por las ventanas de mi departamento. Vivo cerca de Cooper River Drive y Fitchville Avenue.

Por favor limpien las calles de esa zona más seguido.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Follow-up after crisis calls
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I rent an apartment near Pacheco Dr and N Jackson Ave. Someone in our building has been having episodes in the stairwell for months, and the ambulance comes but the only follow-up is a ride to the emergency room. Our building manager has asked for help several times, but nothing has changed.

Please fund a follow-up team that connects people in crisis to a bed or a clinic after an emergency response.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: 关于租户保护的请求
emails.body:
我们一家住在出租屋里，房东突然发出搬离通知，没有说明理由。

希望市议会加强租户保护，禁止在没有正当理由的情况下驱逐租户。

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Robos en el vecindario
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

En mi cuadra ha habido varios robos a autos y casas. Llegamos en 2001 y queremos quedarnos. La policía tarda mucho en llegar.

Pedimos más vigilancia y que respondan a tiempo.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Road surface is falling apart
emails.body:
To the City Council,

My neighbor uses a wheelchair, so this matters a lot. We live near the corner of Williams Rd and Trifone Dr. The pothole patch from last year already crumbled and the hole is back, deeper. We pay our share of taxes and the street looks abandoned.

I SUPPORT more road-repair funding for residential streets.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Support funding for housing
emails.body:
Hi,

I work two jobs and still cannot afford a place that is not overcrowded. My family and I live in Los Alamitos Creek.

Please fund more affordable housing projects this year.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: 垃圾乱扔
emails.body:
我家门口的小巷经常有人扔床垫和旧家具。

希望市政府尽快清理，并加强巡查。

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Juntas de la ciudad
emails.body:
Hola,

Las reuniones de las comisiones son entre semana por la tarde y yo trabajo en la construcción, así que nunca puedo ir a hablar. Mi esposa tampoco puede faltar a su trabajo y nadie nos avisó que había intérprete en español.

Les pido que pongan intérpretes en las reuniones y que las hagan en horario de noche.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Speeding on our street
emails.body:
Other neighborhoods got flashing beacons at their school crossings years ago and we are still waiting. We asked for a traffic study two years ago. I work nights, so I see this at 5 a.m. most days.

Please install a flashing beacon and a marked crosswalk this year.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Bulky pickup policy
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

Our apartment managers say bulky item pickup must be scheduled by the owner, so renters have no way to request it. I live in Country Lane. Several tenants just put their old couches out on the curb and they sit there for weeks.

I want the city to let tenants schedule pickups directly through the 311 app.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Support townhomes with sidewalk access
emails.body:
Hi,

We live just off Santa Teresa Blvd near Miyuki Dr. I support the new townhome project on the empty parcel, as long as the builder keeps the sidewalk open during construction.

Please make sidewalk closures a permit condition, with daily noise and dust limits.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Storm drain backs up every rain
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

Water pools across the whole intersection after any storm because the drain is blocked. I coach youth soccer and the families ask me about this. I live in Playa del Rey.

Please have Public Works clear the drain before the rainy season.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Inoperable vehicles in driveway
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

We live near the corner of Renaissance Dr and Torrenzia Dr. A camper trailer has been sitting in the driveway next door since January with a flat tire, and it's now covered in leaves. Someone also has an old truck up on jacks in the side yard. Oil stains are running into the storm drain at the curb every time it rains.

Please have the vehicles inspected and removed if they are inoperable or stored illegally.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Catalytic converter thefts
emails.body:
Hi,

Someone tried to break into our garage at 3 a.m. and police took over an hour to come. I'm a small business owner and a parent of 4. We live just off Cherry Ave near Joplin Dr. People are scared to park on the street. We put up cameras ourselves.

I SUPPORT more patrols and community service officers in our area. We will keep watching how the council votes.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Library hours cut
emails.body:
To the City Council,

The senior lunch program is the only place many older neighbors see anyone all week. It costs very little compared to what it gives back. My mother and I talk about this every week.

Please restore the full senior center schedule. I'm happy to talk to staff about it.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Equal repairs for everyone
emails.body:
I've been a homeowner near Whirlaway Dr and Carryback Ave for 27 years. I believe every part of this city should get the same speed on pothole and sidewalk repairs. When we pay the same taxes, the response should not depend on which side of town you live on.

Please audit repair response times across the city and share the results with the public.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Landlord won't fix anything
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

I've lived in Flickinger since 2008. The building's front door lock has been broken for months and strangers sleep in the stairwell.

Please send an inspector and hold the landlord accountable.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Property taxes and bills
emails.body:
My property tax bill and the cost of home repairs are eating everything I have set aside, and I feel like I am always behind. The little savings I had went to the water heater last winter.

I hope the council keeps the cost of living in mind when they make decisions.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Abandoned house on our street
emails.body:
I've lived in Mount Pleasant Foothills since 1994. A boarded-up commercial building on our corner has trash piling up and the fence is falling onto the sidewalk. Code enforcement opened a case and closed it without anything changing.

Please enforce the vacant building ordinance and fine the owner.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Developer perspective on funding
emails.body:
Hi,

Our company builds affordable apartments and we can only start projects when local funding is committed on time. Delays in approving gap financing have pushed two of our projects back by almost a year.

Please approve gap financing on schedule so affordable projects do not stall.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Người già cần chở đi khám
emails.body:
Xin chào,

Gia đình tôi ở gần Trailside Ln và Trestlewood Dr. Mẹ tôi lớn tuổi, không lái xe được nên cần người chở đi khám bệnh mỗi tuần. Gia đình tôi đều đi làm nên thường không sắp xếp kịp.

Mong thành phố có chương trình đưa đón người cao tuổi đi khám bệnh.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Mattresses and trash dumped on our street
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

I'm retired and I walk the neighborhood every morning. Someone keeps dumping mattresses and construction debris at the end of our street. We cleaned it up ourselves twice and it came right back. I reported it in the app and the pickup took eighteen days.

I SUPPORT more dumping enforcement and faster cleanup. I'm happy to talk to staff about it.

Regards,
[name removed]
Los Paseos resident
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Rent increase again
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

Every spring the notice comes and the new number is always higher than what I can comfortably pay. I have lived in my unit for six years and I have never once been late on rent. The last increase made me cut back on medicine for my mother.

Please keep the yearly cap in place and make sure it covers every type of rental.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.to: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
emails.subject: Cần thêm nhà ở
emails.body:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Gia đình tôi có ba người phải ở chung một phòng vì giá thuê nhà quá cao.

Tôi mong thành phố cho phép xây thêm nhà ở nhỏ ở nhiều khu dân cư hơn.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Court lights
emails.body:
Hello,

I live near E Empire St and N 13th St. The lights at the basketball courts shut off at nine, and kids who would be shooting hoops end up at the bus shelter with nothing to do. Parents in my building asked to keep them on until ten on weekends, and the request has been sitting for months.

Please keep the court lights on until ten on weekends as a low-cost fix.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Walang mainit na tubig sa apartment
emails.body:
Magandang araw po,

Isang linggo na po kaming walang mainit na tubig sa aming apartment at hindi sumasagot ang may-ari. Ang mga anak ko ay naliligo sa malamig na tubig.

Sana po ay magpadala kayo ng inspector sa lalong madaling panahon. Salamat po.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.to: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
emails.subject: Trường học và nước sạch
emails.body:
Xin chào,

Nhà mới được xây nhiều nhưng trường học và hệ thống nước vẫn chưa được nâng cấp kịp. Con tôi học lớp đông hơn hai mươi học sinh và nước đôi khi bị yếu vào buổi tối.

Tôi đề nghị thành phố kiểm tra sức chứa trường học và nước trước khi cấp phép thêm.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Calle oscura otra vez
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

Las luces de la calle llevan semanas apagadas en nuestra cuadra. Mis hijos caminan de noche y da miedo.

Por favor manden a alguien a repararlas.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Renovation evictions in our building
emails.body:
To the City Council,

We are writing on behalf of our members. Tenants in my building are being pushed out with 'substantial remodel' notices and the units get re-rented at double. Most of us have lived here more than ten years. I've been in this city 12 years and I've never written before.

Please close the remodel loophole and require relocation payments. Thank you for reading this.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
Coordinator
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Trees along the freeway
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

The wall of trees that used to block the freeway dust was cut down, and now the wind blows grit onto our porch. We used to sweep it up twice a week and now it is every day.

I want the city to plant new trees and set up a buffer along the freeway edge.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Se inunda la calle
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

Cada vez que llueve la calle se inunda porque el drenaje está tapado. Mi esposa y yo trabajamos en la limpieza de oficinas.

Por favor limpien el drenaje antes de las lluvias.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Ổ gà nguy hiểm trên đường
emails.body:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Gia đình tôi ở gần Huran Drive và Harbor View Avenue. Có một ổ gà rất lớn trên đường nhà tôi từ mấy tháng nay. Mẹ tôi đã 81 tuổi và đi lại khó khăn.

Xin thành phố cho sửa đường sớm.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Storm drain clogged again
emails.body:
Hi,

The storm drain at the bottom of our street fills with leaves every fall and water backs up over the curb. We live near the corner of Cherry Ave and Avis Dr. Last winter the water got high enough to reach the garage door, and we had to move the car to higher ground.

Please clear the storm drain before the rainy season and add a regular cleaning schedule.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Sewer smell in rental kitchen
emails.body:
Hi,

We've lived in Meadowlands for 3 years. My rental house has a sewer smell in the kitchen that gets stronger every week.

Please tell me whether an inspection is needed for a suspected sewer line problem.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Proactive rental inspection and habitability enforcement

emails.subject: Remodel permit backlog
emails.body:
We are writing on behalf of our members. My solar permit has been pending for twelve weeks for a standard rooftop system. Nobody at the permit center can tell me where it is in the queue. The contractor is about to walk away.

Please fix the permit backlog and set a real turnaround time. I hope this gets on someone's list.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
Chair
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Cámaras y privacidad
emails.body:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

En mi cuadra ya hay cámaras de vecinos y no me molesta, pero no quiero que la ciudad guarde los videos durante años. Mi hijo trabaja en el turno de noche y lo último que quiero es que sus horarios queden en una base de datos.

Les pido que pongan un límite claro de cuántos días se guardan las grabaciones antes de aprobar algo.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Storm drain backs up every rain
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

Water pools across the whole intersection after any storm because the drain is blocked. Last winter it got into two of our neighbors' garages. Kids walking to school have to wade through it.

Please have Public Works clear the drain before the rainy season. I'm happy to talk to staff about it.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Tiran basura otra vez
emails.body:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

Vivo cerca de Yerba Buena Road y Kauai Drive. Trabajo de noche y llego a casa a las 4. Siguen tirando basura y muebles viejos en la esquina de nuestra cuadra.

Apoyo que la ciudad limpie y ponga cámaras.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Commission appointments process
emails.body:
To the City Council,

I live near Blossom Valley Dr and Blossom Acres Dr. The commission application process is hard to find and the interviews happen at 2 p.m. on weekdays. Working parents can't take off for a daytime interview. I've been in this city 19 years and I've never written before.

Please hold evening interviews and publish the applicant pool for every commission.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Solar permit still pending
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

My solar permit has been pending for twelve weeks for a standard rooftop system. I'm a teacher and a parent of 2. I'm paying rent and a loan on a space I can't use.

Please fix the permit backlog and set a real turnaround time.

Thanks,
[name removed]
San José, CA 95118
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Thùng rác công cộng
emails.body:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Gia đình tôi ở gần Farthing Way và Piedmont Rd. Thùng rác công cộng ở góc đường gần nhà tôi lúc nào cũng đầy và rác tràn ra vỉa hè. Mấy con chó hoang tha rác ra đường rất bẩn và mùi rất khó chịu.

Mong thành phố thu gom thường xuyên hơn hoặc thêm một thùng nữa.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Unsafe crossing near the school
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I've been a homeowner near Piedmont Rd and Farthing Way for 4 years. Cars speed down our street every morning and there is no marked crosswalk for the kids. We asked for a traffic study two years ago.

Please install a flashing beacon and a marked crosswalk this year.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Bond money for families
emails.body:
My daughter and I are on a waiting list for a subsidized unit that has been closed for two years. If the city reopens funding for new affordable units, families like ours would finally have a real chance.

Please prioritize bond funding for new affordable apartments that serve extremely low-income households.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Vandalism at vacant building
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

My auto repair shop shares a lot with an abandoned commercial building that has tagging on every wall. Vandals have been breaking in at night, and I have had to pay for a fence twice. The graffiti is starting to make customers think the block is unsafe.

Please have the vacant building boarded and the graffiti removed within the next thirty days.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Cost of living
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

Everything in this city costs more every year and nobody in charge seems to notice. I work nights, so I see this at 3 a.m. most days.

I just wanted someone to hear it.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: ADU permit stuck for months
emails.body:
Hello,

I signed a lease for my bakery last winter and still can't open because the permit is stuck. The contractor is about to walk away. We moved here in 1996 and we'd like to stay.

Please fix the permit backlog and set a real turnaround time.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Se inunda la calle
emails.body:
Hola,

Vivo cerca de Comanche Dr y Calero Ave. Es la cuarta vez que escribo. Cada vez que llueve la calle se inunda porque el drenaje está tapado. El agua llegó a la cochera del vecino.

Por favor limpien el drenaje antes de las lluvias.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Programas para jóvenes
emails.body:
Buenas tardes,

El centro comunitario cerró los programas para jóvenes en la noche. Nosotros vivimos cerca de Rotherhaven Way y Houndshaven Way desde hace 15 años. Los jóvenes no tienen a dónde ir. Trabajo de noche y llego a casa a las 1.

Apoyo que la ciudad pague más programas para jóvenes.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Small property manager concerns
emails.body:
I run a shop near the corner of Morse Street and West Hedding Street. My company manages about forty small buildings and a stricter cap would push some owners to sell. Some of my clients have already told me they cannot keep up with maintenance costs under the current limit.

Please add a hardship process so owners facing real losses can request a higher increase.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Older blocks get forgotten
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

The older blocks in town wait far longer for basic road work than the new developments do.

Please make sure older blocks are included in the next round of repaving.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Solar permit delay hurts crews
emails.body:
Hi,

As a licensed contractor, I have a solar installation waiting on a city permit that was filed nearly three months ago. Clients are canceling because the schedule keeps slipping. My crew sat idle for two weeks in August, and that cost me about four thousand dollars.

Please give small contractors a clear timeline for solar permit review and tell us where the file is.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Dark sidewalk after dinner
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

The sidewalk under the streetlight is pitch black after dinner and I cannot see the curb.

Please fix the light so the sidewalk is safe for walkers again.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Người vô gia cư
emails.body:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Ở khu tôi có một người đàn ông vô gia cư bị khủng hoảng tinh thần, ông hay la hét giữa đường vào ban đêm. Gia đình tôi ở gần Canoas Garden Ave và Almaden Expy. Cảnh sát đến rồi đi, không ai biết cách giúp ông ấy, và tôi rất lo cho sức khỏe của ông.

Xin thành phố đưa nhân viên tâm thần đến hỗ trợ thay vì chỉ có cảnh sát.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Storm drain backs up every rain
emails.body:
Hello,

The storm drain on our block has been clogged with leaves and silt since October. My partner and I talk about this every week. I live in San Tomas Aquino Park. Last winter it got into two of our neighbors' garages. Kids walking to school have to wade through it.

I SUPPORT funding storm drain upgrades on residential streets. We will keep watching how the council votes.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: dumping problem
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I live near Springfield Way and Overland Way. The vacant lot next to us has become a dump site for appliances and bags of trash. It smells and the rats are getting into yards.

I SUPPORT more dumping enforcement and faster cleanup.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Path lights
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I live at the corner of Grey Ghost Avenue and Edenview Drive. The lights on the path to the playground have been out for six months, and it is too dark for kids to walk home after practice.

Please repair the path lighting and add it to the next capital improvement list.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Robos en el vecindario
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

Nos robaron el convertidor catalítico del carro. La policía tarda mucho en llegar. Llevo 13 años en esta ciudad.

Pedimos más vigilancia y que respondan a tiempo.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Commission appointments process
emails.body:
Hello,

I live in Alta Vista. The commission application process is hard to find and the interviews happen at 2 p.m. on weekdays. My partner uses a wheelchair, so this matters a lot. Working parents can't take off for a daytime interview.

Please hold evening interviews and publish the applicant pool for every commission.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Basura tirada en la calle
emails.body:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

Nosotros vivimos cerca de Norwalk Drive y South Kiely Boulevard desde hace 23 años. Hay colchones y basura tirados junto al arroyo. Lo reportamos y tardaron semanas.

Apoyo que la ciudad limpie y ponga cámaras.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Closed sessions
emails.body:
To the City Council,

We've lived in San Tomas West for 27 years. I want the council to keep its appointment record open for review, so voters can see how each member voted on the replacement and why. If the decision is hidden behind a closed session, the public loses trust in the process. Most residents I talk to feel the same way.

Please ban closed-session votes on council vacancies.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Graffiti on our wall
emails.body:
Graffiti on our store wall has been removed three times this year.

Please prioritize our wall so it does not come back.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Meeting times
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,
