My house is right at Piedmont Road and Majestic Way. The commission meetings are always at two in the afternoon on weekdays, so the people who actually live with the problems never get to speak. I work a shift until four, and by the time I could get there the agenda would be over.

Please move at least some commission meetings to evenings or weekends so working families can attend.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Teens walking to practice
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

After the lights went out on our side of the street last winter, I stopped letting my teenagers walk to practice alone. Parents on our block are carpooling now because nobody wants their kids on a dark sidewalk.

Please prioritize outages on our street that leave whole blocks dark for more than a week.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Đèn đường bị tắt
emails.body:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Mấy cột đèn đường gần trạm xe buýt bị tắt từ tháng trước. Tôi sống gần Monteverde Dr và Redmond Ave. Buổi tối rất tối và nguy hiểm.

Xin quý vị cho người đến sửa sớm.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Summer water pressure dropping
emails.body:
To the City Council,

I rent a unit close to the proposed housing site, and the water pressure already drops every summer when the neighbors water their lawns. Adding a hundred new units could make it worse for all of us. I called the water department twice about low pressure, and they told me to run the tap in the morning.

Please require the city to confirm water supply capacity before the housing project is approved.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Against a special election
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I oppose a special election for the vacant seat, because a campaign costs too much and turnout would be low anyway. We've lived in Los Paseos for 20 years. Turnout for these off-cycle races is usually a few percent, so a small group would decide who represents the whole district. We would be paying for an election that the council could fill much more cheaply.

Please appoint a qualified interim member this month and save the special election money.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Write the rule down
emails.body:
I am not sure what the right balance is, but I want the council to be clear about when local officers help with immigration arrests. Right now people hear different things from different officers, and that creates fear.

Please publish a written policy that spells out when local police can assist federal immigration agents.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Send someone trained
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

We live near the corner of Farnsworth Dr and Silver Ridge Dr. Please stop sending officers to every mental health call, because half the time the officer is not what the person needs.

Send someone trained for this kind of call first and call police only if needed.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: We need more patrols
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

My neighbor's catalytic converter was cut off in broad daylight last week. I live near Moorpark Avenue and Greenmeadow Way. We put up cameras ourselves.

Please fund faster police response for property crime.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Paalis sa tinitirhan
emails.body:
Nakatanggap kami ng abiso na kailangan naming umalis sa loob ng tatlumpung araw nang walang dahilan. Matagal na kaming nakatira dito at ang mga anak ko ay nasa malapit na paaralan, kaya napakahirap ang ganitong biglaang abiso.

Hinihiling namin sa konseho na palakasin ang proteksyon laban sa paalis na walang dahilan.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Abandoned house on our street
emails.body:
I'm retired and I walk the neighborhood every morning. I run a shop near the corner of McAbee Rd and Redmond Ave. The house two doors down has been vacant for three years, the roof is caving in, and people break in at night. We worry about a fire.

Please enforce the vacant building ordinance and fine the owner.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Concerns about the density plan
emails.body:
To the City Council,

I've lived in Willow Vale since 1999. A plan to put several units on each lot would change how our block looks and feels within a few years. Our street has one lane of parking and the sewer line already backs up after big storms. Adding that many families without new infrastructure would make both problems worse.

Please require an infrastructure study before any upzoning proposal for residential lots gets a vote.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: Closing the shop
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

Our family has been in Silver Leaf for 7 years. I may have to close my small repair shop after my biggest client moved away and the rent stayed the same. I have been paying my two employees out of savings and that money is almost gone.

Please tell small business owners like me where to get emergency loans or grants.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Illegal dumping again
emails.body:
Hello,

Someone keeps dumping mattresses and construction debris at the end of our street. I rent an apartment near Oakland Rd and Mabury Rd.

Please schedule a cleanup crew and post no-dumping signs.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Waited hours
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

We live near the corner of Sequoia Avenue and Hanchett Avenue. We waited close to four hours for an officer after a man broke into our neighbor's garage.

Please fund faster patrol coverage so these calls are not left sitting for hours.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Support protections for immigrant residents
emails.body:
To the City Council,

My neighbors are afraid to report crimes or take their kids to the clinic because of immigration raids.

I SUPPORT the resolution protecting immigrant residents.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: dumping problem
emails.body:
There is a pile of dumped furniture and trash bags on the sidewalk that has been there two weeks. I've lived in Winchester since 2012. Kids have to walk around it into the street.

Please schedule a cleanup crew and post no-dumping signs.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Bulky pickup appointments
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

It is almost impossible to get a bulky item pickup appointment in less than a month.

Please add more open slots or a same-week option for seniors.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Couch on the sidewalk
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

There is a couch sitting on the sidewalk in front of our apartment building and it has been there since Friday. Kids have to walk around it into the street to get to school.

Can the city remove it and put up a sign saying no dumping?

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Dump drop-off hours
emails.body:
Hello,

The transfer station hours do not work for anyone who has a day job.

Please extend the hours into the evening once a month.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: We need more patrols
emails.body:
Hello,

My neighbor's catalytic converter was cut off in broad daylight last week. Nobody even called back about the report. I'm a pharmacist and a parent of 3.

I SUPPORT more patrols and community service officers in our area.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Speeding cars on side street
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

Cars already speed down our side street to avoid the light, and the proposed apartments would send another few hundred trips onto it. Kids on bikes have almost been hit twice this year. I reported it to traffic engineering, and they said the speed bumps are on a waiting list.

Please require traffic calming on our street as part of the project approval.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Speeding on our street
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

I live at the corner of North Bascom Avenue and University Avenue. I've been in this city 4 years and I've never written before. Cars speed down our street every morning and there is no marked crosswalk for the kids. We asked for a traffic study two years ago.

I SUPPORT equal traffic-safety funding for every neighborhood, not just the loudest ones.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: No noise data for nearby homes
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

The appendix on noise in the warehouse report has no measurements from our side of the street.

Please require noise measurements at the nearest homes before the hearing.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Car wash worried about runoff
emails.body:
Hello,

I'm a Communications Hill homeowner. As the owner of a small car wash near the proposed data center site, I am worried the project could change how water drains down our block. Our wash already loses a day's business after heavy rain. We would lose money every time the lot floods, and the neighbors would be stuck too.

Please require the project to include stormwater retention and show how the lot will drain.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Terra Verde data center: EIR certification and site development permit

emails.subject: Catalytic converter theft
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

Someone cut the catalytic converter off our minivan in the driveway overnight, and the repair bill came to over two thousand dollars.

Please put more patrol attention on overnight catalytic converter thefts in residential streets.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: ADU permit stuck for months
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

Our family has been in San Tomas Aquino Park for 19 years. My son uses a wheelchair, so this matters a lot. A simple kitchen remodel permit has taken five months and three resubmittals.

Please fix the permit backlog and set a real turnaround time.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Library hours cut
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

The senior lunch program is the only place many older neighbors see anyone all week. I'm writing on my lunch break, so I'll keep it short.

Please restore the full senior center schedule.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Muebles tirados cerca del arroyo
emails.body:
Hola,

Cada semana aparece un sillón, una cama o bolsas de ropa tiradas cerca del sendero del arroyo detrás de nuestra casa. Mi mamá es mayor y ya se tropezó con una silla escondida entre los arbustos. Llamamos al 311 varias veces, pero siempre tardan días en venir.

Pedimos que la ciudad recoja todo y ponga vigilancia en esa zona.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Ổ gà nguy hiểm trên đường
emails.body:
Xin chào,

Có một ổ gà rất lớn trên đường nhà tôi từ mấy tháng nay. Gia đình tôi sống ở khu Silver Creek đã 6 năm. Mẹ tôi đã 86 tuổi và đi lại khó khăn. Tôi đã báo nhiều lần.

Xin thành phố cho sửa đường sớm.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Car break-ins on my block
emails.body:
Hello,

Three cars on our block were broken into last month and nobody came out for the report until the next afternoon. We have called the non-emergency line about the same corner several times and each time the wait got longer.

Please fund enough patrol officers that a break-in report gets a real response the same day.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Summer jobs
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I rent an apartment near Vernice Avenue and Griffith Street. Summer jobs for teens ran out before I could sign up my daughter, and she spent the whole summer at home.

Please fund more summer job slots for young people and open the applications earlier.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Growth needs better sewers
emails.body:
To the City Council,

New housing is fine with me, but the sewer line on our street was not built for many more homes. When it rains hard the manhole covers bubble up, and I am worried about what happens with more connections.

Please require sewer and water capacity checks before the council approves major new housing projects.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: Freeway noise at night
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

The freeway noise keeps me up every night, even with the windows shut. I've lived in Palmia Park since 2010.

Please push for a sound wall along our side.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Lights out near my home
emails.body:
To the City Council,

The streetlight in front of our house has been flickering and then off entirely for six weeks. It's the darkest stretch in the neighborhood now. I'm writing on my lunch break, so I'll keep it short. Cars have been broken into twice since the lights went out.

I OPPOSE renewing a contract that leaves lights out this long. This has gone on long enough.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: No heat, thermostat error
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

Our unit has no working heat, and the thermostat just shows an error code.

Please send a city inspector to cite the owner for failing heating.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Slow down the fourplex reform
emails.body:
Hi,

Parking on our street is already full every night, and the fourplex reform has no plan for it. I live near Centerwood Way and Brightwood Drive. I'm not against housing, I'm against doing it without a plan.

Please vote no on citywide fourplexes.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: Casa abandonada
emails.body:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

La casa abandonada de la esquina está llena de basura y entra gente de noche. Trabajo de noche y llego a casa a las 11.

Pedimos que la ciudad obligue al dueño a limpiar.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Vacant duplex with broken windows and rats
emails.body:
To the City Council,

We've lived in West San José for 5 years. The duplex next to our apartment has been vacant since spring, with three windows broken and the back door hanging open. Rats have been moving between its yard and our trash bins every night. Our landlord says it is not his property, so he will not call anyone. I have counted at least six piles of trash the size of a couch in the back yard.

Please send code enforcement to board the windows, clear the yard, and set a deadline for the owner.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Streetlight outage question
emails.body:
To the City Council,

The light by my apartment building keeps flickering on and off every night for the last two weeks.

Please check the wiring and fix the flicker before it goes out for good.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Streetlights out on our block
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

Three streetlights on our block have been out for almost a month. My son uses a wheelchair, so this matters a lot. The service request says closed, but nothing was fixed.

I SUPPORT funding a faster repair crew and theft-proof wiring.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
San José, CA 95125
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Leaves block the grate
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

The grate at the corner gets covered by leaves in October and then the water runs straight into my neighbor's yard. Our city crew came once last year, but the next storm filled it right back up.

Please add that grate to the autumn cleaning schedule so it gets cleared before the first big storm.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.to: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
emails.subject: Tiếng ồn xa lộ
emails.body:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Nhà tôi sát xa lộ, bụi và tiếng ồn suốt ngày. Tôi làm ca đêm và về nhà lúc 4 giờ sáng. Con tôi bị suyễn.

Xin xây tường cách âm và trồng cây.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: On-ramp backups at rush hour
emails.body:
To the City Council,

The planned apartments are near the freeway on-ramp, and the study ignores how backed up the ramp gets at rush hour. Adding a few hundred cars there will likely mean longer waits for everyone trying to get home. I live by Union Avenue and Heimgartner Lane with my family. I drive that ramp every day, and it is already a fifteen-minute wait. I would like the traffic study to model the actual peak-hour backup, not just average counts.

Please require a peak-hour traffic analysis at the on-ramp before the project is approved.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Medical bills
emails.body:
Hi,

My medical bills from the surgery are piling up and the collection calls started this week. Our family has been in Berryessa Crossing for 9 years.

Please point me to any city program that helps with hospital debt.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Against the sanctuary idea
emails.body:
To the City Council,

I oppose limiting police cooperation with federal agents, because if someone is a criminal the police should be able to work with whoever can help.

Please vote no on any policy that restricts officers from sharing information with federal partners.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Basura tirada en la calle
emails.body:
Buenas tardes,

Hay colchones y basura tirados junto al arroyo. Vivo cerca de Bailey Ave y Ciro Ave. Soy mecánico y casi no tengo tiempo, pero esto es importante. Lo reportamos y tardaron semanas.

Por favor vengan a limpiar pronto.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Ổ gà nguy hiểm trên đường
emails.body:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Có một ổ gà rất lớn trên đường nhà tôi từ mấy tháng nay. Gia đình tôi ở gần Royalvale Way và Cardington Drive. Tôi đã báo nhiều lần. Gia đình tôi có 3 con nhỏ.

Xin thành phố cho sửa đường sớm.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Please keep the senior lunch program
emails.body:
Hi,

The senior lunch program is the only place many older neighbors see anyone all week. We moved here in 1988 and we'd like to stay. We live near the corner of Albany Dr and S Kiely Blvd. It costs very little compared to what it gives back.

Please restore the full senior center schedule.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Renter asking for a YES vote
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

This is my fourth email about it. My rent went up again this year and it now takes more than half my paycheck. I live at the corner of Wine Grower Way and Wine Cork Way. We are not asking for a handout, just predictability. I work two jobs and I'm still behind.

Please vote YES on the rent cap amendment. I hope this gets on someone's list.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Graffiti on the fence
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

Graffiti on the back fence of my yard keeps reappearing even after the crew cleans it, and it is getting bigger. I live by Calero Ave and Indian Ave with my family. It is on the side facing the bike path, so everyone sees it.

Please send the graffiti crew sooner and use a paint that resists marker.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: No parking on our street
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

Our street already has no parking after six o'clock because of the apartments, and the new building would bring another hundred residents with cars. People park across our driveways and block the mailboxes, and there is no plan to deal with it.

Please require the developer to provide on-site parking or a parking permit plan before approval.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Neighbor's leak through shared wall
emails.body:
Hi,

Water is coming through the shared wall from the unit next door, and my kitchen ceiling bubbled up last month. The neighbor's unit is a rental and the owner is not answering calls. I had a plumber look at my side, and he says the leak is definitely coming from the other side of the wall.

Please have an inspector visit the neighboring unit and order the owner to fix the leak.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Front door lock broken
emails.body:
Hi,

My front door deadbolt does not lock anymore because the strike plate pulled out of the frame. Anyone can push the door open from outside. I live near Bennett Way and Lincoln Avenue.

Please order the owner to repair the door lock within the code timeline.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Cracked bedroom window
emails.body:
Hi,

The window in my bedroom has a crack that lets in cold air, and the frame is rotting at the bottom.

Please require the owner to replace the window before winter.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Apoyo la protección a inmigrantes
emails.body:
Buenas tardes,

Muchas familias tienen miedo de salir por las redadas de inmigración. Los niños tienen miedo de ir a la escuela.

Apoyo la resolución para proteger a las familias inmigrantes.

Gracias,
[name removed]
Residente de Hillview
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Permisos tardan demasiado
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

Llevo meses esperando el permiso para una pequeña remodelación. Nosotros vivimos cerca de McLaughlin Avenue y Candia Drive desde hace 8 años. Cada vez piden otro documento. Es la tercera vez que escribo.

Por favor simplifiquen el proceso de permisos.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Road surface is falling apart
emails.body:
To the City Council,

Our family has been in Kooser for 23 years. The road surface on our block is so broken that delivery trucks swerve into the bike lane. A patch is not a fix if it fails in six months. My neighbor and I talk about this every week.

I SUPPORT more road-repair funding for residential streets.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Renovation evictions in our building
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I work nights, so I see this at 2 a.m. most days. Our landlord sent notices to six units saying we have to leave for renovations that never seem to happen. Most of us have lived here more than ten years.

Please close the remodel loophole and require relocation payments. We will keep watching how the council votes.

Best,
[name removed]
Steindorf-Doerr resident
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Flooding at our driveway
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I live near Minnesota Ave and W Alma Ave. The water that sits at the low point of our driveway during storms has started seeping into the garage. We have put out sandbags twice this winter, and my husband has had to pump the floor. The neighbors across the street have a similar problem, so it is not just one house.

Please inspect the storm drains at the low point of our block and fix whatever is blocking them.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Flooding at our curb
emails.body:
To the City Council,

Every time it rains the storm drain at our curb backs up and water reaches the garages. We live near the corner of Dow Drive and Hillsdale Avenue. I work nights, so I see this at 4 a.m. most days. Last winter it got into two of our neighbors' garages.

I SUPPORT funding storm drain upgrades on residential streets.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Fireworks
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

Illegal fireworks go off every night in the week before the holiday and I can't sleep with my baby.

Please step up enforcement on illegal fireworks so families can get some rest.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Cống bị nghẹt
emails.body:
Xin chào,

Gia đình tôi ở gần Kirk Rd và Swangate Way. Mỗi lần mưa nước ngập vào sân vì cống bị nghẹt. Mẹ tôi đã 78 tuổi và đi lại khó khăn. Nước tràn vào nhà hàng xóm.

Xin cho người đến thông cống trước mùa mưa.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: dumping problem
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I own a small business near Montgomery Ln and Gerdts Dr. My wife and I talk about this every week. The vacant lot next to us has become a dump site for appliances and bags of trash.

I SUPPORT more dumping enforcement and faster cleanup.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Dangerous pothole
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

Crews patched one pothole on our street and left four others right next to it. A patch is not a fix if it fails in six months. We pay our share of taxes and the street looks abandoned.

I OPPOSE spending on cosmetic projects while basic streets crumble. I hope this gets on someone's list.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Streetlights out on our block
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

Three streetlights on our block have been out for almost a month. Seniors on our street have stopped taking evening walks. We moved here in 2014 and we'd like to stay.

Please send a crew to repair these lights.

Best,
[name removed]
San José, CA 95138
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.to: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
emails.subject: Trộm cắp trong khu phố
emails.body:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Nhà hàng xóm bị trộm hai lần trong tháng. Mẹ tôi đã 86 tuổi và đi lại khó khăn.

Xin tăng cường tuần tra trong khu phố.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Retired on a budget
emails.body:
Hi,

We bought our house thirty years ago and the property taxes and insurance keep climbing faster than our pensions. I live at the corner of Silver Leaf Road and Grandwell Way. My wife and I now look at every grocery receipt and argue about whether we can afford the bus pass. Our neighbors on this block are selling and moving away because they just cannot keep up.

I wish the council would focus more on helping longtime residents stay in their homes.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Costos de permiso y espera larga
emails.body:
Hola,

Vivo cerca de Blossom Acres Drive y Blossom Valley Drive. Los derechos de permiso para mi negocio subieron mucho el año pasado, pero la revisión tarda semanas. Pagamos más y seguimos esperando. Si tuviéramos más personal que revisara planos, no nos afectaría tanto la espera.

Pido que la ciudad baje las cuotas o contrate más revisores para dar un servicio más rápido.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Llamadas de crisis
emails.body:
Hola,

Vivo en Dove Hill. Cuando mi mamá tuvo una crisis en casa, llamamos y tardaron horas, y nadie sabía cómo calmarla.

Les pido que pongan un equipo de crisis que sepa manejar estas situaciones.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Opposed to fourplexes next door
emails.body:
To the City Council,

We've lived in Playa del Rey for 20 years. I bought my house because the lot is quiet and I do not want a fourplex built on the lot next door. Our street has narrow parking and the driveways are already full on weekends.

Please keep the current limits for single-family lots and require public notice before any change.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform

emails.subject: Cámaras en el callejón
emails.body:
Hola,

Vivo cerca de Ford Road y Mayland Avenue. Los tiraderos de basura en el callejón atrás del edificio siguen aunque limpiemos cada mes. Los vecinos ya ponen sus propias cámaras, pero no sirven bien de noche.

Pido que la ciudad ponga cámaras con buena luz en ese lugar.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Couch dumped on the sidewalk for two weeks
emails.body:
Hello,

I work nights, so I see this at 5 a.m. most days. I live in North Valley. People dump old tires and paint cans by the creek path behind our homes. Kids have to walk around it into the street.

I SUPPORT more dumping enforcement and faster cleanup.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Bị ép dọn nhà
emails.body:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Chủ nhà bắt chúng tôi dọn đi để sửa nhà nhưng thật ra là để tăng giá. Tôi đã sống ở thành phố này 14 năm. Tôi sống gần Downing Avenue và Rickenbacker Street.

Xin thành phố bảo vệ người thuê nhà và đóng lỗ hổng này.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Appoint and move on
emails.body:
Hello,

I rent an apartment near Ciro Avenue and Bailey Avenue. Honestly, appointing someone is faster and saves the city money, and I'd rather have a qualified person in the seat now.

Please appoint a qualified replacement now and skip the cost of a special election.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Doubts a civilian team
emails.body:
To the City Council,

I am not sure trained civilians can handle a crisis when someone has a weapon, so I would rather have officers stay part of the response. That is the situation I keep worrying about, especially with my kids walking home past the bus stop.

Please keep officers in the lead on crisis calls and do not replace them with a pilot program until it is proven.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: 心理危机
emails.body:
我住的地方附近有一位无家可归的人经常情绪失控，大声喊叫，有时候还会在路边摔东西。 我担心他会受伤，附近的孩子看到也会害怕，但叫警察又怕把事情弄得更糟。

希望市政府能派受过训练的心理危机人员去协助，而不是只派警察。

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Light pole outage question
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

The light at the bus stop near my house has been dim for a week and sometimes goes completely dark. I live at the corner of Union Ave and Heather Dr. Older folks from our building wait there every morning, and they have asked me to write this email for them.

Please replace the bulb or pole and let us know when the work is scheduled.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Unsafe crossing near the school
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

I'm writing on my lunch break, so I'll keep it short. Cars speed down our street every morning and there is no marked crosswalk for the kids.

Please install a flashing beacon and a marked crosswalk this year.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Cống bị nghẹt
emails.body:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Chúng tôi đến đây từ năm 1996. Mỗi lần mưa nước ngập vào sân vì cống bị nghẹt.

Xin cho người đến thông cống trước mùa mưa.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Truck routes missing from review
emails.body:
The review for the rezoned parcel near our shop left out truck routes, and our delivery vans would have to use the same narrow road.

Please ask the applicant to add a truck route analysis before the hearing.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Mahal ng upa
emails.body:
Magandang gabi po,

Taon-taon pong tumataas ang upa namin at halos kalahati na ng sahod ko ang napupunta dito. Hirap na hirap na po ang pamilya namin.

Salamat po sa pakikinig.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Junked cars block our loading
emails.body:
Hello,

I own a small moving company, and our trucks get blocked by a row of junked cars on the street next to our yard. Two of them have been there since last winter with no plates. I own a small business near Lochner Drive and Griffith Street. We have to park our trucks in a separate lot now, which costs us money every month.

Please have the inoperable cars towed so our loading area is clear.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Thanh niên không có chỗ đi
emails.body:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Ở chung cư tôi, các em học sinh cấp hai không có chỗ học bài hay chơi sau giờ học nên cả tuần chỉ quanh quẩn ở sân. Tôi sống gần Chaboya Road và Gurdwara Avenue. Mẹ tôi giữ bé ở nhà còn tôi phải đi làm ca tối, nên không ai để ý con em họ. Tôi mong thành phố mở một phòng sinh hoạt có người lớn trông coi vào buổi tối.

Xin thành phố mở chương trình sinh hoạt tối cho thiếu niên trong năm tới.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Who is actually assigned
emails.body:
Hello,

We've lived in Mount Pleasant for 20 years. The police are talking about adding staff, but on my street they have not come by once this year, even though the cars keep getting broken into. I have a list of the incident numbers if anyone wants them.

Please show us how many officers are actually assigned to our district before approving more money.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Slow police response
emails.body:
Hello,

My mother uses a wheelchair, so this matters a lot. I'm a Dove Hill homeowner. There have been five car break-ins on our street since August and two catalytic converter thefts.

I SUPPORT more patrols and community service officers in our area.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Apoyo al fondo de vivienda
emails.body:
Hola,

Nosotros vivimos cerca de Torrance Avenue y Diamond Avenue desde hace 27 años. Yo soy dueño de mi casa y apoyo que se use dinero público para vivienda económica para nuestros vecinos.

Les pido que aprueben el financiamiento y que informen cada año sobre los resultados.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Repairs take longer in our part of town
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

I have noticed that the repairs in our part of the city take months longer than the ones on the wealthier side. Our street has been broken for over a year while streets nearby got fixed in a few weeks.

Please publish repair times by area so residents can see whether service is fair.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: ADU permit stuck for months
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

A simple kitchen remodel permit has taken five months and three resubmittals. I've been in this city 26 years and I've never written before. We live near the corner of Sydney Dr and Piedmont Rd.

I SUPPORT the permitting modernization, but please add plan checkers, not just software.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Rent keeps going up
emails.body:
Our rent went up again this year, and we are now paying more than half of what we bring home. Our family has been in La Vey for 7 years. My partner and I both work, and we still cannot save a single dollar for an emergency.

Please do whatever you can to slow down rent increases for people like us.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Trash cans full by Friday
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I live near Thornhaven Way and Knightshaven Way. The public cans on our block fill up by Friday and nobody empties them until Monday. The garbage smell gets bad in the summer and the bugs come out.

I want the city to add a weekend emptying schedule for these cans.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.to: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
emails.subject: Cống thoát nước bị nghẹt
emails.body:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Cống thoát nước trước nhà tôi bị tắc nên nước tràn lên vỉa hè mỗi khi trời mưa lớn.

Tôi mong thành phố vét cống này và kiểm tra lại toàn bộ hệ thống thoát nước của khu.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Childcare at meetings
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

I cannot bring my toddler to a commission meeting and nobody offers childcare, so I just stay home. Two other parents on my floor gave up on speaking at all for the same reason.

Please provide childcare or a kids' room at commission meetings held in the evening.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Privacy concern about readers
emails.body:
Hi,

I oppose license plate readers because they record where everyone drives, and I do not think a few stolen parts justify a database of our movements. I live near Cherry Ave and Joplin Dr. Immigrant neighbors in my building already avoid going out after dark, and I don't want them to feel watched by their own city. Any data kept should be deleted quickly and never shared with other agencies.

Please vote against the plate reader contract unless there is a strict limit on data retention and sharing.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Slow response
emails.body:
I waited almost three hours for an officer after someone smashed my car window in the carport.

Please make sure the council funds more officers so response times come down.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Fund youth programs
emails.body:
The community center near us cut its teen hours and since then there are more kids with nothing to do at night. I rent an apartment near Blossom Hill Rd and Harvard Dr. My son found his first job through one of those programs.

Please restore funding for youth programs in the public safety budget.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Rezoning application: Blossom Hill Road retail parcel

emails.subject: Ổ gà nguy hiểm trên đường
emails.body:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Có một ổ gà rất lớn trên đường nhà tôi từ mấy tháng nay. Đây là lần thứ ba tôi viết thư. Xe máy và xe đạp rất dễ bị ngã.

Xin thành phố cho sửa đường sớm.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
Cư dân khu Chaboya
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Đường băng qua nguy hiểm
emails.body:
Xin chào,

Tôi đã sống ở thành phố này 7 năm. Gần trường học không có vạch qua đường và xe chạy rất nhanh. Tháng trước suýt có tai nạn.

Xin thành phố làm vạch qua đường và đèn báo.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.to: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
emails.subject: Đèn đường bị hỏng
emails.body:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Đèn đường trước nhà tôi đã tắt hơn hai tuần nên đêm rất tối và đi lại không an toàn. Tôi đã báo qua ứng dụng 311 nhưng chưa thấy ai đến sửa.

Tôi đề nghị thành phố cử người đến sửa đèn và kiểm tra dây điện có bị lấy trộm không.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Apoyo para más viviendas
emails.body:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

Nosotros vivimos cerca de Annona Ave y Harbor View Ave desde hace 5 años. Mi hijo ya tiene familia y no puede encontrar un lugar para rentar cerca de nosotros, así que apoyo que se construyan más casas. Si se permite un cuarto extra o una unidad pequeña en el patio, muchas familias podrían quedarse en la ciudad.

Les pido que faciliten los permisos para unidades pequeñas en los patios de las casas unifamiliares.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Unsafe crossing near the school
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

Other neighborhoods got flashing beacons at their school crossings years ago and we are still waiting. We live just off Sierra Rd near Tourney Dr. A crossing guard was nearly hit in September.

I SUPPORT equal traffic-safety funding for every neighborhood, not just the loudest ones.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Senior center hours
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

The senior lunch program is the only place many older neighbors see anyone all week. My son uses a wheelchair, so this matters a lot. My family and I live in Sakamota. It costs very little compared to what it gives back.

Please restore the full senior center schedule.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Who decides
emails.body:
Hi,

The council should not be picking its own replacement, because that is how the same people stay in power for years.

Please put the appointment rules up for public comment before the next vacancy.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Dump days are too far
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

The dump days are held on weekdays when I am at work, and the drop-off sites are an hour away by bus. I have a truck and a pile of old fencing, but I cannot take a day off just to make the drop-off window. Other families in our area are dumping things illegally because they do not have another option.

Please add a weekend dump day closer to us.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Yearly increase too high
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

My rent jumped in August and nothing about my building or my pay justified it.

Please enforce the yearly cap so families can plan their budgets.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Pinabayaang bahay at daga
emails.body:
May bahay sa tabi namin na walang nakatira simula pa noong nakaraang taon. Puno na ng damo ang bakuran at may mga basurang nakatambak sa likod, at dumadami ang daga. Madalas kaming abalahin ng amoy kapag mainit ang panahon.

Sana ay magpadala ng inspektor ang lungsod para linisin ang bakuran at ipaalam sa may-ari.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Lights out at our loading area
emails.body:
Hello,

I run a shop near the corner of Ciro Ave and Bailey Ave. Our loading area behind the shop has been dark for a month, and our delivery drivers are complaining.

Please restore the streetlight near our loading area as soon as possible.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: How is the cap calculated?
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I live near Wonderama Drive and Ocala Avenue. I got a notice saying my increase is within the limit, but I cannot figure out how the number was calculated. The notice listed a percentage but did not show the base amount or the date it applies.

Please require landlords to show the calculation on every rent increase notice.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Behind on rent
emails.body:
Hi,

I live in Mount Pleasant Foothills. I fell two months behind on rent after my hours got cut, and my landlord has started sending notices. I have been applying for jobs every day but nothing has come through yet.

Please tell me what programs are open for renters who are behind right now.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Họp ngoài giờ hành chính
emails.body:
Xin chào,

Gia đình tôi ở gần Pearl Avenue và Upton Way. Các buổi họp của ủy ban luôn diễn ra vào buổi chiều giờ hành chính nên người đi làm như tôi không thể tham dự. Tôi muốn phát biểu về vấn đề đường phố nhưng phải xin nghỉ việc, và tôi không đủ tiền để mất một ngày lương.

Xin thành phố tổ chức họp ủy ban vào buổi tối hoặc cuối tuần để người lao động có thể tham gia.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Unhoused neighbor
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

Our block has a woman who yells at cars at night and I am worried she will get hurt, but calling police feels like making it worse. Our family has been in McKean for 20 years.

Please create a daytime outreach team that can check on people like her before a crisis happens.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Dumped on our street
emails.body:
To the City Council,

Someone dumped a broken shopping cart and two bags of yard trimmings in front of my driveway.

Can someone come get it? It is blocking the sidewalk.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.to: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
emails.subject: Mặt đường hư hỏng
emails.body:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Gia đình tôi ở gần Calero Avenue và Shawcroft Drive. Mặt đường trước nhà tôi bị nứt thành từng mảng, nên mỗi lần mưa xe đạp của con tôi lại bị trượt. Lần vá đường trước đó chỉ được vài tuần rồi lại hư.

Tôi mong thành phố sửa lại cả đoạn đường thay vì vá tạm nhiều lần.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Our street needs real repaving
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

My wife and I talk about this every week. The pavement on our street is cracked end to end and water sits in the low spots. My neighbor's tire blew out on it in March.

Please repave the block instead of patching it again.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Street lights have been out for weeks
emails.body:
I coach youth soccer and the families ask me about this. Our whole block lost its streetlights after the wire theft in the spring and only one came back. We live near the corner of Newhall St and Sherwood Ave.

I SUPPORT funding a faster repair crew and theft-proof wiring.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Patrullas
emails.body:
Buenas tardes,

Los fuegos artificiales ilegales truenan hasta la madrugada y ya llamé varias veces sin que llegue nadie. Vivo en La Vey.

Les pido que pongan más oficiales en esta zona para parar los fuegos artificiales.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Sewage backup in laundry room
emails.body:
The building manager shut off the laundry room water for a whole weekend, and now there's a flooded hallway that smells like sewage. The drain line under the sink is backed up, and nobody has come out to clear it. We have had no working toilet on the second floor since Friday.

Please have inspectors check the sewer backup and order the owner to restore plumbing service.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Car break-ins on our street
emails.body:
Hello,

There have been five car break-ins on our street since August and two catalytic converter thefts. I've been in this city 37 years and I've never written before.

Please fund faster police response for property crime.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.to: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
emails.subject: Ổ gà trên đường
emails.body:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Tôi sống ở khu Cambrian Park. Có một ổ gà lớn trước cổng nhà tôi làm xe máy của chồng tôi bị hư hai lần rồi.

Tôi mong thành phố lấp ổ gà này và kiểm tra cả đoạn đường.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Rent increase letter
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

I live at the corner of Ocala Ave and Ridgemont Dr. Our rent is going up again next month and I got the letter yesterday.

Please think about renters before the next rent decision.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Three families got notices
emails.body:
Hello,

Three families in my building got eviction notices in the same month, and nobody told us why. Most of us have lived here for over a decade and we are all struggling to find something we can afford nearby.

Please require a written reason and a relocation plan before a landlord can end a long tenancy.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Late night gym
emails.body:
Our city gym closes at nine and teens have nowhere to go on Friday nights, so they end up in the parking lots. I've lived in Farnham since 1999.

Please keep the gym open late on weekends as a funded pilot.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Storm drain clogged by sand
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

I live at the corner of Santa Teresa Blvd and Indian Ave. After the construction on the next block, sand and gravel washed into the storm drain and it stopped working. The water now sits in the road for hours and cars splash the sidewalk where my kids wait for the bus.

Please inspect the storm drain and ask the contractor to pay for cleanup if needed.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: pothole damage to my car
emails.body:
Hi,

I own a small business near W Hedding St and Morse St. I'm writing on my lunch break, so I'll keep it short. The pavement on our street is cracked end to end and water sits in the low spots. We pay our share of taxes and the street looks abandoned.

I OPPOSE spending on cosmetic projects while basic streets crumble.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Free junk pickup
emails.body:
To the City Council,

I have a broken dresser and a crib that need hauling, but the free junk pickup in our area fills up within minutes. I live by Redwood Drive and Birch Way with my family. I had to pay a hauler two hundred dollars last time, which I could not really afford.

I want the city to expand the free pickup days or give renters a second option.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Concerns about the proposed rent cap
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I own a duplex and I am worried that a lower annual cap will leave me unable to cover repairs. My property taxes and insurance have gone up every year, and the cap has not kept pace with those costs.

Please let the council consider a cap formula that covers my real operating costs.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Against the sanctuary resolution
emails.body:
Hi,

I oppose a sanctuary policy that tells local officers to refuse federal requests, because it leaves our street exposed to people who should be arrested. I live by Woosley Drive and Felder Drive with my family. Our block had a stolen car ring last year, and the federal task force was the only thing that helped us find them. I would not want that tool removed.

Please vote against the sanctuary resolution unless it keeps cooperation on serious criminal cases.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Dark street again
emails.body:
To the City Council,

Our whole block lost its streetlights after the wire theft in the spring and only one came back. I live at the corner of West San Carlos Street and Race Street. My partner uses a wheelchair, so this matters a lot. The service request says closed, but nothing was fixed.

Please send a crew to repair these lights.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Who gets appointed
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

I've lived in Hyde Park since 1999. Almost everyone appointed to the planning board seems to be a homeowner who has lived in the same place for decades. Many residents rent, but nobody on the board has ever lived in an apartment like mine.

Please appoint a renter and a younger worker to the next open seat on the planning board.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Everything costs too much
emails.body:
Hello,

I make a decent salary and still can't save anything after rent and childcare. We're thinking about leaving the Bay Area. I coach youth soccer and the families ask me about this.

I just wanted someone to hear it.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
San Tomas West resident
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Dumpster overflow
emails.body:
The public trash can at the corner outside our restaurant overflows every single day.

Please add a second can or more frequent emptying there.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.to: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
emails.subject: Sợ đi trình báo
emails.body:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Một người bạn ở chung cư của tôi nhận được một lá thư có con dấu liên bang và không dám nói chuyện với cảnh sát khi xe bị trộm. Chị ấy vẫn chưa trình báo, và tôi nói chị ấy phải được trình báo mà không sợ hãi.

Xin thành phố bảo đảm cảnh sát địa phương không hỏi về tình trạng nhập cư khi nhận tin báo.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Đổ rác trên đường
emails.body:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Tôi sống gần Croft Drive và Pavan Drive. Mấy hôm nay có người đổ nệm và ghế sofa cũ ngay bên lề đường trước nhà tôi. Xe rác không chịu lấy vì đồ quá cồng kềnh nên đồ cứ nằm đó mãi.

Mong thành phố cho người đến dọn và phạt người đổ rác.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Walking home
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I live by Desmet Dr and Brunetti Dr with my family. Kids walking home from the library after dark have to cross a dark lot, and I'm worried about them every night.

Please add lighting and a late bus route to help kids get home safely.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Empty house with yard full of weeds
emails.body:
We live just off Harry Road near Bernal Road. The house across from us has been empty for over two years, and the back yard is full of dead weeds and old tires.

Please send code enforcement to inspect the lot and require the owner to clean it up.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Just a thought on growth
emails.body:
To the City Council,

We live near the corner of Lahaina Way and Ilikai Ave. I am not against growth but I think the city should slow down a little and see what breaks first.

I hope the council keeps a steady pace on new approvals.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Open garage at vacant house
emails.body:
Hi,

We live near the corner of Candia Dr and McLaughlin Ave. The house across the alley has a broken garage door that has been wide open for a month, and there are shopping carts and pallets stacked against the fence. Anyone can wander in and out of the back yard, and the open garage looks like an invitation to whoever walks by. I called the non-emergency number twice, but they told me it is a code matter and gave me a case number. Nothing has changed since.

Please send code enforcement to secure the garage and remove the stacked materials.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Ổ gà nguy hiểm trên đường
emails.body:
Xin chào,

Tôi sống gần Valley Forge Way và Antonio Ln. Có một ổ gà rất lớn trên đường nhà tôi từ mấy tháng nay.

Xin thành phố cho sửa đường sớm.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Carro sin placas y reparaciones
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

En la casa de al lado hay un carro sin llantas y sin placas que está estacionado desde hace más de cuatro meses. Además alguien hace reparaciones de motor en la entrada. El aceite se derrama en la calle y los niños pasan por ahí para ir a la escuela.

Pido que la ciudad revise el carro y prohíba las reparaciones en la entrada.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Mattresses piling up
emails.body:
I live at the corner of Norseman Dr and Undajon Dr. Every few days another mattress or box spring shows up in the dumpster area of my complex, and it is not from our residents. The management says it is the city's job to pick them up since they are on the street side.

Please coordinate with us and get the street-side pile cleared out regularly.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Verano sin trabajo
emails.body:
Buenas tardes,

Mi hija quería un trabajo de verano y no pudo entrar en el programa porque se llenó en dos días.

Les pido que abran más plazas de trabajo de verano para jóvenes el próximo año.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: pothole damage to my car
emails.body:
Hi,

The pothole patch from last year already crumbled and the hole is back, deeper. I live by Thornhaven Way and Knightshaven Way with my family.

Please fix this pothole before someone gets hurt.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Người nhập cư sợ hãi
emails.body:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Gia đình tôi là người nhập cư, và chúng tôi rất sợ mỗi khi nghe tin cảnh sát hợp tác với đặc vụ liên bang. Tôi sống ở khu Cadwallader. Con gái tôi không dám đi học một mình vì sợ bị hỏi giấy tờ, dù con không làm gì sai.

Xin hội đồng thành phố hạn chế việc cảnh sát địa phương hỗ trợ đặc vụ liên bang bắt giữ người nhập cư.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Car break-ins on our street
emails.body:
This is my third email about it. Package theft and car break-ins on our block have doubled this year. We've lived in Cadwallader for 6 years. Nobody even called back about the report. We put up cameras ourselves.

I SUPPORT more patrols and community service officers in our area. Thank you for reading this.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Upstream subdivision will worsen drains
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

The new subdivision upstream would pave over the last open field, and I am worried the storm drains on our street cannot handle the runoff. Our basement flooded twice in the last five years, and both times the water came up through the storm drain.

Please require a drainage study that models a 100-year storm with the new paved surfaces.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Lights out near my home
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

Our family has been in Calico Creek for 4 years. Our whole block lost its streetlights after the wire theft in the spring and only one came back. I reported it through the app twice and got an automatic reply both times.

Please prioritize the streetlight maintenance contract and fix our block.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Colchón tirado en la calle
emails.body:
Hola,

Alguien tiró un colchón viejo y una silla rota en la esquina de mi calle hace cuatro días. Los niños juegan ahí y ya hay olor feo cuando llueve.

Les pido que lo recojan pronto y que pongan vigilancia en esa esquina.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Fees hidden inside the rent
emails.body:
Hello,

Our building manager raised rent by the maximum allowed and then added a new monthly trash fee on top. That fee was not in our lease, and the increase came right after we asked for a repair that never got done.

Please make sure fees count toward the rent cap so landlords cannot shift costs around it.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: 小餐馆许可证拖延
emails.body:
您好：

我在申请开一家小餐馆，许可证审批已经等了八个月，每次都要求补交新的文件。每个月我都要付空店面的租金。

希望市政府加快许可证审批，增加审图人员。

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Senior center hours
emails.body:
Hello,

I'm a Sierramont homeowner. The senior center near us cut its hours to three days a week and my father now eats lunch alone most days. It costs very little compared to what it gives back.

Please restore the full senior center schedule. This has gone on long enough.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Recolección de basura
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

Vivimos en Village Oaks desde hace 27 años. La basura no la recogen desde hace dos semanas en mi cuadra, aunque los botes ya están llenos. Mi esposo trabaja de noche y no puede esperar en la calle para reportarlo.

Quisiera que el camión pase a su horario y que me digan por qué fallaron.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Calle destruida por los baches
emails.body:
Hola,

La calle donde vivo tiene baches grandes que se hacen más profundos cada temporada de lluvia. Mi carro ya tuvo que ir al taller dos veces por las llantas y los amortiguadores. Los vecinos mayores tienen miedo de caminar porque el pavimento está roto cerca de la banqueta.

Les pido que reparen la calle completa y no solo parchen los huecos más grandes.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Couch dumped on the sidewalk for two weeks
emails.body:
Hello,

I'm a teacher and a parent of 3. Someone keeps dumping mattresses and construction debris at the end of our street.

Please clean it up and put a camera at this spot.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Landlord won't fix anything
emails.body:
Hello,

The building's front door lock has been broken for months and strangers sleep in the stairwell. My neighbor uses a wheelchair, so this matters a lot.

I SUPPORT proactive rental inspections so tenants don't have to fight alone.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Proactive rental inspection and habitability enforcement

emails.subject: Dangerous pothole
emails.body:
Hi,

I've been in this city 25 years and I've never written before. We live near the corner of Azule Avenue and Calero Avenue. There is a pothole on our street the size of a manhole cover and it has been there since winter.

Please fix this pothole before someone gets hurt.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Tired of paying more
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

Everything costs more every month, and nobody seems to care about people who are working hard. My family and I live in Norwood.

Please keep the working families in mind when you vote.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Catalytic converter thefts
emails.body:
Hello,

I run a shop near the corner of Felder Dr and Woosley Dr. There have been five car break-ins on our street since August and two catalytic converter thefts. We put up cameras ourselves.

I SUPPORT more patrols and community service officers in our area.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Las reparaciones tardan más en mi zona
emails.body:
Buenas tardes,

En mi lado de la ciudad las reparaciones tardan meses, mientras en otras zonas las hacen en pocas semanas. Nosotros también pagamos impuestos y merecemos el mismo servicio que cualquier otra familia.

Les pido que den igual respuesta a todas las zonas, sin importar el ingreso de la gente.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: 孩子放学后
emails.body:
放学以后孩子没有地方去，晚上只能在街上闲逛，我很担心他们的安全。

希望市政府能增加夜间青少年活动项目，让孩子们有地方去。

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Luz de la calle apagada
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

La luz de la calle cerca de mi casa lleva más de un mes apagada y se oscurece todo el tramo. Vivo cerca de Clovercrest Drive y Glen Brae Lane. Ya la reporté en la aplicación 311 y nadie ha venido a repararla.

Les pido que manden a alguien a repararla y revisen si se robaron los cables.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Road surface is falling apart
emails.body:
This is my fourth email about it. The pavement on our street is cracked end to end and water sits in the low spots.

I SUPPORT more road-repair funding for residential streets.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Fairness in street repair schedules
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

The street repair schedule seems to favor the newer subdivisions, and our older blocks keep getting pushed back. We have been waiting almost two years for a simple resurfacing that a neighboring area got in one season.

Please set repair priorities using a clear need-based scoring method that is published online.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Meal program hours
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

The lunch site for seniors only takes reservations by phone and the line is always busy. I've lived in Dentwood since 2010.

Please allow walk-in signups for older adults at the lunch program.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Rides to appointments
emails.body:
Hello,

My mother needs rides to her dialysis appointments and the paratransit line keeps saying no. I've lived in Willowmont since 2004. Our family takes turns driving her but we all work full days.

Please add more paratransit capacity for seniors going to medical appointments.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Mattresses and trash dumped on our street
emails.body:
Hello,

This is my fourth email about it. People dump old tires and paint cans by the creek path behind our homes. I own a small business near E San Antonio St and S 15th St. It smells and the rats are getting into yards.

Please schedule a cleanup crew and post no-dumping signs.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: dumping problem
emails.body:
Hello,

I'm a teacher and a parent of 2. Someone keeps dumping mattresses and construction debris at the end of our street. It smells and the rats are getting into yards.

I SUPPORT more dumping enforcement and faster cleanup.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Where does the housing money come from?
emails.body:
Hi,

I keep hearing about affordable housing money, but I cannot tell where the funding comes from.

Please publish a plain-language summary of where the affordable housing funding comes from.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Falta de patrullas
emails.body:
Buenas tardes,

En el complejo donde vivo se han robado varios carros este año y la policía casi nunca pasa por la noche. Mi esposo maneja de noche y dice que no ha visto ni una patrulla en semanas.

Les pido que aumenten las patrullas nocturnas y que el presupuesto apoye más oficiales.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Remodel permit backlog
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

My family and I live in Tamien. I'm retired and I walk the neighborhood every morning. Our ADU permit has been in plan review for eleven months and every round brings a new comment.

I SUPPORT the permitting modernization, but please add plan checkers, not just software.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Car break-ins on our street
emails.body:
Hi,

There have been five car break-ins on our street since August and two catalytic converter thefts. This is my fourth email about it. We live just off Trinidad Drive near Mt Pakron Drive. We put up cameras ourselves. Nobody even called back about the report.

Please fund faster police response for property crime. Thank you for reading this.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Camera ở khu phố
emails.body:
Xin chào,

Tôi sống gần Trinidad Drive và Jeremie Drive. Tôi đồng ý lắp camera ở các góc đường đông người qua lại vì nhiều xe máy bị trộm. Nhưng tôi mong thành phố công khai ai được xem các đoạn video và trong bao lâu thì xóa.

Xin hội đồng thành phố thông qua chương trình camera với quy định rõ ràng về việc lưu trữ dữ liệu.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Centro para personas mayores
emails.body:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

Vivo cerca de S Bascom Ave y Foxworthy Ave. El centro para personas mayores redujo sus horas y mi mamá ya no tiene a dónde ir. Ella se siente muy sola. Soy mecánico y casi no tengo tiempo, pero esto es importante.

Por favor regresen el horario completo.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Mold behind bedroom closet
emails.body:
To the City Council,

I live at the corner of Minuet Dr and N Capitol Ave. Mold grows on the bedroom closet wall after every rainstorm, and I found it in my daughter's shoes too. The landlord says it's just condensation and won't open the wall to look. We bought a dehumidifier out of our own pocket, but the wall is still damp to the touch.

Please send an inspector to open the wall and check for water intrusion and mold.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Preocupación por el tope de renta
emails.body:
Buenas tardes,

Tengo una casa con dos cuartos para rentar y el tope actual no me deja cubrir la reparación del techo. Vivo cerca de Redmond Ave y Mancuso St.

Les pido que revisen la fórmula del tope para que tome en cuenta los gastos reales del dueño.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Wetlands claim doesn't match
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

The environmental report says the rezoned parcel has no wetlands, but I have seen standing water there every spring. My house is right at Brigadoon Way and Laddie Way.

Please have the city recheck the wetlands delineation before approving the rezoning.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Our street needs real repaving
emails.body:
To the City Council,

Crews patched one pothole on our street and left four others right next to it. We pay our share of taxes and the street looks abandoned. A patch is not a fix if it fails in six months.

Please repave the block instead of patching it again. This has gone on long enough.

Thank you,
[name removed]
Holy Spirit resident
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Mentorship funding
emails.body:
Hi,

I support the budget item for youth mentorship, because a mentor on my son's team made a bigger difference than any patrol car could. I've lived in Baker West since 2015. Our city has a mentorship program that works, but it only has room for a few kids each year.

Please keep youth mentorship funding in the budget and open it to more kids in our area.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Aviso de desalojo por quejarme
emails.body:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

Me llegó un aviso de desalojo después de quejarme por la plaga de cucarachas en mi cocina.

Les pido que castiguen a los caseros que quieren desalojar a quien reporta problemas de salud.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Mattress dumped by the creek trail
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

Someone dumped a mattress and two chairs at the end of our block again.

Please send a crew to haul it away this week.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: 房租太高
emails.body:
议员们好，

我们家租房住，每年房租都涨，现在房租已经占了一半的收入。请支持降低每年房租上涨的上限 (rent cap)。

张伟
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Lonely at home
emails.body:
To the City Council,

I've been a homeowner near Huran Dr and Harbor View Ave for 7 years. I live alone now and I rarely talk to anyone during the week.

Please think about older residents who are isolated.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Dark parking lot behind our shop
emails.body:
Hi,

I own a small business near Delna Manor Ln and Downing Ave. The light pole behind our store has been dead for about a month and customers are asking whether it is safe. We put up a sign to warn people, but it is not enough when the sun goes down at five.

Please send a repair crew to the light pole behind our business as soon as possible.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Street racing at night
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

Every weekend after midnight cars race down the boulevard past our apartment and the noise wakes up the whole building. I live by Boxleaf Court and Judro Way with my family.

Please send patrols to enforce street racing at night and add speed humps where needed.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Tiền nhà
emails.body:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Gia đình tôi ở gần Greymont Dr và Vistapark Dr. Tiền nhà tăng lên một lần nữa và tôi không biết còn ở được bao lâu.

Mong thành phố quan tâm đến người thuê nhà như chúng tôi.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Old house with falling siding
emails.body:
To the City Council,

The old house on our block has had a roof tarp flapping in the wind for a year, and water gets into the attic every time it rains. Pieces of siding keep falling onto the sidewalk where kids walk to school. We reported it through the online portal twice, and the case was closed without anyone visiting.

Please have an inspector visit, secure the roof, and order repairs or demolition.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Ổ gà nguy hiểm trên đường
emails.body:
Xin chào,

Có một ổ gà rất lớn trên đường nhà tôi từ mấy tháng nay. Xe máy và xe đạp rất dễ bị ngã. Mẹ tôi đã 78 tuổi và đi lại khó khăn.

Xin thành phố cho sửa đường sớm.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
Cư dân khu Briarwood
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Water and sewer capacity for new units
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

I have been reading the staff reports and I do not see a clear plan for water and sewer service in our part of the city.
