Our water pressure drops during summer evenings, and I wonder how that will work with several new buildings on the same line. I would like to know whether the utility has counted the new connections.

Please publish the water and sewer capacity numbers that were used to approve each new project.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Our street needs real repaving
emails.body:
The pothole patch from last year already crumbled and the hole is back, deeper. I work nights, so I see this at 3 a.m. most days.

I SUPPORT more road-repair funding for residential streets.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Unsafe crossing near the school
emails.body:
We've lived in Chaboya for 11 years. Cars speed down our street every morning and there is no marked crosswalk for the kids. I'm retired and I walk the neighborhood every morning. A crossing guard was nearly hit in September.

I SUPPORT equal traffic-safety funding for every neighborhood, not just the loudest ones.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Las luces de la calle no funcionan
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

Varias luces de la calle están apagadas desde hace un mes. Soy costurera y casi no tengo tiempo, pero esto es importante. Mis hijos caminan de noche y da miedo.

Apoyo que la ciudad arregle las luces pronto.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Cost of groceries and gas
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I drive forty minutes to work and gas alone costs me a fortune every week now. We live just off Harwood Rd near Merrill Dr. I have started skipping the fresh produce just to make the grocery budget stretch.

I wish the city would think harder about how working people are getting squeezed.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Apoyo la protección a inmigrantes
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

Muchas familias tienen miedo de salir por las redadas de inmigración. Es la tercera vez que escribo.

Apoyo la resolución para proteger a las familias inmigrantes.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Cockroaches in the kitchen again
emails.body:
To the City Council,

We've lived in Santa Teresa for 7 years. Roaches are coming out of the stove and the cabinet under the sink every night. The exterminator came once in March and the problem came right back.

Please have an inspector look at the unit and require the owner to treat the building properly.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Abandoned RV on vacant lot
emails.body:
Someone has been parking an RV on the lot next to my house for most of the year, and it has not moved since spring. It has no visible registration and the tires are flat. There is a hose running from it to the neighbor's outdoor faucet, which looks like a long-term hookup.

Please check whether the RV is stored illegally and have it removed if it is abandoned.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Patch job already cracking
emails.body:
I live by Minnesota Ave and Bird Ave with my family. The last patch crew filled a pothole on our street, but it has already cracked and popped back out after two rains. I have photographed the crack and reported it through the 311 app, and the ticket was closed without a visit.

Please reinspect the patch and do a proper repair that lasts more than a few weeks.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Delivery trucks and potholes
emails.body:
To the City Council,

I own a small business near Lone Bluff Way and Oldham Way. Our delivery vans take the same route every day, and the potholes on this road are wrecking our suspension and tires. We have replaced four tires this year, which is hurting our small business. The trucks also have to slow to a crawl, which makes deliveries late and customers unhappy.

Please prioritize pothole repair on the main delivery routes that serve local businesses.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Hold a hearing
emails.body:
Hello,

We've lived in Willowmont for 3 years. I want the council to hold a public hearing on the policy before any vote, since the first draft was written without anyone from our community. Immigrant business owners on my street weren't invited to the first meeting, and I think that's a problem.

Please schedule a public hearing on the sanctuary draft with interpretation in several languages.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.to: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
emails.subject: Vẽ bậy trên tường
emails.body:
Xin chào,

Tường rào bên hông nhà tôi bị vẽ bậy lại sau khi đội vệ sinh đã sơn xong vài ngày. Đây là lần thứ ba trong năm nay, và nhìn rất xấu nên trẻ em trong xóm ngại đi qua. Tôi đã báo qua ứng dụng 311 hai lần nhưng vẫn chưa thấy ai đến làm lại.

Mong thành phố dùng loại sơn bền hơn và xử lý nhanh hơn khi có báo cáo.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Permisos tardan demasiado
emails.body:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

Llegamos en 2011 y queremos quedarnos. Llevo meses esperando el permiso para una pequeña remodelación.

Por favor simplifiquen el proceso de permisos.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Basura tirada en la calle
emails.body:
Hola,

Nosotros vivimos cerca de Vernice Avenue y Griffith Street desde hace 4 años. Siguen tirando basura y muebles viejos en la esquina de nuestra cuadra. Lo reportamos y tardaron semanas.

Apoyo que la ciudad limpie y ponga cámaras.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Slow police response
emails.body:
Hello,

I rent an apartment near Ford Rd and Summer Dr. Package theft and car break-ins on our block have doubled this year. This is my third email about it.

Please fund faster police response for property crime.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Priorities this year
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I live at the corner of Hillsdale Avenue and Summercreek Drive. I oppose adding more police money this year, because the youth programs got cut and those kids are the ones getting into trouble. We have seen more kids on the street since the community pool closed for repairs and never reopened. Give the money to after-school staff and counselors and see what changes in a year.

Please vote no on the next officer hiring increase and move that money to youth programs.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: We need more patrols
emails.body:
Hello,

There have been five car break-ins on our street since August and two catalytic converter thefts. I live in Norwood. Nobody even called back about the report. I work nights, so I see this at 4 a.m. most days. We put up cameras ourselves.

Please fund faster police response for property crime. Thank you for reading this.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Drain clogged again
emails.body:
Hello,

We live just off Fieldcrest Drive near Woosley Drive. Water pools across the whole intersection after any storm because the drain is blocked.

I SUPPORT funding storm drain upgrades on residential streets.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Streetlights out on our block
emails.body:
Hi,

I run a shop near the corner of Carryback Avenue and Indian Broom Drive. The streetlight in front of our house has been flickering and then off entirely for six weeks. I reported it through the app twice and got an automatic reply both times.

I SUPPORT funding a faster repair crew and theft-proof wiring.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Sewer repair stuck in review
emails.body:
Hello,

We live just off Quesada Drive near Henessy Drive. The landlord in our building is waiting on a plan check for a sewer repair, and the city has no published timeline for it. Every week the sewer line stays broken is another week our bathroom does not work. The staff at the counter said the reviewer has a backlog of about two hundred files, and that is the reason. We are asking for more reviewers so these basic repairs stop dragging on.

Please add plan checkers and publish turnaround times for repair permits like sewer work.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Las luces de la calle no funcionan
emails.body:
Buenas tardes,

Trabajo de noche y llego a casa a las 5. Vivo en Warm Springs. Varias luces de la calle están apagadas desde hace un mes. Lo reporté por la aplicación y nadie vino.

Por favor manden a alguien a repararlas.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Support the rent cap amendment
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I've lived in Lynbrook since 2016. I'm a renter and the annual increases are the reason my friends have left the city. We are not asking for a handout, just predictability. My son uses a wheelchair, so this matters a lot.

I SUPPORT lowering the annual rent-increase cap. Please vote yes.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Dark street again
emails.body:
Hello,

The streetlights on our street go dark every few nights and then stay out for weeks. I live by North Jackson Avenue and Pacheco Drive with my family. I've been in this city 30 years and I've never written before.

I SUPPORT funding a faster repair crew and theft-proof wiring.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Escombro junto al arroyo
emails.body:
Buenas tardes,

Nosotros vivimos cerca de Summer Dr y Ford Rd desde hace 20 años. Vecinos dejan escombros de construcción y pedazos de madera junto al sendero del arroyo cada fin de semana. Los perros se enredan con los clavos y ya dos personas se cortaron.

Les pedimos que limpien el área y que pongan letreros de multa.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Impuesto a la propiedad
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

No estoy de acuerdo con bajar el requisito de votos para aprobar impuestos locales, porque ya pagamos demasiado en la casa. Cada año sube la cuenta de impuestos sin que nadie nos pregunte, y nosotros somos los que pagamos.

Les pido que voten en contra de cualquier medida que baje el requisito de dos tercios.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Surveillance cameras
emails.body:
Hello,

We moved here in 1988 and we'd like to stay. The plan to add license-plate readers and surveillance cameras on every arterial goes too far for a city that values privacy. I live at the corner of Taft Dr and Blossom Valley Dr.

I OPPOSE expanding surveillance cameras without a privacy ordinance first.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Public can overflows
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

The public can outside our office keeps overflowing and nobody empties it on weekends.

Please add a weekend empty to the route.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Rác đổ trong hẻm
emails.body:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Tôi sống gần Fowler Road và Yerba Buena Road. Có người đổ rác xây dựng và mấy cái lốp xe cũ trong hẻm sau nhà tôi.

Mong thành phố cho xe đến dọn sạch giúp chúng tôi.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Childcare costs
emails.body:
Hi,

Daycare for our two kids costs more than my rent, and I cannot get a spot in the subsidized program. I work a night shift and my partner works mornings, so we juggle who watches them every week. Some of my coworkers have quit because they cannot afford childcare anymore.

Please make sure families like ours get a fair chance at affordable childcare.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: streetlight outage, third report
emails.body:
Hello,

I coach youth soccer and the families ask me about this. The streetlight in front of our house has been flickering and then off entirely for six weeks.

Please prioritize the streetlight maintenance contract and fix our block.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Se inunda la calle
emails.body:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

Cada vez que llueve la calle se inunda porque el drenaje está tapado. Vivo cerca de Union Avenue y Rosswood Drive. Soy mecánico y casi no tengo tiempo, pero esto es importante. El agua llegó a la cochera del vecino.

Por favor limpien el drenaje antes de las lluvias.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Transparency for appointments
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I run a shop near the corner of Chesbro Avenue and Calero Avenue. As a business owner, I want the appointment process to be published line by line, with each council member's vote and reasons recorded. Right now we hear results after the fact, and it is hard to hold anyone accountable.

Please require that every appointment vote and its reasons be posted online the same day.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Slow police response
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

Someone tried to break into our garage at 3 a.m. and police took over an hour to come. I've been a homeowner near Doyle Road and Marilla Avenue for 8 years. Nobody even called back about the report.

I SUPPORT more patrols and community service officers in our area.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Water in the street
emails.body:
Every time it rains hard, the street in front of our building floods and stays wet for hours. I live at the corner of Antonio Ln and Valley Forge Way.

Please clean out the drain grate on our block and check whether it is connected.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Robos en el vecindario
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

Es la cuarta vez que escribo. En mi cuadra ha habido varios robos a autos y casas.

Pedimos más vigilancia y que respondan a tiempo.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Unsafe crossing near the school
emails.body:
Hello,

The crossing by the elementary school has no signal and drivers do fifty through it. I'm writing on my lunch break, so I'll keep it short. We asked for a traffic study two years ago. A crossing guard was nearly hit in September.

I SUPPORT equal traffic-safety funding for every neighborhood, not just the loudest ones. We will keep watching how the council votes.

Regards,
[name removed]
Village Oaks resident
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Oppose moving patrol money
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I oppose the proposal to move patrol money into a new unit, because our street still waits hours for an officer.

Please vote no on that transfer until the department shows how response times will change.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Hiring teens
emails.body:
Hi,

I run a small landscaping business and I want to hire teens this summer, but the youth job placement paperwork is too slow. I run a shop near the corner of Bryan Avenue and Cherry Avenue. Two of the teens I interviewed had to drop out because the paperwork took six weeks.

Please fast-track the summer youth job placement process for local small businesses.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Senior center hours
emails.body:
Hi,

I'm a teacher and a parent of 4. The senior lunch program is the only place many older neighbors see anyone all week. I've lived in Farnham since 2012. It costs very little compared to what it gives back.

Please restore the full senior center schedule. I hope this gets on someone's list.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.to: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
emails.subject: Kho hàng và xe tải ban đêm
emails.body:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Tôi thuê nhà gần khu đất sắp xây kho hàng, nhưng báo cáo môi trường không hề nói đến xe tải chạy đêm.

Mong thành phố yêu cầu bổ sung đánh giá về xe tải chạy đêm trước khi duyệt.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Abandoned house on our street
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I'm writing on my lunch break, so I'll keep it short. I live near Hellyer Avenue and Silicon Valley Boulevard. The abandoned property next door has a pool full of green water and the weeds are taller than the fence. We worry about a fire.

Please send code enforcement back out and keep the case open until it's secured.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Delivery van break-in
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

Someone broke into our delivery van in the lot overnight and took the handheld scanners and a case of tools. I run a shop near the corner of Woosley Dr and Sautner Dr. That van is our only one, so we lost three days of deliveries while the window was replaced.

Please dedicate more patrols to commercial lots at night, since we pay taxes like everyone else.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Street lights have been out for weeks
emails.body:
Our whole block lost its streetlights after the wire theft in the spring and only one came back. It's the darkest stretch in the neighborhood now. I'm retired and I walk the neighborhood every morning. Seniors on our street have stopped taking evening walks.

I SUPPORT funding a faster repair crew and theft-proof wiring. I hope this gets on someone's list.

[name removed]
Village Oaks resident
emails.item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

emails.subject: Everything costs more
emails.body:
Hello,

We live just off S Monroe St near Moorpark Ave. Our grocery bill went up almost a hundred dollars a month, and the price of rice and eggs keeps creeping up. I used to meal plan once a week and now I am doing it every three days.

I just hope the city is paying attention to what working families are dealing with.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Bulky pickup for our tenants
emails.body:
We manage three small rentals and need bulky pickups faster than the current wait. I run a shop near the corner of Echo Valley Dr and Leyland Park Dr.

Please allow business owners to book bulky pickups online.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

emails.subject: Freeway noise and air
emails.body:
Hello,

We live close enough to the freeway that the windowsills are black with soot every week. I rent an apartment near Leigh Avenue and Hamilton Place. There is no sound wall on our side, only a chain-link fence. My son and I talk about this every week.

Please fund a sound wall and tree planting along this stretch.

Regards,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Programas para jóvenes
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

El centro comunitario cerró los programas para jóvenes en la noche. Llegamos en 2001 y queremos quedarnos. Vivo cerca de Lincoln Ave y Bennett Way.

Apoyo que la ciudad pague más programas para jóvenes.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Vote yes on the housing bond
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I am a homeowner who believes we should fund affordable housing even if it costs me a little more in taxes.

Please approve the affordable housing bond and make sure the money goes to projects quickly.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Speeding on our street
emails.body:
Hi,

We are writing on behalf of our members. The crossing by the elementary school has no signal and drivers do fifty through it. A crossing guard was nearly hit in September. We asked for a traffic study two years ago. I've been in this city 3 years and I've never written before.

I SUPPORT equal traffic-safety funding for every neighborhood, not just the loudest ones. I'm happy to talk to staff about it.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
Secretary
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Rò nước và ẩm mốc
emails.body:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Nhà tôi bị rò nước từ trần phòng tắm xuống phòng khách, sàn gỗ bị phồng lên và có mùi ẩm mốc. Tôi đã báo cho quản lý tòa nhà hai lần nhưng họ chỉ lau sàn. Gia đình tôi ở gần Kimberly Dr và Cherry Ave. Con tôi bị dị ứng và phải ngủ ở phòng khác vì mùi quá nặng.

Mong thành phố kiểm tra chỗ rò nước và buộc chủ nhà sửa tận gốc.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Coladera tapada
emails.body:
Estimados concejales,

La coladera de la esquina está tapada con hojas y el agua se queda en la calle cada vez que llueve. Nosotros vivimos cerca de Yerba Buena Rd y McLaughlin Ave desde hace 7 años.

Les pido que la limpien antes de la temporada de lluvias y la revisen cada otoño.

Gracias,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Pothole that keeps coming back
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

A pothole near the crosswalk bent the rim on my car last week. I coach youth soccer and the families ask me about this. I've been a homeowner near Jackson Street and North 13th Street for 30 years. My neighbor's tire blew out on it in March. We pay our share of taxes and the street looks abandoned.

Please repave the block instead of patching it again. Thank you for reading this.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Centro para personas mayores
emails.body:
Hola,

El centro para personas mayores redujo sus horas y mi mamá ya no tiene a dónde ir. Mi esposa y yo trabajamos en la limpieza de oficinas.

Por favor regresen el horario completo.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Rent stabilization first
emails.body:
To the City Council,

I am against any tax measure that puts the cost on renters without a rent cap, because that just passes the bill to the people who can least afford it. Our building has already had two rent hikes this year, and the owner says the property taxes are the reason. A rent cap would protect us more than any tax credit.

Please vote no on any ballot tax measure unless it comes with a rent stabilization provision.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: Rác bị vứt bừa bãi
emails.body:
Xin chào,

Gia đình tôi ở gần Santa Teresa Blvd và Fairway Glen Ln. Chúng tôi đến đây từ năm 2014. Có người vứt nệm cũ và rác ở góc đường nhà tôi.

Tôi ủng hộ phạt nặng người vứt rác.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Catalytic converter thefts
emails.body:
Hello,

Package theft and car break-ins on our block have doubled this year. I work nights, so I see this at 6 a.m. most days. People are scared to park on the street.

I SUPPORT more patrols and community service officers in our area.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Comidas para adultos mayores
emails.body:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

Vivo cerca de Bermuda Way y Ocala Avenue. Mi mamá recibe la comida del programa de adultos mayores solo entre semana y los fines de semana se queda sin comer. Ella no puede manejar y los vecinos no siempre están en casa.

Pido que el programa incluya entregas los sábados y domingos.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Break-ins in our lot
emails.body:
I rent an apartment near Quimby Road and Edgebank Drive. My car was broken into twice in one month in our apartment lot and the police only came out once, after I called three times.

Please prioritize repeat car break-in reports in the next budget and patrol plan.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Slow police response
emails.body:
My neighbor uses a wheelchair, so this matters a lot. Package theft and car break-ins on our block have doubled this year.

Please fund faster police response for property crime.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Opposing civilian pilot
emails.body:
Hi,

I've been a homeowner near Red Maple Way and Trailside Lane for 27 years. I oppose the proposed civilian crisis pilot because I don't trust that a new program will show up on time with enough staff at night.

Please vote no on the pilot until the city shows funded staffing and a training plan.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Puerta de cocina rota
emails.body:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

Vivo cerca de Lucerne Way y Higate Drive. Los vidrios de la puerta de la cocina están rotos y no cierran bien, así que entra mucho aire frío y hay cucarachas por los huecos. Ya puse cinta y cartón, pero no aguanta y el dueño dice que no tiene dinero para cambiarlos.

Quisiera que la ciudad revise la puerta y las ventanas y obligue al dueño a repararlas.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Mixed-use with height cap
emails.body:
Hello,

The proposed mixed-use building could bring needed shops, but only if it is sized to fit the block and the developer commits to ground-floor retail that stays open. Right now the plan calls for empty storefronts, which is exactly what we already have too many of. I would support it with a cap on height and a commitment to local tenants for the storefronts. Otherwise I would rather the lot wait for a better plan.

Please approve it only with a height limit and a local-tenant leasing commitment for ground-floor retail.

Thanks,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap

emails.subject: ADU permit stuck for months
emails.body:
To the City Council,

I signed a lease for my bakery last winter and still can't open because the permit is stuck. I coach youth soccer and the families ask me about this. I've been a homeowner near West Hedding Street and North Bascom Avenue for 19 years. Nobody at the permit center can tell me where it is in the queue. I'm paying rent and a loan on a space I can't use.

Please fix the permit backlog and set a real turnaround time. We will keep watching how the council votes.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule

emails.subject: Road surface is falling apart
emails.body:
To the City Council,

A pothole near the crosswalk bent the rim on my car last week. My partner uses a wheelchair, so this matters a lot. Cyclists have to swerve into traffic to avoid it.

Please fix this pothole before someone gets hurt.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
Rancho Rinconada resident
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: pothole damage to my car
emails.body:
Dear Mayor and Council,

The road surface on our block is so broken that delivery trucks swerve into the bike lane. I'm writing on my lunch break, so I'll keep it short. Cyclists have to swerve into traffic to avoid it.

I OPPOSE spending on cosmetic projects while basic streets crumble.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

emails.subject: Proteger a las familias
emails.body:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

Vivo cerca de Hanchett Ave y Sequoia Ave. Yo creo que la ciudad debe proteger a las familias inmigrantes, porque muchas tienen niños que van a la escuela y no quieren ver a la policía. Mi vecina dejó de mandar a su hija a la clase de música por miedo a que la detuvieran afuera. Eso no debe pasar en nuestra ciudad.

Les pido que aprueben un límite a la cooperación de la policía con agentes federales de inmigración.

Saludos,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

emails.subject: Support limits on cooperation
emails.body:
Hello,

I support limiting how much local police work with federal immigration agents, because my neighbors stop calling for help when they fear a knock at the door. I live at the corner of Newhall St and Sherwood Ave. Two families on our street have already moved out after rumors that agents were in the area.

Please pass the ordinance that keeps local officers out of civil immigration enforcement.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Car break-ins on our street
emails.body:
Dear Councilmember,

I'm writing on my lunch break, so I'll keep it short. My neighbor's catalytic converter was cut off in broad daylight last week.

Please fund faster police response for property crime.

[name removed]
emails.item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras

emails.subject: Oppose the Blossom Hill strip mall rezoning
emails.body:
Hello,

Rezoning the Blossom Hill retail parcel for another strip mall will add traffic that is already jammed at school pickup. This is my second email about it. I live by Galen Drive and Curie Drive with my family.

Please deny the Blossom Hill rezoning application.

Thank you,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Rezoning application: Blossom Hill Road retail parcel

emails.subject: Potholes slowing deliveries
emails.body:
Dear Council Office,

Our florist shop gets flower deliveries every morning and the potholes on our approach road are slowing the van down. I own a small business near Crowder Ave and Prescott Ave. Some flowers arrive bruised because the van bounces so hard, and we have had to write off orders.

Please fix the potholes on the approach road before the next busy season.

Best,
[name removed]
emails.item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding
